cases.title: Public realm discovery is served; Keycloak admin console and master realm are not published on the customer identity host id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the owner-approved console lives on the separate kc-admin host and is covered by docs/operations/14-keycloak-admin-console.md; absorbs CFG-035)
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)
No SSH tunnel is open from the test machine (the check is about the public path)

steps.action: curl -s https://id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/realms/matbakhy/.well-known/openid-configuration
steps.data: Read the JSON fields issuer, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, jwks_uri

steps.action: For each path run `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN><path>`
steps.data: /admin, /admin/, /admin/master/console/, /admin/realms/matbakhy, /realms/master, /realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/auth, /realms/master/.well-known/openid-configuration

steps.action: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/actuator/health ; same for /actuator/prometheus
steps.data: Both paths on the API host

steps.action: curl -sI http://id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/realms/matbakhy/.well-known/openid-configuration
steps.data: Plain HTTP request: expect a redirect to https (Caddy automatic HTTPS)

ui: Browser address bar never reaches a Keycloak admin login page on any of the listed paths
api: Discovery: HTTP 200, issuer equals exactly https://id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/realms/matbakhy, every endpoint URL starts with https://id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/
Every /admin* and /realms/master* path returns exactly 404 (Caddyfile: `respond @admin 404`, same assertion as deploy/web-preview/smoke.sh), not 401/302/403
/actuator/health and /actuator/prometheus on api. return 404
Plain http request answers 301/308 to https, never serves content
database: none

unverified: Keycloak paths other than /admin and /realms/master (for example /metrics, /health, /resources) are proxied unfiltered by Caddy; their content was not enumerated

cases.title: Customer web sign-in uses authorization code + PKCE S256 and a real logout ends the server session
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)
Private browser window, no prior cookies for app./api./id.
Password for preview-customer-1 comes from the private fixture sheet (server .env PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); do not type it into any repository file

steps.action: Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/ with DevTools Network 'Preserve log' on, click the sign-in link (Arabic UI by default)
steps.data: Observe the navigation to https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/oauth2/authorization/keycloak

steps.action: In the redirect to the id. host, read the query string of the /realms/matbakhy/protocol/openid-connect/auth request
steps.data: Check client_id, response_type, redirect_uri, scope, state, code_challenge, code_challenge_method

steps.action: Sign in as preview-customer-1 with the fixture-sheet password. Do NOT expect or enter an OTP
steps.data: Normal sign-in must not ask for a second factor under the default OPTIONAL policy

steps.action: Browser DevTools console on the signed-in app origin, using the session cookie: `fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/me',{credentials:'include',method:'GET',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/)[1]}})` (the XSRF-TOKEN cookie is set for the parent domain and readable; the session cookie MATBAKHY_SESSION is HttpOnly)
steps.data: GET /api/v1/me

steps.action: In the app click Sign out (calls POST /api/v1/auth/logout with the X-XSRF-TOKEN header)
Repeat GET /api/v1/me from the same tab, then press Browser Back and open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/account (the web app uses hash routes)
steps.data: Also inspect DevTools > Application > Cookies for MATBAKHY_SESSION

ui: Sign-in page is on id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> in the matbakhy realm and Arabic by default (defaultLocale ar)
After sign-in the app shows the customer as signed in; no OTP screen appeared
After sign-out the app shows the signed-out state; Back/refresh does not restore private data
api: Authorize request: client_id=matbakhy-web, response_type=code, redirect_uri=https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/login/oauth2/code/keycloak, code_challenge_method=S256 with a code_challenge present, state present, no implicit/hybrid response_type
GET /api/v1/me while signed in: 200 with the customer's own profile; no password or token in the body
After logout GET /api/v1/me: 401 and the MATBAKHY_SESSION cookie is deleted/expired (SecurityConfiguration deleteCookies)
database: Read-only: spring_session row for the principal exists while signed in and is gone after logout (isolated stack only; the preview DB is not queried by the tester)

unverified: Exact HTTP status of POST /api/v1/auth/logout (204 vs 200) was not confirmed in code
Whether the Keycloak SSO session also ends on app logout (post.logout.redirect.uris is registered; RP-initiated logout wiring not read)

cases.title: Web session expiry and server-side revocation: idle timeout and deleted session row both force re-authentication
prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete
The API container is started with WEB_SESSION_TIMEOUT=2m (default is 30m, application.yaml server.servlet.session.timeout) so the idle test is minutes, not half an hour
Operator has psql access to the isolated `matbakhy` database only (never the preview database)

steps.action: Sign in on the isolated customer web; run GET /api/v1/me (expect 200)
Wait 2 minutes 30 seconds without any request, then GET /api/v1/me
steps.data: Idle expiry

steps.action: Sign in again; operator runs `docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U matbakhy -d matbakhy -c "DELETE FROM spring_session"` on the isolated stack, then GET /api/v1/me
steps.data: Server-side revocation (table name per Spring Session JDBC default; confirm with \dt spring_session*)

steps.action: Click Sign in again on the app

ui: After steps 2 and 3 the app shows the signed-out state and offers sign-in; no private data is shown from cache
api: Steps 2 and 3: GET /api/v1/me returns 401
A replayed old MATBAKHY_SESSION cookie value returns 401
database: Read-only: `SELECT count(*) FROM spring_session` is 0 after step 3 before re-login

cases.title: MFA decision table (ISOLATED STACK ONLY): effective mode, required and available for every category combination, user preference and missing row (replaces CFG-007, 009, 010, 012-matrix, 013)
prerequisites: ISOLATED STACK ONLY (needs_isolated_stack): every row changes policy for all users of a category and R13 deletes a policy row; never run on the shared preview
Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)

Four account shapes exist on the isolated stack: customer-only (FX-CUST-A: category CUSTOMER), cook (FX-COOK-A owns an approved kitchen: CUSTOMER+KITCHEN), staff (FX-STAFF-SUPPORT holds any active grant, no kitchen: CUSTOMER+STAFF), multi-role (FX-MULTIROLE: kitchen + active grant: all three). Every account is always in CUSTOMER (MfaPolicyService.decide)
Reset all policies first: three PUTs setting CUSTOMER, KITCHEN, STAFF to OPTIONAL and every fixture preference off (PUT /api/v1/me/security/mfa {"enabled":false})

steps.action: For each row of the table in `data` run the policy PUTs listed in the row, in order (GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy first for the versions). Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)

cases.title: Own two-step preference under OPTIONAL: enable only on a verified session; disable needs a recent factor, ends sessions, and is audited (absorbs CFG-017)
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)
CUSTOMER policy is OPTIONAL (GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy as an admin shows mode OPTIONAL for CUSTOMER)
FX-CUST-A has completed CFG-102 (authenticator enrolled), preference currently off
OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET is set in the stack's .env (`grep -c '^OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=.' .env` prints 1; never print the value)

steps.action: Sign in password-only at app.<D> > Account > Security > click 'Turn on two-step verification'
steps.data: Expect refusal because the session has no MFA

steps.action: Open the 'Verify now' link (https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/oauth2/authorization/keycloak?stepUp=true&returnTo=https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/), enter the OTP, return, then click 'Turn on two-step verification'
Sign out and sign in password-only, then call PATCH /api/v1/me body {"displayName":"E2E","expectedVersion":<current>}
steps.data: Preference is on => protected writes need MFA

steps.action: In a second private window sign in as FX-CUST-A, do step-up with OTP, keep this window open (window W2). In window W1 (MFA-verified) click 'Turn off two-step verification'
steps.data: Disable with a recent factor

steps.action: In W2 reload any page and GET /api/v1/me; also GET /api/v1/me/security in W1
steps.data: Disable ends the user's application web sessions

steps.action: Sign in password-only again; turn the preference on once more and then wait 11 minutes (OIDC_STEP_UP_MAX_AGE default 10m) in the MFA session; click 'Turn off two-step verification'
steps.data: Disable with a stale factor

ui: Step 1: banner 'This action needs additional verification.' with link 'Verify now'
Step 6: same banner/link; preference stays On
After step 4 'Security settings updated.' and status Off
api: Step 1: PUT /api/v1/me/security/mfa {"enabled":true} => 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
Step 2: 200 with enabled=true, required=true, verifiedInSession=true
Step 3: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
Step 4: 200 enabled=false, required=false

Step 5: W2 GET /api/v1/me => 401 (application sessions of the account end); W1 session also ended, so a new sign-in is needed; provider sessions end too only when OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET is configured (best effort)
Step 6: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED (auth_time older than step-up-max-age)
database: Read-only: `SELECT enabled FROM user_mfa_preference WHERE user_id=<A>` goes true then false

Read-only: `SELECT action, outcome FROM audit_event WHERE actor_id=<A> AND action LIKE 'mfa.preference.%' ORDER BY occurred_at` shows mfa.preference.enable then mfa.preference.disable (ALLOWED), details {effectiveMode: OPTIONAL}; denied attempts are not audited

unverified: Whether W1 itself is also ended by the disable (sessions.endAllFor(subject) ends every application session of the subject, including the caller's) is inferred from code, expectation recorded as such
Preview-safe: only FX-CUST-A's own preference changes, but it needs a real TOTP; acceptable on the shared preview once the migration exists

cases.title: Category set to REQUIRED: enforcement reaches the next request, the user cannot turn it off, open endpoints stay reachable, policy change is audited
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
Policies are all OPTIONAL and all preferences off before starting; FX-CUST-A and FX-COOK-A are enrolled (CFG-102) so they can pass the step-up

Do not run on the shared preview: mfa-policy.md step 5 says REQUIRED starts with STAFF and CUSTOMER/KITCHEN must not be REQUIRED until the mobile app is verified (this case sets CUSTOMER and KITCHEN to REQUIRED on the isolated stack only)

steps.action: Sign in password-only (level 1) and keep the tab open

After step-up on ops.<D> open Security tab > 'Two-step verification policy per category'; set Customers to Required with reason 'E2E required', click Apply (UI warns 'REQUIRED makes every user in the category verify with a second factor on their next request.')
steps.data: Or PUT /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy/CUSTOMER {mode:REQUIRED, expectedVersion:<n>, reason:'E2E required'}

steps.action: Without re-login, call each: GET /api/v1/me ; GET /api/v1/me/security ; GET /api/v1/meals ; PATCH /api/v1/me ; POST /api/v1/orders (any valid-looking body) ; POST /api/v1/auth/logout
steps.data: Protected, open and public paths

steps.action: PUT /api/v1/me/security/mfa {"enabled":false} on a step-up session
Repeat step 3 for GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard with a level-1 session while only CUSTOMER is REQUIRED
steps.data: Cook is also CUSTOMER so it is affected

steps.action: Set Customers back to Optional (PUT mode OPTIONAL with the current expectedVersion)
steps.data: Rollback

ui: Customer web shows 'This action needs additional verification.' / 'Verify now' for refused actions, and 'Two-step verification is required for your account and cannot be turned off.' on Security
After step 2 the cook workspace shows 'Your account requires two-step verification before these screens can be used.'
api: Step 3 with level-1 session: GET /api/v1/me 200; GET /api/v1/me/security 200; GET /api/v1/meals 200 (public); PATCH /api/v1/me 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED; POST /api/v1/orders 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED; POST /api/v1/auth/logout allowed
After a step-up the same PATCH/POST succeed (no new policy needed)
Step 4: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with field enabled=MFA_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY
Step 5: GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
database: Read-only: mfa_policy CUSTOMER row version +2 after step 2 and step 6; two mfa.policy.update audit rows with from/to OPTIONAL->REQUIRED->OPTIONAL and the reason text

unverified: POST /api/v1/orders body validity was not hand-built; use the UI checkout to trigger it if a hand-built request returns 400 before the filter (the filter runs first, so expect 403 first)

flow.instruction: شغّل plan عند المشغّل. لو الحسابات ناقصة استخدم apply بعد التفويض فقط: الأداة تعمل backup وpartial import بنفس IDs وSQL للمنح وrefresh للمواعيد وreconciliation. existing users يحتفظوا بباسوردهم القديم. لا تعيد seed-preview.sql.
flow.expected: reconciliation تنجح وتظهر الهوية وصلاحياتها المطلوبة. كلمات السر الجديدة في BACKUP_DIR/owner-e2e-private/<run>/credentials.private.json، صلاحيات600، عبر قناة خاصة فقط.
flow.verification: المشغّل يقارن IDs والـgrants بالقيم المطلوبة في تجهيزات الحالة؛ عند اختلاف ID الأداة ترفض قبل SQL.

./owner-e2e-provision.sh plan

cases.title: Category DISABLED: enrolment is refused, existing preference and authenticator are not silently removed, staff high-risk step-up still applies
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
FX-CUST-A is enrolled with preference ON (CFG-008 step 2) before the category is changed
FX-STAFF-SUPPORT holds support.case

steps.action: Set CUSTOMER, KITCHEN and STAFF all to DISABLED (three PUTs, reason 'E2E disabled'; step-up session)
steps.data: FX-CUST-A (enrolled, preference ON) and FX-CUST-NEW (never enabled) exist

steps.action: GET /api/v1/me/security
steps.data: Preference must be retained

steps.action: PUT /api/v1/me/security/mfa {"enabled":true}
steps.data: Enabling while DISABLED

steps.action: With a password-only session call PATCH /api/v1/me; then click 'Manage authenticator app (add or remove)' in Security
steps.data: Keycloak account console is outside the API's control

steps.action: With a password-only session (no fresh step-up) PUT /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy/STAFF {mode:OPTIONAL, expectedVersion:<n>, reason:'E2E restore'}
steps.data: STAFF=DISABLED does not remove the staff high-risk control

steps.action: Step up (OTP) and repeat the PUT to restore OPTIONAL; restore CUSTOMER and KITCHEN to OPTIONAL
steps.data: Rollback

ui: Security shows 'Two-step verification is not available for your account right now.' and no 'Turn on' button
Keycloak account console still allows adding an authenticator (documented residual risk, not a defect)
api: FX-CUST-A GET /api/v1/me/security: effectiveMode DISABLED, enabled true (preference kept), required false, available false
PUT enabled=true: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with field enabled=MFA_UNAVAILABLE
PATCH /api/v1/me with a password-only session: 200 (no step-up asked)
Staff policy PUT without recent MFA: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED even though STAFF=DISABLED
database: Read-only: `SELECT enabled FROM user_mfa_preference WHERE user_id=<A>` is still true after the category change

unverified: Step 2 wording is awkward: simplest executable form is to use FX-CUST-NEW (never enabled) for the PUT enabled=true and FX-CUST-A to observe the retained preference

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete
Operator has psql on the ISOLATED database only; this case would lock out accounts on a shared environment

steps.action: As operator: `docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U matbakhy -d matbakhy -c "DELETE FROM mfa_policy WHERE category='KITCHEN'"`
Password-only session: GET /api/v1/me/security then PATCH /api/v1/me
steps.data: Cook is CUSTOMER+KITCHEN

steps.action: Password-only session of the customer-only account: GET /api/v1/me/security
steps.data: KITCHEN does not apply

steps.action: Restore: `INSERT INTO mfa_policy(category,mode) VALUES ('KITCHEN','OPTIONAL')` (version column defaults to 0)
Check API logs of the API container for the period for tokens, OTP or secrets: `docker compose logs api --since 10m | grep -i -E 'secret|otp|token' | wc -l`
steps.data: Expect only non-sensitive words

ui: Cook sees the 'requires two-step verification' screen until the row is restored
api: Cook: effectiveMode REQUIRED, required true; PATCH => 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
Customer-only: unaffected (OPTIONAL)
No stack trace or secret in logs
database: Read-only: `SELECT * FROM mfa_policy` has 2 rows during the test and 3 after restore

unverified: There is no API to delete a policy row; the situation only arises from data damage

cases.title: Policy update uses optimistic versioning and a mandatory reason
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)

steps.action: After step-up: GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy, note STAFF.version = v
PUT /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy/STAFF {"mode":"OPTIONAL","expectedVersion":v,"reason":"E2E first"}
Repeat the exact same PUT (still expectedVersion v)
steps.data: Stale version

steps.action: PUT with expectedVersion v+1 and reason "ab" (2 characters)
steps.data: Reason shorter than 3

steps.action: PUT with expectedVersion v+1 and no reason field
steps.data: Missing reason

ui: Ops web shows 'Policy saved.' once and a refreshed-data message for the stale attempt
api: Step 2: 200 with version v+1
Step 3: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT; the stored mode and version are unchanged
Step 4: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (body constraint @Size min 3 or service check)
Step 5: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED field reason
database: Read-only: exactly one new audit_event mfa.policy.update row for steps 2 (none for 3-5); mfa_policy.version = v+1

unverified: Original CFG-015 assumed two admins (Admin A/B) racing; one admin issuing the same stale version proves the same rule deterministically. Real concurrency is not needed

flow.configuration: الأداة من deploy/web-preview؛ plan للقراءة، apply تعديل فعلي في Keycloak وقاعدة التطبيق، يحتاج موافقة المالك على Preview المشتركة. لا تنشئ User عشوائي بدل fixed-ID fixture.
flow.instruction: شغّل plan عند المشغّل. لو الحسابات ناقصة استخدم apply بعد التفويض فقط: الأداة تعمل backup وpartial import بنفس IDs وSQL للمنح وrefresh للمواعيد وreconciliation. existing users يحتفظوا بباسوردهم القديم. لا تعيد seed-preview.sql.
flow.expected: reconciliation تنجح وتظهر الهوية وصلاحياتها المطلوبة. كلمات السر الجديدة في BACKUP_DIR/owner-e2e-private/<run>/credentials.private.json، صلاحيات600، عبر قناة خاصة فقط.

./owner-e2e-provision.sh plan

cases.title: Policy mutation authorization ladder (refusals only): guest, customer, ungranted staff, bootstrap admin, and granted staff without recent MFA; no state change
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)

Every PUT in this case is expected to be REFUSED; if any returns 2xx the case FAILS and the policy must be restored from the version/mode read in step 1 (GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy). Safe on the shared preview only because nothing is expected to change

steps.action: curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"mode":"OPTIONAL","expectedVersion":0,"reason":"E2E guest"}' https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy/STAFF
steps.data: Body mode value equals the current STAFF mode read beforehand; no CSRF, no credentials

steps.action: Same PUT from a customer session (use the console with X-XSRF-TOKEN)
Same PUT from preview-ops-2 (no grants); also GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy
Same PUT and GET as preview-ops-1 (holds staff.grant, audit.read only)
steps.data: The bootstrap admin does NOT hold security.mfa_policy

steps.action: With a PASSWORD-ONLY session: GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy (record all modes and versions), then PUT /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy/STAFF with the CURRENT mode and current expectedVersion
steps.data: Read needs the permission only; write needs recent MFA, so this PUT must be refused

ui: Ops web: only accounts holding security.mfa_policy or security.mfa_reset see the Security > policy controls (App.tsx adds the tab for those flags)
api: Guest: 401 (or 403 on missing CSRF token before authentication; record which)
Customer, NOGRANT, preview-ops-1: 403 FORBIDDEN
FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B password-only: GET 200; PUT 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
GET /api/v1/me/security canManagePolicy is true only for ADMIN-B
database: Read-only: mfa_policy rows (mode, version) identical before and after; no new mfa.policy.update audit_event row

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET is set in the stack's .env (`grep -c '^OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=.' .env` prints 1; never print the value)
FX-CUST-B account id known (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE subject=... on the isolated DB, or from the ops web account search)

steps.action: POST /api/v1/ops/accounts/<FX-CUST-B id>/mfa-reset {"reason":"E2E reset attempt long"}
steps.data: Support has no security.mfa_reset

steps.action: Password-only session: same POST
After step-up: POST with {"reason":"short"} (5 chars)
After step-up: POST to its OWN account id with a valid reason
After step-up: POST to a random UUID 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 with a valid reason

ui: Ops web Security > 'Reset a user's two-step verification' requires Account id and a Reason of at least 10 characters
api: Step 1: 403 FORBIDDEN
Step 2: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
Step 3: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (reason min 10)
Step 4: 403 FORBIDDEN 'an administrator cannot reset their own MFA'
Step 5: 404 NOT_FOUND
No credential is removed in any step
database: Read-only: step 4 writes audit_event action='mfa.reset' outcome='DENIED' reason 'self reset refused'; steps 1-3 and 5 write no mfa.reset.attempt row; user_mfa_reset has no row for FX-CUST-B

unverified: Validation order (permission/recent MFA before body validation) follows @PreAuthorize then @Valid; step 3 status assumes MFA passes first

cases.title: Authorized MFA reset removes the OTP credential, ends sessions, forces re-enrolment and is audited without exposing any secret
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET is set in the stack's .env (`grep -c '^OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=.' .env` prints 1; never print the value)
FX-CUST-B enrolled an authenticator (CFG-102 for preview-customer-2) and has preference ON; FX-CUST-B is signed in in a separate browser window WB with an MFA session
This changes the live Keycloak credential of FX-CUST-B: run on FX-ISOLATED first; on the shared preview only after the owner agrees FX-CUST-B may lose its authenticator

steps.action: Step-up on ops.<D>, Security tab > 'Reset a user's two-step verification': Account id = FX-CUST-B id, Reason = 'E2E reset authorised', click Reset
steps.data: Or POST /api/v1/ops/accounts/<id>/mfa-reset

steps.action: In WB click anything that calls the API (GET /api/v1/me)
Sign in password-only and GET /api/v1/me/security; then PATCH /api/v1/me
steps.data: Preference is still ON so MFA is required

steps.action: Open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/oauth2/authorization/keycloak?stepUp=true&returnTo=https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/
steps.data: Keycloak must lead to authenticator enrolment (no old authenticator works)

steps.action: Try the OLD authenticator code at the enrolment/OTP prompt (if an OTP form shows)
steps.data: Old factor is gone

ui: Reset result text: 'Removed 1 verification factor(s) and ended the sessions.'
WB is signed out
Old authenticator codes no longer accepted
api: Reset: 200 {accountId, removedFactors:1, sessionsEnded:true}; response has no secret/OTP field
Password-only session: GET /api/v1/me 200, PATCH 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
The response of GET /api/v1/ops/audit never contains a credential
database: Read-only: audit_event actions in order: mfa.reset.attempt (ALLOWED, reason) then mfa.reset (ALLOWED, details {removedFactors:1, sessionsEnded:true}); `SELECT reset_at, reset_by FROM user_mfa_reset WHERE user_id=<B>` has a row

unverified: Whether old authenticator codes are rejected at an OTP form after credential deletion is Keycloak behaviour; with no credential Keycloak should route to enrolment, not an OTP form

cases.title: MFA reset while Keycloak admin access fails midway: attempt audited first, partial reset recorded, retry converges
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET is set in the stack's .env (`grep -c '^OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=.' .env` prints 1; never print the value)
Operator can stop/start the identity container of the ISOLATED stack

steps.action: On the isolated stack: `docker compose stop identity`, then POST /api/v1/ops/accounts/<FX-CUST-B id>/mfa-reset {"reason":"E2E outage reset"}
steps.data: Keycloak down (unconfigured case is CFG-023)

steps.action: `docker compose start identity`, wait until `./deploy.sh status` shows identity healthy, step-up again, repeat the same POST
With a bearer/session issued BEFORE the first POST: call PATCH /api/v1/me
steps.data: Pre-reset assertion must not count

ui: Ops web shows an error for step 1 (not 'Removed N factors')
api: Step 1: non-2xx (5xx or 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE), no sessionsEnded:true
Step 2: 200 removedFactors equals the credentials that actually existed (0 if none, 1 if enrolled); idempotent
Step 3: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED or 401, never success
database: Read-only: audit_event has mfa.reset.attempt (ALLOWED) then mfa.reset (DENIED, reason starting 'reset incomplete: ', details {removedFactors, completed:false}) for step 1, and an ALLOWED mfa.reset for step 2; user_mfa_reset.reset_at set from step 1 (stays in force)

unverified: HTTP status returned when Keycloak is unreachable (RuntimeException rethrown) not confirmed; record the observed one

cases.title: After a reset a still-valid pre-reset token or session cannot perform a protected or staff high-risk action
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET is set in the stack's .env (`grep -c '^OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=.' .env` prints 1; never print the value)

FX-CUST-B has preference ON and an enrolled authenticator; a mobile or scripted client holds an access token issued before the reset (web sessions are ended by the reset, so only the isolated stack with a bearer harness or the iPhone can show the token case: see CFG-109)

steps.action: Obtain an MFA-asserted access token A1 (acr mfa) via the isolated stack's test harness (identity/verify-mfa-flow.py style flow on a throwaway user, NOT a preview account); confirm PATCH /api/v1/me with A1 is 200
Reset that user's MFA (CFG-019 step 1)
Within the 5 minute token lifetime repeat the PATCH with A1
steps.data: Token has not expired

steps.action: Re-authenticate with step-up after the reset; repeat PATCH with the new token A2
steps.data: Assertion newer than reset_at counts

ui: n/a (API-level)
api: Step 1: 200
Step 3: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED (satisfiedBy requires auth_time >= reset_at); the same A1 also fails StaffAssurance.recentMfa for a staff user
Step 4: 200
database: Read-only: user_mfa_reset.reset_at later than A1's auth_time

unverified: There is no browser-only way to hold a pre-reset bearer token; the automated test is the primary evidence and the manual check is limited to the harness/device

cases.title: Invalid and reused TOTP codes at the Keycloak OTP prompt are rejected and Keycloak brute-force protection applies
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete
FX-CUST-A enrolled on the isolated stack (a lockout test must not hit preview-customer-1)

steps.action: Start step-up (https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/oauth2/authorization/keycloak?stepUp=true&returnTo=https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/); enter a wrong 6-digit code once
Enter the correct current code; sign out of Keycloak; start step-up again within the same 30-second window and enter the SAME code
steps.data: Replay of a used code

steps.action: Enter wrong codes consecutively until Keycloak shows a temporary lockout message; record the count of attempts
steps.data: Realm has bruteForceProtected=true; thresholds not set in the realm file

ui: Wrong code: invalid authenticator code message, stays on OTP page
Lockout: account temporarily disabled message
api: No token is issued on a wrong or replayed code; no STEP_UP satisfaction results (GET /api/v1/me/security verifiedInSession=false)
database: none (credentials live in Keycloak)

unverified: Whether Keycloak rejects a replayed TOTP depends on the OTP policy 'reusable' setting; not configured in matbakhy-realm.preview.json, so replay acceptance is an observation to record, not an assumed pass
Lockout threshold uses Keycloak defaults (not in the realm file)

cases.title: Reset and provider-session end return a safe 503 when the Keycloak admin client secret is not configured; policy and preference keep working
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
Isolated API started with OIDC_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET blank (compose env override), nothing else changed

steps.action: After step-up: POST /api/v1/ops/accounts/<FX-CUST-A id>/mfa-reset {"reason":"E2E no secret"}
PUT /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy/STAFF with a valid body (policy still works)
Enable then disable own MFA (CFG-008 steps 2 and 4) and read the API logs: `docker compose logs api --since 5m | grep 'provider admin access not configured'`
steps.data: Disable still ends application sessions but not provider sessions

ui: Ops web shows a dependency-unavailable error for the reset
api: Step 1: 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE with field mfa=ADMIN_ACCESS_NOT_CONFIGURED
Step 2: 200
Step 3: 200, log line 'MFA turned off; provider admin access not configured, provider sessions were not ended' present
database: Read-only: no mfa.reset.attempt and no user_mfa_reset row for FX-CUST-A (the guard runs before the attempt is audited)

cases.title: Staff high-risk actions (grants) require recent MFA regardless of policy mode; a password-only staff session is refused and the step-up path works (isolated, separate synthetic staff accounts)
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

ISOLATED STACK ONLY: uses separate synthetic staff accounts (fixtures.md), NOT the password-only preview-ops-* accounts, and changes grants. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds staff.grant and has an enrolled authenticator; FX-STAFF-SUPPORT has no support.case grant yet
FX-ISOLATED exists and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` there prints flows=complete (the step-up half needs the migrated realm; the refusal half works on any build with StaffAssurance)

Fixture variant (ordinary fixtures.json grants differ): FX-STAFF-SUPPORT normally holds support.case, so BEFORE the case revoke its support.case grant (POST /api/v1/ops/staff/<id>/grant-revocations) so the probe grant can be added; FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B keeps its ordinary grants (staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset) and is not changed. AFTER the case, restore: re-grant support.case to FX-STAFF-SUPPORT (it must end with exactly its ordinary grant list ['support.case'], verify via GET /api/v1/ops/staff)

steps.action: Sign in at ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> password-only; open the Staff tab
POST /api/v1/ops/staff/<FX-STAFF-SUPPORT account id>/grants {"permission":"support.case","reason":"E2E grant probe"} with the password-only session
steps.data: Confirm body field names in contracts/openapi.yaml postOpsStaffGrants first

steps.action: Open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/oauth2/authorization/keycloak?stepUp=true&returnTo=https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/, enter the TOTP, repeat step 2

Cleanup/restore: revoke the probe support.case grant if still active, then ensure FX-STAFF-SUPPORT holds exactly one active support.case grant again (re-grant with step-up if needed), then GET /api/v1/ops/staff
steps.data: End state equals fixtures.json: FX-STAFF-SUPPORT grants = [support.case]

ui: Ops web shows 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' with a step-up link /oauth2/authorization/keycloak?stepUp=true&returnTo=... for the refused action
api: Step 2: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED (token has no acr/amr MFA evidence or auth_time older than OIDC_STEP_UP_MAX_AGE)
Step 3: 201/200 with the new grant
GET /api/v1/ops/staff still 200 without MFA
database: Read-only: no user_grant row for FX-STAFF-SUPPORT after step 2; one active support.case row after step 3 (audit_event staff.grant ALLOWED); revoked_at set after step 4 (audit_event staff.revoke ALLOWED)

unverified: Request body field names for postOpsStaffGrants (permission, reason, expiresAt) taken from GrantService signature, schema not read; confirm in contracts/openapi.yaml before running

cases.title: Staff grants: no self-escalation, no duplicate active grant, last staff.grant holder cannot be revoked
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete
Isolated stack with exactly one holder of staff.grant (preview-ops-1 bootstrap), another account FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B present, and step-up done for each admin before its calls

Fixture variant: needs exactly ONE active staff.grant holder. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (ordinary: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset) is NOT used as the second holder initially; use preview-ops-1/FX-STAFF-ADMIN as the sole staff.grant holder: if ADMIN-B exists on the stack, revoke its staff.grant first (needs another holder, so do this before revoking anyone else) and RESTORE it at the end. Step 2 grants security.mfa_policy to ADMIN-B, which ordinarily already holds it: duplicate-grant 409 is then the expected first answer, or revoke that grant before and restore after. Step 4 adds staff.grant to ADMIN-B and revokes the original holder's: re-grant the original holder's staff.grant at the end. Final state must equal fixtures.json grants for both accounts

steps.data: Last administrator

steps.action: POST /api/v1/ops/staff/<ADMIN-B id>/grants staff.grant, then revoke preview-ops-1's own staff.grant

api: Step 1: 403 FORBIDDEN
Step 2: first 201/200, second 409 STATE_CONFLICT 'grant already active'
Step 3: 409 STATE_CONFLICT 'last administrator'
Step 4: grant 200; revoke 200
database: Read-only: audit_event staff.grant DENIED reason 'self-escalation refused'; staff.revoke DENIED reason 'last administrator protected'; user_grant keeps one active staff.grant row until step 4

cases.title: iPhone step-up for the same customer: banner, system-browser verification, tokens replaced, refused order placement re-sent only by explicit retry with the same idempotency key (device plan C2, C3)
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

TestFlight/Preview build installed on FX-DEVICE-IOS (physical iPhone) and the mobile OIDC client registered (docs/mobile/ios-testflight-beta.md step 'register the mobile client'; `VERIFY_MOBILE=1 ./migrate-mfa.sh verify` no longer SKIPs mobile checks). These documents (ios-beta-device-test-plan.md, ios-testflight-beta.md) exist on branch beta/ios-testflight-prep, NOT on PR #9 or develop
Preview allow-list decision made so the phone's network is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (device test plan expects no 403 'Not available')
Customer web (app.<D>) and the phone use the same synthetic customer FX-CUST-A, preference currently off

steps.action: C1 first: on the phone sign in as FX-CUST-A, browse, add to basket, request a quote. No OTP is asked anywhere
On the web (app.<D> > Account > Security) turn on two-step verification (CFG-008 steps 1-2)
steps.data: Now MFA is required for this account

steps.action: On the phone with the basket still filled press the checkout/place-order button
steps.data: Placement is refused 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED

steps.action: Observe the step-up banner; do NOT tap anything for 10 seconds; check that no order exists (web Orders list)
steps.data: The refused placement must not be re-sent automatically

steps.action: Tap the banner 'Verify'; in the system browser sheet enter the password (prompt=login) and the OTP; return to the app
steps.data: acr_values=mfa 2 is sent by the app

steps.action: Pull to refresh; verify basket and account are unchanged; tap the explicit retry/place-order again exactly once
steps.data: Same pending placement

steps.action: Count orders on the web Orders list and in the DB (isolated) / read-only SQL: `SELECT count(*) FROM customer_order WHERE customer_id=<A> AND created_at > <test start>`

ui: Banner testID step-up-banner with a Verify button appears after the refused call and disappears after verification
Basket and account unchanged after return; screens work after pull-to-refresh
api: Refused placement: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED, no order created
After verification the explicit retry returns 201 (or the idempotent replay of the same Idempotency-Key); exactly one order in total
Tokens replaced for the same subject (GET /api/v1/me returns the same account id)
database: Read-only: exactly one customer_order row created after the test start for the customer; idempotency_record has one row for (actor_id, idempotency_key) of the placement (V1__baseline_identity_and_idempotency.sql)

unverified: mfa-policy.md states no physical-device or simulator MFA run exists: this case is the first real evidence
Commit 89ec820 says a refused placement is re-sent only by explicit retry: confirm the visible control name on device
automated_coverage: apps/customer-mobile/src/signIn.test.ts, auth.test.ts, App.test.tsx (jest: params, banner, cancel, other 403s)

prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

TestFlight/Preview build installed on FX-DEVICE-IOS (physical iPhone) and the mobile OIDC client registered (docs/mobile/ios-testflight-beta.md step 'register the mobile client'; `VERIFY_MOBILE=1 ./migrate-mfa.sh verify` no longer SKIPs mobile checks). These documents (ios-beta-device-test-plan.md, ios-testflight-beta.md) exist on branch beta/ios-testflight-prep, NOT on PR #9 or develop
Preview allow-list decision made so the phone's network is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (device test plan expects no 403 'Not available')
Customer web (app.<D>) and the phone use the same synthetic customer FX-CUST-A, preference currently off

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)

Preferred: FX-ISOLATED exists (CUSTOMER=REQUIRED must not be set on the shared preview before the mobile app is device-verified, mfa-policy.md step 5): a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete

steps.action: Phone signed in as A with an MFA session (after CFG-024); screens work
C5: reset FX-CUST-A's MFA (CFG-019 step 1)
Open Orders
Verify again (re-enrolment); then on the web turn A's preference off
C6: set CUSTOMER to REQUIRED, then on the phone open Orders; afterwards set CUSTOMER back to OPTIONAL and reopen Orders

ui: After step 3 banner or sign-in prompt, never stale data
After REQUIRED the phone shows the banner on the next protected call; after OPTIONAL the journey works as C1
api: Step 3: 401 (sessions ended) or 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED; old token no longer counts
C6: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED then 200 after verification, and 200 again with no prompt after policy back to OPTIONAL and preference off
database: Read-only: user_mfa_reset row for A; mfa_policy CUSTOMER version +2

unverified: Isolated stack must be reachable from the phone (needs public hostname/TLS) or the case stays BLOCKED
cases.blocked_reason: Requires an isolated stack reachable from a physical iPhone over TLS; no such environment is defined in the repository

cases.title: Apply the MFA realm migration: verified backup first, flow bound last, verify gate prints RESULT (owner-gated, live-realm change)
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Operator shell on the server in the deploy/web-preview directory (CD uses /srv/matbakhy-staging/deploy/web-preview; docs/operations/06 mentions /srv/matbakhy-preview/src/deploy/web-preview; use whichever `./deploy.sh status` works in)

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Rehearse on FX-ISOLATED first (realm imported from origin/develop's realm file, then `./migrate-mfa.sh apply`); the live run additionally requires owner authorization and a change window (3-5 minutes, no downtime)
`./migrate-mfa.sh status` shows flows=absent and `./deploy.sh status` shows the PR #9 release
Free space for backups under $BACKUP_DIR (default /srv/matbakhy-backups)

steps.action: `./migrate-mfa.sh status` (record) then `./migrate-mfa.sh apply 2>&1 | tee apply.log`
`ls -l $BACKUP_DIR/keycloak/` and `ls -l $BACKUP_DIR/db-*/`
steps.data: Backups exist, mode 600 for keycloak files

steps.action: `./migrate-mfa.sh status`
steps.data: After

steps.action: Last line of apply.log and exit code: `tail -n1 apply.log; echo exit=$?`
Normal sign-in of preview-customer-1 and preview-ops-1 at the web apps: no OTP asked

steps.data: Only view-users and manage-users

ui: Normal sign-in unchanged for existing users
api: apply.log shows the order: database backup, Keycloak DB dump, realm export, migration, verify; the final line is `RESULT: PASS` (exit 0), or `RESULT: INCOMPLETE` (exit 3, 'applied, not proven') or FAIL (exit 1); PASS requires verify-mfa-flow.py to have exercised acr/amr and the API
After: flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser, client.matbakhy-admin=present
Service account holds exactly view-users and manage-users

cases.title: Default MFA state after deploy: all three categories OPTIONAL, nobody required, sign-in never asks OTP for customer, cook or staff
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)

steps.action: GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy (needs security.mfa_policy; password-only is enough for GET)
steps.data: Three rows

steps.action: Sign in password-only at app.<D>; GET /api/v1/me/security
Sign in password-only at ops.<D> as preview-cook-1; GET /api/v1/me/security
Sign in password-only at ops.<D> as preview-ops-1; GET /api/v1/me/security

ui: No OTP page in any of the three sign-ins
api: Policy: CUSTOMER, KITCHEN, STAFF each mode OPTIONAL (version 0 on a fresh deployment)
Each /me/security: effectiveMode OPTIONAL, enabled false, required false, available true; cook categories [CUSTOMER,KITCHEN]; ops-1 [CUSTOMER,STAFF]
database: Read-only: `SELECT category, mode, version FROM mfa_policy` returns three OPTIONAL rows; no audit mfa.policy.update rows on a fresh deploy

unverified: The live preview's mfa_policy may differ if anyone changed it; the test records actual values

prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

cases.title: Content-Security-Policy is Report-Only (not enforced) on app. and ops.; baseline header set on every host
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)
Chrome or Edge desktop with DevTools

steps.action: `for h in app ops api id media; do echo == $h; curl -sI https://$h.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/ | grep -i -E 'strict-transport|x-content-type|referrer-policy|x-robots|x-frame|content-security|server'; done`
Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/ with DevTools Console open, run: sign in, browse meals, basket, quote, checkout up to the order screen; copy every `[Report Only]` console message
steps.data: Violations are logged, not blocked

steps.action: Open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/ as preview-ops-1 and visit Staff, Security, Configuration, Finance tabs; copy `[Report Only]` messages
In the Console of app.<D> run `document.body.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('script'),{textContent:'window.__csp=1'})); window.__csp`
steps.data: Inline script injection probe

ui: No page is broken; any violation appears only as a console report
api: app./ops. carry `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only` (default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://media.<D>; connect-src 'self' https://api.<D>; frame-ancestors 'none') and NO `Content-Security-Policy` header
Step 4 returns 1: inline script runs, which proves CSP is NOT enforced; record exactly this and do not claim enforcement (SEC-004 open)

All hosts: Strict-Transport-Security max-age=31536000 (no includeSubDomains), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, no Server header; X-Frame-Options: DENY only on app. and ops.
database: none

unverified: This case is evidence gathering for CSP promotion; Step 2/3 violation lists are inputs for the follow-up task, not pass criteria
Promotion to enforced CSP (rename header, prove injected inline script blocked) is a different, later, owner-visible change and is not part of this case

cases.title: Brute-force and rate limiting: Keycloak lockout is the only login throttle; application-level rate limits for login/quote/order/search are not implemented
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

FX-ISOLATED exists: a disposable compose stack with its own PREVIEW_DOMAIN and fresh volumes built from the PR #9 head images, realm imported, `./deploy.sh up` healthy, `./deploy.sh seed` run, and `./migrate-mfa.sh status` run on it prints flows=complete
A disposable throwaway Keycloak user FX-CUST-NEW on the isolated realm (never preview-customer-*)

steps.action: Submit a wrong password on the Keycloak login form repeatedly (record count until the lockout message; realm has bruteForceProtected=true with default thresholds)
Then log in with the right password during lockout and after waiting out the lockout
steps.data: Legitimate user recovery

steps.action: Send 60 sequential `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://api.<isolated>/api/v1/meals` and 60 POST quote calls from one session; count non-200 results
steps.data: Bounded, isolated stack only

steps.action: Phone verification: request more than 3 codes within an hour or within the resend interval (/api/v1/me/phone/challenges)
steps.data: The implemented limiter (PhoneVerificationService)

ui: Lockout message shows after N failures
api: Step 1: temporary lockout appears; the user is not enumerated (generic message)

database: Read-only: payment event rows carry synthetic markers only (no provider reference); notification outbox, if present, has no delivered-to-provider status

cases.title: Physical iPhone build identity and baseline: install from TestFlight, record build/version, reach the API, sign in and out (device plan A1, A2, B1, B4, B5, D2)
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

TestFlight/Preview build installed on FX-DEVICE-IOS (physical iPhone) and the mobile OIDC client registered (docs/mobile/ios-testflight-beta.md step 'register the mobile client'; `VERIFY_MOBILE=1 ./migrate-mfa.sh verify` no longer SKIPs mobile checks). These documents (ios-beta-device-test-plan.md, ios-testflight-beta.md) exist on branch beta/ios-testflight-prep, NOT on PR #9 or develop
Preview allow-list decision made so the phone's network is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (device test plan expects no 403 'Not available')
Customer web (app.<D>) and the phone use the same synthetic customer FX-CUST-A, preference currently off

steps.action: A1: install from TestFlight; open Settings > Matbakhy Beta and record version and build number
steps.data: Bundle com.matbakhy.customer.beta

B1: Account > sign in with FX-CUST-A; B4: sign out; B5: sign in as FX-CUST-B
D2: open a deep link to an order while signed out
Record device model, iOS version, build, date, tester; no tokens or codes in screenshots

ui: Name 'Matbakhy Beta'; Arabic default or device language; system browser sheet (not embedded) for sign-in; no data of A after switch to B; deep link asks to sign in and shows nothing private
api: Discover returns meals (no 403 'Not available')
Server-side: build is accepted by the beta OIDC client (matbakhy-beta registered)
database: none

unverified: Bundle id and client id taken from the commit message of 8ddc7b5 (beta branch), not present in PR #9
Android has no equivalent device plan in the repository: add a Android physical-device case when the plan exists
automated_coverage: native CI builds IOS-NATIVE logs (build only, no sign-in/MFA journey)

cases.title: Account console link and residual risk: Manage authenticator opens the Keycloak account console; DISABLED cannot stop adding an authenticator there
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Live realm migrated (owner-gated): on the server `./migrate-mfa.sh status` prints flows=complete, browserFlow=matbakhy browser and client.matbakhy-admin=present (NOT true on the live realm today: migration has never been run there)

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)

steps.action: Account > Security > click 'Manage authenticator app (add or remove)'
steps.data: accountManagementUrl from GET /api/v1/me/security

Confirm the master realm account page is still 404: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://id.<D>/realms/master/account/`

ui: Keycloak account console 'Signing in' page of the matbakhy realm opens in the same account
api: accountManagementUrl is an https URL on id.<D>
Master realm path 404

cases.title: Authorized MFA policy change by an administrator with recent MFA is applied, audited and restored to the exact previous mode
prerequisites: Deployed release recorded: on the server, in the deploy/web-preview directory, run `./deploy.sh status` and note RELEASE_COMMIT, both image digests and the schema version

Deployed API contains PR #9 (D18): `./deploy.sh status` shows schema version >= 31 and RELEASE_COMMIT is the PR #9 head or later; origin/develop does NOT contain V31/MfaController, so on the current deployment GET /api/v1/me/security is not a 200

Tester's source IP is inside CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS (and STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and /api/v1/ops, /api/v1/cook): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/` returns 200 (a 403 body 'Not available' means the IP is not allow-listed; the preview is deny-by-default, not public, unless the owner set CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS=0.0.0.0/0)

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B holds active grants security.mfa_policy and security.mfa_reset and has an enrolled authenticator (TOTP secret kept in the private fixture sheet). Provision per docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.md (the bootstrap administrator preview-ops-1 holds only staff.grant and audit.read, so these permissions are absent by default)
ISOLATED STACK ONLY: this case really changes policy (REQUIRED->OPTIONAL weakens, DISABLED->OPTIONAL changes behaviour); run only on FX-ISOLATED

steps.action: GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy and write down mode and version of STAFF (prior)
Step up with the enrolled TOTP, then PUT /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy/STAFF {"mode":"<a mode different from prior>","expectedVersion":<version>,"reason":"E2E authorised change"}
GET /api/v1/me/security for a STAFF-category account and GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy
steps.data: Effect on the next request

steps.action: Restore: PUT STAFF back to the prior mode with the new version and reason 'E2E restore'
steps.data: Rollback

ui: Ops web Security tab shows 'Policy saved.'
api: Step 2: 200 with version prior+1 and the new mode
Step 3: the staff account's effectiveMode follows the new value without re-login
Step 4: 200, mode equals prior, version prior+2
database: Read-only: two mfa.policy.update audit rows with details {category:STAFF, from, to} in both directions and the reasons given; mfa_policy.mode equals the prior mode at the end

unverified: Guest PUT order of CSRF vs authentication rejection not confirmed

cases.title: Applicant saves a draft, is told what is missing, submits revision 1 and stays a non-cook until staff decide
prerequisites: FX-CUST-NEW (PROVISION): a Keycloak user that has signed in at least once (so an app_user row exists) and has never created a cook application. Verify: SELECT count(*) FROM cook_application WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE subject = '<subject>') returns 0.

The API is reachable at https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> opens (IP allow-list permitting). No customer-web or mobile screen can create a cook application: apps/customer-web/src and apps/customer-mobile/src contain no call to /api/v1/cook/application, so this case drives the API from the browser console.

steps.action: Open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and press 'Sign in' (ar 'تسجيل الدخول'); sign in as FX-CUST-NEW (password from the private fixture sheet).
steps.data: Page title 'Cook workspace - ...' (ar 'مساحة الطاهي'). Use the language button (shows 'العربية' / 'English') to check both languages.

steps.action: On the screen read the heading and the status line; note that no tab bar is shown.
Open DevTools console on this tab and define the helper, then run: await x('GET','/api/v1/cook/dashboard') and await x('GET','/api/v1/cook/application').
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Run: await x('PUT','/api/v1/cook/application',{publicName:'مطبخ القبول',bio:'أكل بيتي تجريبي',contactPhone:'12345',privateLocation:'عنوان تجريبي رقم 5',pickupEnabled:true,zoneIds:[],documentIds:[]})
steps.data: contactPhone '12345' is deliberately not an Egyptian mobile number.

steps.action: Run the same PUT with contactPhone:'01000000999' and WITHOUT the bio property (omit bio), no expectedVersion (the application does not exist yet).
steps.data: publicName 'مطبخ القبول', privateLocation 'عنوان تجريبي رقم 5', pickupEnabled true, zoneIds [], documentIds []

steps.action: Run: await x('POST','/api/v1/cook/application/submit',{expectedVersion:0})
steps.data: Expected to fail: the draft has no bio.

steps.action: Run the PUT again with all fields including bio:'أكل بيتي تجريبي', zoneIds:['00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001'], expectedVersion:0.
steps.data: Phone is stored normalized as +201000000999.

steps.action: Run: await x('POST','/api/v1/cook/application/submit',{expectedVersion:1})
Reload the page https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (F5).
Run: await x('POST','/api/v1/cook/meals',{titleAr:'محاولة'}) and await x('PUT','/api/v1/cook/application',{publicName:'اسم جديد',expectedVersion:2})

ui: Step 2: heading 'This account has no approved kitchen yet.' (ar 'لا يوجد مطبخ معتمد لهذا الحساب بعد.') and the line 'You have not started an application.' (ar 'لم تبدأ طلب الانضمام بعد.'); no tab navigation.
Step 9: the line 'Application status: SUBMITTED' (ar 'حالة الطلب: SUBMITTED'; the state code is shown untranslated); still no tab bar; still the heading 'This account has no approved kitchen yet.'.
api: Step 3: GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard -> 403 code FORBIDDEN; GET /api/v1/cook/application -> 404 code NOT_FOUND.
Step 4: 422 code VALIDATION_FAILED with fieldErrors containing {field:'contactPhone', code:'INVALID_EGYPTIAN_MOBILE'}; nothing is stored.
Step 5: 200, body.state 'DRAFT', body.version 0, body.draft.contactPhone '+201000000999', draft.bio null.
Step 6: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with fieldErrors containing {field:'bio', code:'REQUIRED'}; application stays DRAFT, currentRevision 0.
Step 7: 200, state 'DRAFT', version 1 (the second save requires expectedVersion equal to the stored version 0 and increments it).
Step 8: 200, state 'SUBMITTED', currentRevision 1, history has one entry {revision:1, decision:null}, version 2.
Step 10: POST /api/v1/cook/meals -> 403 FORBIDDEN (no approved kitchen); PUT draft in SUBMITTED -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT.
database: SELECT state, current_revision, version FROM cook_application WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE subject = '<FX-CUST-NEW subject>') -> SUBMITTED, 1, 2.
SELECT revision, decision, reviewer_id FROM cook_application_revision WHERE application_id = <id> -> exactly one row (1, NULL, NULL).
SELECT count(*) FROM kitchen WHERE owner_id = <user id> -> 0 (no kitchen without an approval).
SELECT action, outcome, object_type FROM audit_event WHERE actor_id = <user id> AND action = 'cook.application.submit' -> one row, ALLOWED, cook_application, details {"revision":1}.

unverified: The exact JSON field name of the stored phone in body.draft (contactPhone) is taken from CookApplicationService.Draft; the OpenAPI schema CookApplication was not diffed field by field.
Whether the customer-web will get an 'apply as cook' screen later is not in the code; a UI-based application cannot be tested today.
