cases.title: Staff approval creates the kitchen; the applicant becomes a cook only after START_REVIEW and APPROVE with fresh MFA
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

FX-COOK-PENDING (seed-owner-e2e.sql, CONSUMED by this case): login owner-e2e-cook-pending (subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000b2), application id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000ba1b2 in state SUBMITTED, public_name 'مطبخ تحت المراجعة', phone +201000000203, private location 'Synthetic location 3', pickup only, NO delivery zones, current_revision 1, version 0 (column default). Run on a fresh/disposable stack (fixtures.md: consumed fixtures; it is single-use: a consumed fixture is not reset by re-seeding; use a fresh isolated stack). Read the live version from GET /api/v1/ops/cooks/<id>; do not assume it.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.
FX-STAFF-OPS has an authenticator app (TOTP) available for the Keycloak step-up (first step-up enrols it). The two accounts are different people (a reviewer can never decide their own application).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: Open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, sign in as FX-STAFF-OPS (password from the private fixture sheet).
steps.data: Expect the tab bar to show 'Cook applications', 'Catalogue moderation', 'Order monitoring' (ar 'طلبات الطهاة', 'مراجعة الأطباق', 'متابعة الطلبات').

steps.action: Open tab 'Cook applications' (ar 'طلبات الطهاة'). The state filter 'Submitted' (ar 'مُقدَّم') is selected by default. Click the entry 'مطبخ تحت المراجعة'.
Read the detail card (do not press anything).

FX-STAFF-OPS: leave 'Decision reason' empty and click 'Start review' (ar 'بدء المراجعة') ONLY to obtain the second factor: if the session has no MFA proof younger than 10 minutes the notice 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' appears (403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED, nothing changes); press 'Verify again' (ar 'إعادة التحقق'), enter the TOTP code (first time: scan the QR code to enrol) and return to the ops page. The decision is NOT executed in this step.
After the step-up returns to https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, open 'Cook applications' > 'Submitted' > 'مطبخ تحت المراجعة' again and click 'Start review' - this is the single execution of START_REVIEW.
Type in 'Decision reason' (ar 'سبب القرار'): 'اكتملت البيانات وتم التحقق التشغيلي' and click 'Approve' (ar 'اعتماد').
Sign in to https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> as FX-COOK-PENDING in a second browser profile (or sign out first) and reload.
Anonymously open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/kitchens/<slug> where <slug> comes from SELECT public_slug FROM kitchen WHERE application_id = <application id>.
steps.data: slug has the form kitchen-<10 hex characters>

ui: Step 3: heading '<name> - Submitted' (ar 'مُقدَّم'), fields Bio, Contact phone (+201000000203, left-to-right), Private location 'Synthetic location 3', Pickup tick, '0 delivery zone(s)'; the only decision button is 'Start review'.
Step 4: notice 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' + button 'Verify again'; the heading still says 'Submitted'.
Step 5: heading changes to 'Under review' (ar 'قيد المراجعة'); decision buttons are now 'Approve', 'Request changes', 'Reject'.
Step 6: heading shows 'Approved' (ar 'معتمد'); a card 'Kitchen: مطبخ تحت المراجعة - Active' (ar 'نشط') appears with 'Active orders affected: 0'.

Step 7: FX-COOK-PENDING now sees the tabs Home, Orders, Meals, Slots, Statement, Insights, Settings (ar 'الرئيسية','الطلبات','الأطباق','المواعيد','الكشف','الأداء','الإعدادات') instead of the application status; Home shows the badge 'Active'.
api: Step 4: POST /api/v1/ops/cooks/{applicationId}/decision {decision:'START_REVIEW',revision:1,expectedVersion:<version read from GET /api/v1/ops/cooks/<id>, seeded 0>} -> 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED (no state change).
Step 5: same call after step-up -> 200, body.state 'UNDER_REVIEW', version 1.
Step 6: {decision:'APPROVE',revision:1,expectedVersion:1,reason:'...'} with an Idempotency-Key header -> 200, state 'APPROVED', version 2, kitchenId non-null, kitchen.operatingState 'ACTIVE'.
Step 8: GET /api/v1/kitchens/{slug} -> 200 with verificationLabel 'OPERATIONALLY_VERIFIED', available true, pickupEnabled true; the body contains no private location and no contact phone.
FX-COOK-PENDING: GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard -> 200 (was 403).
database: SELECT state FROM cook_application WHERE id = <application id> -> APPROVED.

SELECT decision, decision_reason, reviewer_id, decided_at FROM cook_application_revision WHERE application_id = <id> AND revision = 1 -> APPROVED, the typed reason, reviewer_id = FX-STAFF-OPS id, decided_at not null.
SELECT operating_state, approved_revision, application_id FROM kitchen WHERE owner_id = <FX-COOK-PENDING id> -> ACTIVE, 1, <application id> (exactly one kitchen).

SELECT action, permission, outcome, reason, details FROM audit_event WHERE object_type = 'cook_application' AND object_id = '<id>' ORDER BY occurred_at -> cook.application.view (cook.review, ALLOWED), cook.application.decision START_REVIEW ALLOWED, cook.application.decision APPROVE ALLOWED with the typed reason; plus one DENIED row action 'denied POST /api/v1/ops/cooks/<id>/decision', reason STEP_UP_REQUIRED from step 4.

cases.title: Suspending a kitchen stops new sales and acceptance of pending orders but lets already accepted orders be fulfilled
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

The seeded kitchen has an OPEN slot tomorrow 13:00-14:00 Africa/Cairo with 10 portions of 'كشري تجريبي' (Preview koshari, 75.00 EGP, meal id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001); FX-CUST-A has a verified phone (seeded).

The active commerce_policy has acceptance_window_minutes = 15 (devdata R__dev_commerce_policy.sql); perform steps 1-3 within 10 minutes so order O1 is still PENDING_ACCEPTANCE when the kitchen is suspended.
Nobody else may use kitchen A during this case; the last step restores it to ACTIVE. Orders created here remain as synthetic data.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

Run on a disposable stack (FX-ISOLATED): this case changes shared seeded state (kitchen A operating state / payment recipient / administrator grants); on any shared preview it would disturb other cases. Restoration steps are listed, but the stack is discarded afterwards.

steps.action: FX-CUST-A: open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, sign in, open the dish 'كشري تجريبي' (Preview koshari), choose tomorrow's 13:00 slot, quantity 1, 'Add to cart' (ar 'أضف إلى السلة'), go to the cart, mode 'Pickup from the kitchen', payment 'Cash on receipt' (chosen BEFORE calculating), 'Calculate total' (ar 'احسب الإجمالي'), tick 'I accept the terms and the cancellation policy' (ar 'أوافق على الشروط وسياسة الإلغاء'; Place order stays disabled until ticked) and click 'Place order'. Repeat once more so there are two orders O1 and O2.
steps.data: Two PICKUP cash orders of 75.00 EGP each. Note both public order numbers.

cases.title: Cook creates a meal draft with an uploaded photo and publishes it; customers see it only after publication
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
A synthetic JPEG file acceptance-dish.jpg, 640x480 pixels, under 1 MB, containing no real person or brand (the server accepts 320-8000 px sides, max 8 MiB, JPEG or PNG; policy in MediaPolicy.java).
The PREVIEW stack uses a fake malware scanner that returns CLEAN and a real SeaweedFS upload target (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, sign in (password from the private fixture sheet), open tab 'Meals' (ar 'الأطباق').

In the form 'New meal (draft)' (ar 'طبق جديد (مسودة)') fill: Arabic name 'طبق قبول تجريبي'; English name 'Acceptance test dish'; Public description 'طبق تجريبي لاختبار النشر والقبول'; Portion 'علبة وسط'; Ingredients 'أرز، خضار، بهارات'; Price (EGP) '85.50'; Allergens 'None declared' (ar 'لا يوجد ما يُعلن عنه'). Do not attach a photo yet. Click 'Create' (ar 'إنشاء').
On the new card 'طبق قبول تجريبي' (status Draft) click 'Publish' (ar 'نشر').
steps.data: Expected to be refused: there is no approved photo.

steps.action: Fill the form again with the same values (name 'طبق قبول تجريبي 2') and choose the file acceptance-dish.jpg in 'Meal photo' (ar 'صورة الطبق'). Click 'Create'.
On the new card click 'Publish'.
FX-GUEST: open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (not signed in), search 'طبق قبول تجريبي 2' and open the dish.

ui: Step 3: the card shows the error 'Check the fields.' (ar 'تحقق من الحقول.') and the status stays 'Draft' (ar 'مسودة').
Step 4: a second card appears with status 'Draft' and price 85.50 EGP.
Step 5: status badge becomes 'Published' (ar 'منشور'); buttons change to 'Pause' and 'Archive'.

Step 6: the dish page lists 'Acceptance test dish' / 'طبق قبول تجريبي 2', price 85.50 EGP, the allergy text 'The kitchen declared no known allergens in this dish.' and the photo; the first draft (step 2) is NOT findable.
api: Step 3: POST /api/v1/cook/meals/{mealId}/publication {action:'PUBLISH',expectedVersion:0} -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with fieldErrors containing {field:'photos', code:'APPROVED_PHOTO_REQUIRED'}.

Step 4 (browser network tab): POST /api/v1/uploads {purpose:'MEAL_PHOTO',contentType:'image/jpeg',bytes,sha256} -> 201 with uploadUrl (host media.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>), method PUT; the browser PUT to uploadUrl -> 200; POST /api/v1/uploads/{id}/complete -> 200 state 'APPROVED'; POST /api/v1/cook/meals -> 201 with content.photos[0].mediaId = that upload id, status 'DRAFT', priceMinor 8550.
Step 5: 200 status 'PUBLISHED', publishedAt set.

Step 6: GET /api/v1/meals/{mealId} (anonymous) -> 200 for the published meal and 404 NOT_FOUND for the draft; the photo URL is on the public media host and is a re-encoded JPEG (no original filename or EXIF).
database: SELECT status, price_minor, allergen_declaration, moderation_state FROM meal WHERE title_ar = 'طبق قبول تجريبي 2' -> PUBLISHED, 8550, NONE_DECLARED, VISIBLE; the draft from step 2 -> DRAFT, 8550.
SELECT state, purpose, scan_verdict, width, height FROM media_asset WHERE owner_id = <FX-COOK-A id> ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 -> APPROVED, MEAL_PHOTO, CLEAN, 640, 480; public_key not null.
SELECT revision, price_minor FROM meal_revision WHERE meal_id = <published meal id> -> at least revision 1 with price 8550.

unverified: Arabic text of errors.VALIDATION_FAILED in the ops web was not read; the English string is 'Check the fields.'.
The format of the price string on the card (digits and currency symbol) comes from formatMoney and is not asserted.

cases.title: Cook creates a slot in the ops web, opens it, and it becomes orderable for customers
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

Choose a free interval: tomorrow +10 days (so it does not overlap the seeded 13:00-14:00 slots of the next 3 days), 16:00-18:00. Africa/Cairo times are entered; the browser timezone does not matter (server interprets them as Cairo).
Kitchen A has PUBLISHED meals 'كشري تجريبي' and 'محشي تجريبي' (seed).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > tab 'Slots' (ar 'المواعيد'). Read the form 'New slot' (ar 'موعد جديد').

Fill Date = today+10 days, Start 16:00, End 18:00, Maximum portions 12, Order lead time (minutes) 120, and under 'Portions per meal' (ar 'حصص لكل طبق') enter 6 for 'كشري تجريبي' and 6 for 'محشي تجريبي'. Click 'Create' (ar 'إنشاء').
On the new slot card click 'Open' (ar 'فتح').
FX-GUEST: https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> open the dish 'كشري تجريبي' and look at 'Cooking slots' (ar 'مواعيد الطهي').
FX-COOK-A: click 'Close' (ar 'إغلاق') on the slot card, then reload the guest page.

ui: Step 2: a card titled with the time range appears with badge 'Draft' (ar 'مسودة') and '0 of 12 portions'.
Step 3: badge 'Open' (ar 'مفتوح').
Step 4: the new slot is listed for the date with '6 left' for the dish (ar 'متبقٍ ٦').
Step 5: badge 'Closed' (ar 'مغلق'); the guest page no longer lists the slot after reload.
api: Step 2: POST /api/v1/cook/slots {localDate,localStart:'16:00',localEnd:'18:00',maxPortions:12,leadMinutes:120,mealCapacities:[{mealId,capacity:6},...]} -> 201 state 'DRAFT', timezone 'Africa/Cairo', cutoffAt = startsAt minus 120 minutes, version 0.
Step 3: PATCH /api/v1/cook/slots/{id} {state:'OPEN',expectedVersion:0} -> 200 state 'OPEN', orderable true.
Step 4: GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots -> contains the slot.
Step 5: PATCH {state:'CLOSED'} -> 200; the public listing no longer returns it.
database: SELECT starts_at, ends_at, cutoff_at, max_portions, state, lead_minutes FROM cook_slot WHERE kitchen_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' AND local_date = <date> -> starts_at = 16:00 Cairo as UTC (14:00Z or 13:00Z depending on DST), cutoff_at = starts_at - 2h, 12, CLOSED at the end, 120.
SELECT meal_id, capacity FROM meal_slot WHERE cook_slot_id = <id> -> two rows capacity 6.

unverified: Whether Egypt is on DST on the test date (Africa/Cairo offset +02:00 or +03:00) decides the UTC value in the DB check; compare with the Cairo wall clock, not a fixed offset.
Where exactly the customer-web prints the per-slot 'N left' label (dish page slot list) was not traced to a component.

cases.title: A cook's onboarding document is private: only owner and the reviewing staff can read it, and replaying the upload ticket cannot change the approved copy
prerequisites: FX-CUST-NEW (PROVISION): a Keycloak user that has signed in at least once (so an app_user row exists) and has never created a cook application. Verify: SELECT count(*) FROM cook_application WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE subject = '<subject>') returns 0. Use an account that has NOT been used for E2E-COOK-048 (fixture sheet must supply a second FX-CUST-NEW).

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

FX-COOK-B (PROVISION by deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql): login owner-e2e-cook-b, re-pointed to the seeded second kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002, 1 meal, one OPEN slot from seed-preview.sql). Verify: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000b1' returns that kitchen, ACTIVE. Never create FX-COOK-B by approving FX-COOK-PENDING: that fixture is consumed only by E2E-COOK-049.

Replay (step 5) must happen within 10 minutes of the ticket (UPLOAD_TTL = 10 min). Nothing in this case needs a staff second factor (reading the application and its documents needs only cook.review). The sealing of approved documents (step 5/DB check) exists only in PR #9 (MediaService.java diff).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: As FX-CUST-NEW in the console of https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> define the helper, then create a synthetic 400x400 PNG and its checksum: const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=400;const g=c.getContext('2d');g.fillStyle='#cfe';g.fillRect(0,0,400,400);g.fillStyle='#000';g.font='24px sans-serif';g.fillText('SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT',20,200);const blob=await new Promise(r=>c.toBlob(r,'image/png'));const buf=await blob.arrayBuffer();const sha=[...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',buf))].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Create the ticket: const t=(await x('POST','/api/v1/uploads',{purpose:'COOK_DOCUMENT',filename:'licence.png',contentType:'image/png',bytes:buf.byteLength,sha256:sha})).body; then upload: const put=await fetch(t.uploadUrl,{method:'PUT',headers:t.requiredHeaders,body:buf}); then complete: await x('POST','/api/v1/uploads/'+t.uploadId+'/complete',{})
steps.data: Keep t.uploadId and t.uploadUrl.

steps.action: Attach and submit: PUT /api/v1/cook/application with the full draft of E2E-COOK-048 step 7 plus documentIds:[t.uploadId] and the current expectedVersion, then POST /api/v1/cook/application/submit.
Read as the owner: await x('GET','/api/v1/uploads/'+t.uploadId)

Replay the old ticket: build a DIFFERENT PNG (change the text to 'TAMPERED'), compute nothing, and run await fetch(t.uploadUrl,{method:'PUT',headers:t.requiredHeaders,body:otherBuf}); then await x('POST','/api/v1/uploads/'+t.uploadId+'/complete',{}) and await x('GET','/api/v1/uploads/'+t.uploadId).
steps.data: Note the status code of the PUT.

steps.action: Other accounts read the same id: FX-CUST-A, FX-COOK-B and FX-STAFF-OPS each run await x('GET','/api/v1/uploads/<uploadId>') in their own signed-in ops tab (FX-STAFF-OPS has not opened the application yet).

FX-STAFF-OPS: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'Cook applications' > 'Submitted' > the application (no decision needed) > section 'Documents' (ar 'المستندات') > 'View document #1' (ar 'عرض المستند'), then click the link 'Temporary link (5 minutes) #1'.
Wait 6 minutes and reload the temporary link in the browser.

ui: Step 7: the link opens the synthetic image 'SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT' (not 'TAMPERED'). Step 8: the browser shows an expired/denied storage error instead of the image.
api: Step 2: ticket 201 {uploadId, uploadUrl (host media.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>), method 'PUT', requiredHeaders {Content-Type:'image/png'}, expiresAt = +10 min}; PUT 200; complete 200 state 'APPROVED'.
Step 3: application PUT 200 and submit 200 state SUBMITTED; documentIds must be APPROVED COOK_DOCUMENT uploads owned by the applicant (otherwise 422 documentIds DOCUMENT_NOT_APPROVED).
Step 4: GET -> 200 state 'APPROVED' with a privateReadUrl for the owner.

Step 5: the replay PUT is either refused by storage (403) or accepted at the old upload key; in both cases complete -> 200 state 'APPROVED' and the document served afterwards is still the original (sha256 of the bytes behind privateReadUrl equals the first sha).
Step 6: FX-CUST-A and FX-COOK-B -> 404 NOT_FOUND; FX-STAFF-OPS -> 200 (the document is attached to a submitted revision) and an audit row is written.
database: SELECT state, purpose, private_key, public_key, scan_verdict FROM media_asset WHERE id = <uploadId> -> APPROVED, COOK_DOCUMENT, 'documents/<uploadId>' (the sealed key, not 'uploads/<uploadId>'), NULL public_key, CLEAN.
SELECT action, permission, outcome FROM audit_event WHERE object_type = 'media' AND object_id = '<uploadId>' -> access.media, cook.review, ALLOWED for FX-STAFF-OPS (one row per staff read).

unverified: PR #9 ONLY: the sealed copy 'documents/<id>' and the cleanup of the upload key exist only in PR #9 (git diff origin/develop...HEAD on MediaService.java: develop leaves private_key = the ticket key 'uploads/<id>'). On origin/develop step 5 is expected to FAIL (the replayed PUT can overwrite the approved document) - run it there only to document that known defect.
Whether SeaweedFS accepts a replayed presigned PUT after approval (200) or refuses it is storage behaviour I did not trace; the case asserts only that the sealed copy is unchanged.
The expiry response of the 5-minute read link (likely 403 from the S3 endpoint) was not read from code.
That the temporary link renders inline in the browser depends on the stored content type.

flow.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.167-86-90-174.sslip.io (the API is on https://api.167-86-90-174.sslip.io; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). flow.original: As FX-CUST-NEW in the console of https://ops.167-86-90-174.sslip.io define the helper, then create a synthetic 400x400 PNG and its checksum: const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=400;const g=c.getContext('2d');g.fillStyle='#cfe';g.fillRect(0,0,400,400);g.fillStyle='#000';g.font='24px sans-serif';g.fillText('SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT',20,200);const blob=await new Promise(r=>c.toBlob(r,'image/png'));const buf=await blob.arrayBuffer();const sha=[...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',buf))].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');

cases.title: Each staff account sees and can call exactly its granted sections; the administrator is not a superuser; denials are audited
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-SUPPORT (PROVISION): staff account with exactly one active grant, support.case. Provision as FX-STAFF-OPS (one INSERT into user_grant with permission 'support.case' after the first sign-in, or POST /api/v1/ops/staff/{userId}/grants by FX-STAFF-ADMIN with MFA).

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION): finance staff with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs (for example finance.read, finance.verify).

FX-STAFF-ADMIN (EXISTS) = preview-ops-1, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1: made the first staff administrator by STAFF_BOOTSTRAP_SUBJECT; holds exactly staff.grant and audit.read (GrantService.bootstrapAdministratorIfNone) and nothing else. Verify: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1 -> audit.read, staff.grant.

FX-STAFF-NOGRANT (EXISTS) = preview-ops-2, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f2: staff-style login with no grants. Its app_user row is created at its first sign-in (not in seed-preview.sql); its user id for API calls: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f2'.

FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
Record t0 = current time before the first sign-in. Use one browser profile per account (or sign out between accounts).
Kitchen A on the shared preview is never mutated by this case: P10 is skipped for OPS (it holds cook.review, so with recent MFA it could pause the kitchen).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: For each account in turn (SUPPORT, OPS, FINANCE, ADMIN, NOGRANT) open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, sign in (password from the private fixture sheet) and write down the tab names in the navigation bar (language English).
steps.data: Opening the page already makes the client send 8 probe GETs (9 in PR #9) plus GET /api/v1/me (App.tsx checkSession).

steps.action: In the same tab define the helper and run probes P1-P11 for that account.
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me') Probes (console helper, run each and record status + body.code): P1 GET /api/v1/ops/cooks?limit=1 [cook.review]; P2 GET /api/v1/ops/catalogue?limit=1 [content.moderate]; P3 GET /api/v1/ops/cases?limit=1 [support.case]; P4 GET /api/v1/ops/orders?limit=1 [order.ops]; P5 GET /api/v1/ops/finance/statements?kitchenId=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001 [finance.read or finance.settlement or finance.refund_approve]; P6 GET /api/v1/ops/payments?state=DISPUTED [finance.verify]; P7 GET /api/v1/ops/configuration [config.read or config.write]; P8 GET /api/v1/ops/staff [staff.grant]; P9 GET /api/v1/ops/audit?limit=1 [audit.read]; P10 POST /api/v1/ops/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/operating-state body {action:'PAUSE',reason:'probe only',expectedVersion:0} [cook.review + MFA]: run P10 ONLY for accounts WITHOUT cook.review (SUPPORT, FINANCE, ADMIN, NOGRANT); for OPS run it only on a disposable stack (FX-ISOLATED) in a session confirmed password-only (no acr/amr MFA claim; never after a step-up), because with a recent MFA proof it really pauses the kitchen; P11 GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy [security.mfa_policy, PR #9 only].

steps.action: After all five accounts are done, read the denial audit rows (SQL under database).

ui: Tabs per account (en / ar): SUPPORT -> 'Support' (الدعم) only. OPS -> 'Cook applications' (طلبات الطهاة), 'Catalogue moderation' (مراجعة الأطباق), 'Order monitoring' (متابعة الطلبات) - no 'Support' because OPS has no support.case. FINANCE -> 'Finance' (المالية) and 'Operating configuration' (الإعدادات التشغيلية, from config.read). ADMIN -> 'Staff permissions' (صلاحيات الموظفين) only. NOGRANT -> no tab bar; heading 'This account has no approved kitchen yet.'.
PR #9 additionally appends a tab 'Security' (ar from sec.tab) to every account that has at least one section; NOGRANT still shows no tabs.
No account sees the cook tabs (Home, Orders, Meals, ...) because none owns a kitchen.
api: Expected status per probe (200 allowed, 403 FORBIDDEN denied). SUPPORT: P3=200, all others 403. OPS: P1, P2, P4 = 200, P3 = 403 (no support.case), P5-P9 = 403, P10 is NOT run on the shared preview for OPS (on FX-ISOLATED with a password-only session: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED, because cook.review passes and recentMfa fails), P11 403. FINANCE: P5 = 200, P6 = 200, P7 = 200 (config.read), all others 403. ADMIN: P8=200, P9=200, all others 403 including P1-P7 (an administrator holds only what was granted). NOGRANT: every probe 403.
Every 403 body is {code:'FORBIDDEN', fieldErrors:[], requestId:<non-empty>, retryable:false}.
P10 by SUPPORT/FINANCE/ADMIN/NOGRANT -> 403 FORBIDDEN (no cook.review); kitchen A is still ACTIVE.
database: SELECT a.actor_id, count(*), array_agg(DISTINCT a.action) FROM audit_event a WHERE a.outcome = 'DENIED' AND a.object_type = 'endpoint' AND a.occurred_at > '<t0>' GROUP BY 1 -> one group per account; actions look like 'denied GET /api/v1/ops/orders' with reason 'FORBIDDEN' and request_id set; the count for each account equals its number of 403 probes plus the automatic 403s of its login (the page probes).
SELECT operating_state, version FROM kitchen WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' -> ACTIVE, unchanged.
SELECT user_id, permission FROM user_grant WHERE revoked_at IS NULL -> unchanged by the case (no probe grants anything).

unverified: Anonymous or non-ApiException 403s (for example a service-level ApiException FORBIDDEN such as 'caller has no approved kitchen' on /cook/dashboard) are NOT audited; only denials raised by Spring Security (@PreAuthorize, step-up) write 'denied ...' rows (ApiSecurityErrors.handle).
The 11th probe (security.mfa_policy) does not exist on origin/develop (404/403 there); the PR #9 expectation is 403 FORBIDDEN.

OPS holds cook.review: CookReviewController:76 evaluates the permission and then recentMfa, so OPS gets STEP_UP_REQUIRED (not FORBIDDEN) without MFA and a real pause with MFA; hence the isolated-stack-only variant.

flow.title: نفّذ فحوصات P1–P11 المحددة في نفس جلسة كل حساب
flow.goal: نفّذ فحوصات P1–P11 المحددة في نفس جلسة كل حساب
flow.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.167-86-90-174.sslip.io (the API is on https://api.167-86-90-174.sslip.io; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.167-86-90-174.sslip.io'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me') Probes (console helper, run each and record status + body.code): P1 GET /api/v1/ops/cooks?limit=1 [cook.review]; P2 GET /api/v1/ops/catalogue?limit=1 [content.moderate]; P3 GET /api/v1/ops/cases?limit=1 [support.case]; P4 GET /api/v1/ops/orders?limit=1 [order.ops]; P5 GET /api/v1/ops/finance/statements?kitchenId=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001 [finance.read or finance.settlement or finance.refund_approve]; P6 GET /api/v1/ops/payments?state=DISPUTED [finance.verify]; P7 GET /api/v1/ops/configuration [config.read or config.write]; P8 GET /api/v1/ops/staff [staff.grant]; P9 GET /api/v1/ops/audit?limit=1 [audit.read]; P10 POST /api/v1/ops/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/operating-state body {action:'PAUSE',reason:'probe only',expectedVersion:0} [cook.review + MFA]: run P10 ONLY for accounts WITHOUT cook.review (SUPPORT, FINANCE, ADMIN, NOGRANT); for OPS run it only on a disposable stack (FX-ISOLATED) in a session confirmed password-only (no acr/amr MFA claim; never after a step-up), because with a recent MFA proof it really pauses the kitchen; P11 GET /api/v1/ops/security/mfa-policy [security.mfa_policy, PR #9 only].

cases.title: Operations hide a meal with a reason; it leaves customer sale at once but the cook's draft/publication state is untouched; restore brings it back
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
Use the meal 'محشي تجريبي' (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002, PUBLISHED, 180.00 EGP); no staff second factor is needed for meal moderation (only content.moderate).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-STAFF-OPS: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'Catalogue moderation' (ar 'مراجعة الأطباق'). Type 'محشي' in 'Search' (ar 'بحث') and press 'Show' (ar 'عرض'). Read the card.
In the card, leave 'Reason' (ar 'السبب') empty and look at the red button; then type 'صورة مخالفة للمواصفات - اختبار' and click 'Hide' (ar 'إخفاء').
FX-GUEST: https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> search 'محشي' and open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002 directly.
FX-COOK-A: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > Meals: look at the card 'محشي تجريبي'. Try 'Publish'/'Pause' only by looking at the offered buttons.
FX-STAFF-OPS: filter 'Hidden' (ar 'مخفي'); in the card type reason 'تمت المراجعة' and click 'Show' (ar 'إظهار').
FX-GUEST: search 'محشي' again.
FX-STAFF-OPS: hide the same meal twice quickly in two tabs (second click on a stale card).
steps.data: Tab 1 hides; tab 2 (loaded before) clicks 'Hide'.

ui: Step 1: card shows title, status badge 'Published' (ar 'منشور'), badge 'Visible' (ar 'ظاهر'), 'مطبخ المعاينة - 180.00'.
Step 2: with an empty reason the button is disabled; after clicking, the card shows badge 'Hidden' (ar 'مخفي') and 'Reason: صورة مخالفة للمواصفات - اختبار'.
Step 3: the guest no longer finds the dish; the direct API call returns 404.
Step 4: the cook still sees status 'Published' and the same price - moderation is separate from the cook's status; the cook gets no 'Publish' offer because the status did not change.
Step 5-6: the dish is visible again and found by search.
Step 7: tab 2 shows 'The data changed. Refreshed; please try again.' (ar from errors.VERSION_CONFLICT).
api: Step 2: POST /api/v1/ops/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002/moderation {action:'HIDE',reason,expectedVersion} -> 200 moderationState 'HIDDEN', status 'PUBLISHED'; reason shorter than 3 characters -> 422 reason LENGTH_3_1000; repeating HIDE -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT ('meal is already HIDDEN').
Step 3: GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002 -> 404 NOT_FOUND; GET /api/v1/meals does not list it.
Step 5: {action:'RESTORE'} -> 200 moderationState 'VISIBLE'.
Step 7: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.
database: SELECT status, moderation_state, moderation_reason, moderated_by FROM meal WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002' -> PUBLISHED, HIDDEN, the typed reason, FX-STAFF-OPS id; after restore VISIBLE with NULL reason (DB constraint meal_hidden_reason_ck).

SELECT action, permission, outcome, reason, details FROM audit_event WHERE object_type = 'meal' AND object_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002' -> two meal.moderation rows (content.moderate, ALLOWED) with details action HIDE / RESTORE and kitchenId.

unverified: The original catalog mentions 're-open permitted review' and a 'reported kitchen'; the code has neither a report-a-kitchen feature nor a re-open workflow: only hide/restore of a meal and of a review exist.

cases.title: Support staff work a customer's case: internal notes stay hidden from the customer, public replies reach them, and every staff view is audited
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-SUPPORT (PROVISION): staff account with exactly one active grant, support.case. Provision as FX-STAFF-OPS (one INSERT into user_grant with permission 'support.case' after the first sign-in, or POST /api/v1/ops/staff/{userId}/grants by FX-STAFF-ADMIN with MFA).

FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION): finance staff with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs (for example finance.read, finance.verify).

FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
FX-CUST-A owns at least one order (for example an order placed in E2E-COOK-050); note its public order number <N>. Cases may be opened on any own order.
The customer-web screen is 'My account' > 'Support' > 'Get help with an order'. No staff second factor is needed for support.case.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-CUST-A: https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'My account' (ar 'حسابي') > 'Support' > 'Get help with an order' (ar 'طلب مساعدة بخصوص طلب'): Order = <N>, Problem type = 'Quality' (ar 'الجودة'), Describe the problem = 'الأكل وصل بارد جدًا - اختبار الدعم' and send. Note the reference 'CS-XXXXXXXX'.
FX-STAFF-SUPPORT: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'Support' (ar 'الدعم') > filter 'Active' (ar 'النشطة'). Click the reference.
In the reply box labelled 'Internal note' (ar 'ملاحظة داخلية', the default) type 'تم التواصل مع المطبخ وجارٍ التحقق' and click 'Send' (ar 'إرسال').
FX-CUST-A: reload the case on the customer web.
FX-STAFF-SUPPORT: switch the toggle to 'Message to customer' (ar 'رسالة للعميل'), type 'نعتذر عن التأخير وسنتابع مع المطبخ' and click 'Send'.
FX-CUST-A: reload the case.
FX-STAFF-SUPPORT: click 'Assign to me' (ar 'إسناد إليّ'); then filter 'Assigned to me' (ar 'المسندة إليّ').
FX-STAFF-FINANCE (no support.case): console GET /api/v1/ops/cases and GET /api/v1/ops/cases/<caseId>.
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

ui: Step 2: queue row: badge 'Normal' (ar 'عادي'), 'CS-XXXXXXXX', 'Quality' (ar 'الجودة'), the order number, 'Open' (ar 'مفتوح'), 'Respond by <time 24 h after creation>'.
Step 2: detail card heading 'CS-XXXXXXXX - Quality - Open'; the description 'الأكل وصل بارد جدًا - اختبار الدعم' is shown.
Step 3: the case state in the heading changes to 'In progress' (ar 'قيد المعالجة'); the note is highlighted as an internal note.
Step 4: the customer sees NO trace of the internal note and the case is not marked answered.
Step 6: the customer sees exactly one staff message, 'نعتذر عن التأخير وسنتابع مع المطبخ'.
Step 7: the case appears under 'Assigned to me'.
api: Step 2: GET /api/v1/ops/cases/{caseId} -> 200 StaffSupportCase with severity 'NORMAL', slaDueAt = createdAt + 24 h, firstResponseAt null.
Step 3: POST /api/v1/ops/cases/{id}/messages {body, visibility:'STAFF_ONLY'} with Idempotency-Key -> 201; firstResponseAt stays null (an internal note is not a response).
Step 4: GET /api/v1/support/cases/{id} (customer) -> messages do not contain the internal note.
Step 5: visibility 'PUBLIC' -> 201; the case's firstResponseAt is now set and overdue false.
Step 8: both calls -> 403 FORBIDDEN.
database: SELECT visibility, author_role FROM case_message WHERE case_id = <id> ORDER BY created_at -> customer PUBLIC (opening description is on support_case), one STAFF_ONLY and one PUBLIC staff message.
SELECT state, assignee_id, first_response_at, sla_due_at - created_at FROM support_case WHERE reference = 'CS-XXXXXXXX' -> IN_PROGRESS, FX-STAFF-SUPPORT id, set, 24:00:00.

SELECT action, permission, outcome FROM audit_event WHERE object_type = 'support_case' AND object_id = '<id>' -> access.support_case (one per staff view of the detail), case.message x2 (details.visibility STAFF_ONLY / PUBLIC), case.update (assigned); no message text in the audit row.

unverified: The original case 'inspect private fields' has no counterpart: the staff case view shows customerId and the description but no customer phone or address; contact is shown only in the order monitoring view while the order is active.
docs/product/06-permissions.md says support staff see 'assigned/authorized' cases, but the queue returns all cases to every support.case holder (SupportService.queue has no assignment filter).

cases.title: A customer cannot make themselves staff: role fields, staff endpoints, forged tokens and grant requests are all refused server-side
prerequisites: FX-CUST-A (EXISTS, preview-customer-1, subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-000000000c01) holds no staff grant: SELECT count(*) FROM user_grant WHERE user_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' -> 0.
Record t0 = current time. All calls are made from the DevTools console of the signed-in customer tab (https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) with the helper (cookie session, XSRF header).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-CUST-A: define the helper (change the page origin: run it in the console of https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>), then await x('GET','/api/v1/me') and keep body.version.
steps.data: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Try to set a role through the profile: await x('PATCH','/api/v1/me',{expectedVersion:<version>,role:'ADMIN'})
Ask for a staff grant for yourself: await x('POST','/api/v1/ops/staff/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001/grants',{permission:'staff.grant',reason:'please make me admin'})

Call staff endpoints: GET /api/v1/ops/staff, GET /api/v1/ops/audit, GET /api/v1/ops/cooks, GET /api/v1/ops/orders, POST /api/v1/ops/cooks/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/decision {decision:'START_REVIEW',revision:1,expectedVersion:0}.

Send a forged unsigned bearer token with a role claim and no cookies, built in the browser console: const b=o=>btoa(JSON.stringify(o)).replace(/=/g,''); fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/staff',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+b({alg:'none'})+'.'+b({sub:'x',roles:['ADMIN']})+'.'}}).then(r=>r.status)
steps.data: Header = {"alg":"none"}, payload = {"sub":"x","roles":["ADMIN"]}, empty signature.

steps.action: Open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> in the same browser.

ui: Step 6: the page shows 'This account has no approved kitchen yet.' (ar 'لا يوجد مطبخ معتمد لهذا الحساب بعد.') and no navigation tabs.
api: Step 2: 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST (the strict request schema rejects the unknown field 'role').
Step 3: 403 FORBIDDEN.
Step 4: every call -> 403 FORBIDDEN, no data.
Step 5: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.
database: SELECT count(*) FROM user_grant WHERE user_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' -> 0.

SELECT action, outcome, reason FROM audit_event WHERE actor_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' AND occurred_at > '<t0>' AND outcome = 'DENIED' -> rows 'denied POST /api/v1/ops/staff/<id>/grants', 'denied GET /api/v1/ops/staff', 'denied GET /api/v1/ops/audit', ... all reason FORBIDDEN (step 5 writes nothing: no authenticated actor).

unverified: The unsigned-token request is sent cross-origin with an Authorization header; if the browser blocks it before sending (CORS preflight), repeat it with curl from the tester's machine.

cases.title: Granting a permission needs fresh MFA, a reason and is audited with actor, time, target and request id and no secrets
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (seed-owner-e2e.sql): staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset; used as grantor AND revoker in its own browser profile with a recent MFA proof, because preview-ops-* accounts stay password-only (docs/security/mfa-policy.md:35) and FX-STAFF-OPS has no staff.grant.

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

FX-STAFF-OPS does not hold finance.read yet (check: SELECT count(*) FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<FX-STAFF-OPS subject>' AND g.permission = 'finance.read' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL -> 0).
The audit trail has no screen in the ops web; it is read through the API in the same browser (GET request, cookie session of the administrator).

cases.title: The last administrator's staff.grant cannot be revoked, even by themself
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-ADMIN (EXISTS) = preview-ops-1, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1: made the first staff administrator by STAFF_BOOTSTRAP_SUBJECT; holds exactly staff.grant and audit.read (GrantService.bootstrapAdministratorIfNone) and nothing else. Verify: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1 -> audit.read, staff.grant.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. cases.title: Two sessions edit the same zone fee from the same version: the first saves, the second gets a version conflict and a refreshed form
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (PROVISION): second administrator with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset. Not in seed-preview.sql. For E2E-OPS-102 first grant it content.moderate.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

Zone 'Test zone B' (ar 'منطقة تجريبية ب', id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a002) has delivery fee 45.00 EGP and is active (devdata). Note its version: GET /api/v1/ops/configuration -> zones[].version.

Two separate browser profiles (A and B), both signed in as FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, with a fresh MFA proof (younger than 10 minutes) in each so no step-up interrupts the sequence. Policy edits are API-only (the screen offers zones and the ordering switch).

steps.action: Profile A and B: open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'Operating configuration' (ar 'الإعدادات التشغيلية'). Both show the card 'Test zone B - 45.00' with 'Delivery fee (EGP)' = 45.00.
Profile A: set 'Delivery fee (EGP)' to 46.00, 'Reason for change' (ar 'سبب التغيير') = 'اختبار تعارض الإصدار 1', click 'Save' (ar 'حفظ').
Profile B (still showing 45.00, stale version): set 47.00, reason 'اختبار تعارض الإصدار 2', click 'Save'.
Profile B: read the form after the refresh and the 'Change log' (ar 'سجل التغييرات').
Restore: in profile B set 45.00 with reason 'استعادة الرسوم' and Save.

ui: Step 2: the zone heading becomes 'Test zone B - 46.00' and the change log shows '<time> - zone:<id> v<N+1> - اختبار تعارض الإصدار 1'.
Step 3: the notice 'The data changed. Refreshed; please try again.' (ar errors.VERSION_CONFLICT) appears, the form reloads with 46.00 (NOT 47.00).
Step 4: the change log contains exactly one new entry for the pair of attempts.
api: Step 2: POST /api/v1/ops/configuration/zone%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a002/versions {value:{active:true,deliveryFeeMinor:4600},reason,expectedVersion:N} -> 200 {key, version:N+1, value, reason, actorId}.
Step 3: same call with expectedVersion N -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT; nothing changes.
database: SELECT delivery_fee_minor, version FROM service_zone WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a002' -> 4600 / N+1 after step 3; 4500 / N+2 after step 5.

SELECT config_key, resulting_version, value, reason, actor_id FROM config_change WHERE config_key = 'zone:00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a002' ORDER BY created_at -> one row per successful save only; the conflicting attempt left no row (and config_change is append-only).
SELECT outcome FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'config.change' AND object_id = 'zone:00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a002' -> ALLOWED rows only for the two successful saves.

unverified: The original catalog text 'both edit policy using expectedVersion=v' cannot be done in the UI; the commerce policy is changed only through the API (see E2E-OPS-107). Zone fee was used because the screen supports it.
service_zone has columns delivery_fee_minor and version (names taken from ZoneAdministration usage and devdata, not from the migration file V3).

cases.title: The public operations URL serves only the sign-in page; every protected call without a session is refused and writes no data
prerequisites: The ops and api hosts are reachable from the tester's network (the preview proxy allows only STAFF_ALLOWED_IPS for these hosts: check from an allowed address first). A shell with curl. Record t0.
No cookies in the browser profile / curl (private window).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-GUEST: open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> in a private window.

Run: for p in /api/v1/ops/staff /api/v1/ops/audit '/api/v1/ops/orders?limit=1' /api/v1/ops/cases /api/v1/ops/configuration /api/v1/cook/dashboard /api/v1/me; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}\n" https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>$p; done

Run: curl -s -i -X POST https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/cooks/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/decision -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"decision":"APPROVE","revision":1,"expectedVersion":0,"reason":"no session"}' and the same for /api/v1/ops/staff/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/grants.

Run: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public and https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=1 and https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/actuator/prometheus.
In the page of step 1 press 'Sign in' (ar 'تسجيل الدخول').

Sign in as FX-CUST-A, then press 'Sign out' (ar 'تسجيل الخروج'), then in a console of https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> run fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/staff',{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.status).

ui: Step 1: the title 'Cook workspace - Matbakhy' style (ar 'مساحة الطاهي'), the slogan, the text 'Sign in to manage your kitchen.' (ar 'سجّل الدخول لإدارة مطبخك.') and a 'Sign in' button; NO tabs, NO data, no error card; footer 'API: https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'. The demo notice 'Demo environment' (ar 'بيئة تجريبية') is shown on the preview.
Step 5: the browser goes to https://id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/realms/matbakhy/... (login form).
Step 6: after sign-out the page is back to the sign-in view.
api: Step 2: every protected path prints 401 (body {code:'UNAUTHENTICATED'}); /api/v1/me also 401.
Step 3: 401 or 403 (a request without session and CSRF token is refused by the CSRF/authentication layer); never 2xx; no state change.
Step 4: configuration/public 200 and meals 200 (public reads); /actuator/prometheus is NOT served on the public host (404/403).
Step 6: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED after logout.
database: SELECT count(*) FROM audit_event WHERE occurred_at > '<t0>' AND actor_id IS NULL AND action LIKE 'denied%' -> 0 (anonymous refusals are not audited); SELECT count(*) FROM cook_application WHERE state <> 'SUBMITTED' AND updated_at > '<t0>' -> 0; user_grant unchanged.

unverified: Status of anonymous POST (step 3) - 401 vs 403 - depends on whether the CSRF filter or the authentication entry point fires first; the case accepts either.
/actuator/prometheus exposure: docs say only /actuator/health is exposed and the proxy does not route actuator; the precise status is not asserted.

cases.title: A meal cannot be published without a complete allergen declaration, price, and approved photo; each missing field is named
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

The ops web 'New meal' form cannot express every case below (it only offers 'None declared' / 'Unknown' allergens and always sends a declaration), so this case uses the API from the signed-in browser.
An APPROVED meal photo owned by FX-COOK-A: use the upload id created in E2E-COOK-051 step 4 (SELECT id FROM media_asset WHERE owner_id = <cook id> AND purpose = 'MEAL_PHOTO' AND state = 'APPROVED').

steps.action: Sign in to https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> as FX-COOK-A and define the helper in the console.
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Create a draft with NO allergen declaration and no photo: await x('POST','/api/v1/cook/meals',{titleAr:'طبق بلا بيان',descriptionAr:'وصف كافٍ للاختبار',portionAr:'علبة',ingredientsAr:'مكونات الاختبار',priceMinor:5000})
steps.data: Keep body.id and body.version.

steps.action: Publish it: await x('POST','/api/v1/cook/meals/<id>/publication',{action:'PUBLISH',expectedVersion:<version>})
Patch the draft to CONTAINS without codes: await x('PATCH','/api/v1/cook/meals/<id>',{allergenDeclaration:'CONTAINS',expectedVersion:<version>})
Patch NONE_DECLARED together with codes: x('PATCH',...,{allergenDeclaration:'NONE_DECLARED',allergenCodes:['MILK'],expectedVersion:<version>})

Patch a valid declaration and the approved photo: x('PATCH',...,{allergenDeclaration:'CONTAINS',allergenCodes:['GLUTEN','MILK'],photos:[{mediaId:'<approved upload id>'}],expectedVersion:<version>}) then publish again.
Anonymously open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the dish page of the new meal (title 'طبق بلا بيان').
Send a PATCH with a photo id that belongs to another account or to a PDF document upload (use a random UUID if none is available): photos:[{mediaId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000dead'}].

ui: Step 7: the customer dish page lists the allergens 'Contains: Gluten, Milk' (ar from allergenNames); before step 6 the dish is not findable at all.
api: Step 2: 201, status 'DRAFT' (incomplete drafts are allowed).
Step 3: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED, fieldErrors include {field:'allergenDeclaration', code:'REQUIRED'} and {field:'photos', code:'APPROVED_PHOTO_REQUIRED'} (priceMinor is present so it is not listed).
Step 4: 422 with {field:'allergenCodes', code:'REQUIRED_FOR_CONTAINS'}.
Step 5: 422 with {field:'allergenCodes', code:'ONLY_WITH_CONTAINS'}.
Step 6: PATCH 200 (revision +1); publish 200 status 'PUBLISHED'.
Step 7: GET /api/v1/meals/{id} -> 200 allergenCodes ['GLUTEN','MILK'], allergenStatement ''.
Step 8: 422 with {field:'photos', code:'PHOTO_NOT_APPROVED'}.
database: SELECT status, allergen_declaration, allergen_codes, revision FROM meal WHERE title_ar = 'طبق بلا بيان' -> DRAFT with allergen_declaration NULL until step 6, then PUBLISHED, CONTAINS, {GLUTEN,MILK}.
SELECT revision, snapshot->>'allergenDeclaration' FROM meal_revision WHERE meal_id = <id> ORDER BY revision -> one new immutable row per successful content change.

unverified: The exact set of fieldErrors for step 3 (e.g. whether titleEn is reported) follows MealService.validate; titleEn is not required, descriptions in English are not required.

cases.title: Meal photo upload tickets refuse wrong types, oversize files and spoofed content
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
Three synthetic files: (a) a real PNG 400x400 px named ok.png; (b) a text file renamed spoof.png whose bytes are not an image; (c) the claim of 9 MiB size (no file needed for the ticket step).

Browser console helper from E2E-COOK-048 on the signed-in ops tab; compute sha256 with: Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', await file.arrayBuffer())),b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')

steps.action: Request a ticket with a PDF as meal photo: await x('POST','/api/v1/uploads',{purpose:'MEAL_PHOTO',filename:'a.pdf',contentType:'application/pdf',bytes:1000,sha256:'<64 hex>'})

cases.title: Changing a meal price records price history; description-only edits add no entry; another cook gets 404
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
Meal 'محشي تجريبي' (Preview mahshi, 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002, 180.00 EGP) is PUBLISHED in the seed. Restore its price to 180.00 at the end.

FX-COOK-B (PROVISION by deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql): login owner-e2e-cook-b, re-pointed to the seeded second kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002, 1 meal, one OPEN slot from seed-preview.sql). Verify: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000b1' returns that kitchen, ACTIVE. Never create FX-COOK-B by approving FX-COOK-PENDING: that fixture is consumed only by E2E-COOK-049.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

cases.title: Pausing or archiving a meal removes it from sale without touching history
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
A disposable published meal: the one created in E2E-COOK-051 ('طبق قبول تجريبي 2').

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: Meals > card 'طبق قبول تجريبي 2' > 'Pause' (ar 'إيقاف مؤقت').
FX-GUEST: search the title in https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>.
FX-COOK-A: the card now offers 'Publish' and 'Archive' (ar 'أرشفة'); click 'Publish', then 'Archive'.
FX-COOK-A: try to publish again; FX-GUEST: search again.

ui: Step 1: badge 'Paused' (ar 'متوقف'). Step 3: after Archive the badge is 'Archived' (ar 'مؤرشف') and the card offers no buttons. Step 2 and 4: the dish is not shown to the guest.
api: Step 2: GET /api/v1/meals/{id} -> 404 NOT_FOUND while paused/archived. Archived meal PATCH -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT ('archived meals are read-only').
database: SELECT status, archived_at, version FROM meal WHERE id = <id> -> ARCHIVED, archived_at set; meal_revision rows unchanged (count identical before and after).

cases.title: Slot creation refuses a passed cutoff, overlap, out-of-range numbers and negative or oversized meal capacity
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql
Seeded OPEN slot tomorrow 13:00-14:00 exists (use its date as <D1>). Helper in the console of the signed-in ops tab.
Capacity cannot be reduced in the ops web at all (the Slots screen only opens, pauses and closes a slot), so all payloads are sent with the console helper.

steps.action: Cutoff already passed: POST /api/v1/cook/slots with localDate = today (Cairo), localStart = the current Cairo time + 30 minutes, localEnd = + 90 minutes, maxPortions 5, leadMinutes 120 (cutoff = start - 120 min is in the past).
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Overlap: localDate <D1>, localStart '13:30', localEnd '15:00', maxPortions 5.
Ranges: maxPortions 501; then maxPortions 0; then leadMinutes 20; then leadMinutes 1441 (use a free future interval each time).

FX-CUST-A (seeded, verified phone) places an order for 5 portions of 'كشري تجريبي' in that slot (quantity 5 in the cart; the per-line limit of the synthetic policy is 10), mode Pickup, Cash on receipt.

cases.title: Cook pause and resume work; a pause set by staff cannot be undone by the cook
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm. (steps 4-6 only; steps 1-3 need no staff MFA)
Kitchen A is ACTIVE at the start and is restored at the end.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

Run on a disposable stack (FX-ISOLATED): this case changes shared seeded state (kitchen A operating state / payment recipient / administrator grants); on any shared preview it would disturb other cases. Restoration steps are listed, but the stack is discarded afterwards.

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > Settings (ar 'الإعدادات'). Click 'Pause new sales' (ar 'إيقاف البيع مؤقتًا').
Click 'Resume sales' (ar 'استئناف البيع').
Click 'Pause new sales' again and leave the kitchen paused by the cook.

FX-STAFF-OPS: 'Cook applications' > 'Approved' > 'مطبخ المعاينة' > reason 'مراجعة جودة' > 'Suspend' (allowed from PAUSED). If the session has no MFA proof younger than 10 minutes the action answers 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED and the screen shows 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' (ar: 'هذا الإجراء يتطلب تحققًا إضافيًا (MFA).') with a button 'Verify again' (ar: 'إعادة التحقق'); press it, enter the TOTP code from the authenticator app (first time: scan the QR code to enrol), then repeat the action.
FX-STAFF-OPS: press 'Restore' with reason 'انتهت المراجعة', then 'Pause' with reason 'إيقاف إداري مؤقت'.
steps.data: Now the kitchen is paused BY STAFF (restore first so it is ACTIVE, then pause).

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: reload Settings. Then in the console (helper as in E2E-COOK-048) run: await x('PATCH','/api/v1/cook/settings',{paused:false,expectedVersion:<kitchen.version from GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard>})
steps.data: Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: FX-STAFF-OPS: 'Restore' with reason 'انتهى الإيقاف'.

ui: Step 1: Settings heading 'Paused' (ar 'متوقف مؤقتًا') and the button 'Resume sales' appears.
Step 2: heading 'Active' (ar 'نشط') and 'Pause new sales' returns.
Step 5-6: heading 'Paused', the text 'Paused by operations; you cannot resume it.' (ar 'أوقفته الإدارة مؤقتًا؛ لا يمكنك استئنافه.') and NO 'Resume sales' button.
api: Step 1-3: PATCH /api/v1/cook/settings {paused:true|false,expectedVersion} -> 200 operatingState 'PAUSED' / 'ACTIVE', pausedBy 'COOK' while paused.
Step 6: PATCH {paused:false} -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fieldErrors [{field:'operatingState', code:'PAUSED'}]; state remains PAUSED.
Customer side while paused: POST /api/v1/quotes for kitchen A -> 409 KITCHEN_UNAVAILABLE; GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 -> 404.
database: SELECT operating_state, paused_by FROM kitchen WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' -> PAUSED/COOK (step 3), PAUSED/STAFF (step 5), ACTIVE/NULL (end).
audit_event: kitchen.settings rows by the cook (details.operatingState) and kitchen.operating_state rows by staff (ALLOWED, with from/to).

unverified: Whether state SUSPENDED -> PAUSED staff transition exists: the code has no such action (PAUSE only from ACTIVE), so step 4 ends in SUSPENDED, not PAUSED; the case therefore restores before pausing.

cases.title: A changed deposit recipient is hidden from customers until finance staff approve it (zero platform fee, direct kitchen account)
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION): finance staff with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs (for example finance.read, finance.verify).

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

Seed state: SELECT deposit_bps, cod_max_total_minor, recipient_method, recipient_identifier, recipient_status FROM kitchen_payment_profile WHERE kitchen_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' -> 5000, NULL, INSTAPAY, demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid, APPROVED (seed-preview.sql, 'approved' by the seeded reviewer row without MFA).

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm. (step 7 only)
Only fake recipient values with the .invalid domain are used; no money moves in the preview.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

Run on a disposable stack (FX-ISOLATED): this case changes shared seeded state (kitchen A operating state / payment recipient / administrator grants); on any shared preview it would disturb other cases. Restoration steps are listed, but the stack is discarded afterwards.

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > Settings > scroll to section 'Payment' (ar 'الدفع'). Read the Deposit (%) field and the status line under 'Account for deposits'.

FX-CUST-A: https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > dish 'كشري تجريبي' > tomorrow's slot > quantity 1 > Add to cart > cart > 'Pickup from the kitchen' > under 'How you pay' choose 'Deposit sent straight to the kitchen' > 'Calculate total'.

FX-COOK-A: change 'Account address or number' to 'demo-kitchen-2@instapay.invalid' and 'Account holder name' to 'Demo kitchen 2 (not a real account)'; leave method InstaPay and Deposit 50; click 'Save' (ar 'حفظ').
FX-CUST-A: in the same cart press 'Calculate total' again with the deposit option selected, then switch to 'Cash on receipt' and press it again.
FX-STAFF-OPS (no finance.verify): console GET /api/v1/ops/payment-recipients.
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: FX-STAFF-FINANCE: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > tab 'Finance' (ar 'المالية'): panel 'Accounts waiting for approval' (ar 'حسابات تنتظر الموافقة') shows the row. Type reason 'قصير' (5 characters) - the button 'Approve account' (ar 'موافقة على الحساب') stays disabled; then type 'تم التحقق من بيانات الحساب التجريبي' and click it. If the session has no MFA proof younger than 10 minutes the action answers 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED and the screen shows 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' (ar: 'هذا الإجراء يتطلب تحققًا إضافيًا (MFA).') with a button 'Verify again' (ar: 'إعادة التحقق'); press it, enter the TOTP code from the authenticator app (first time: scan the QR code to enrol), then repeat the action.
FX-COOK-A: reload Settings. FX-CUST-A: repeat the deposit quote.

ui: Step 1: Deposit (%) 50; status line 'Staff approved this account.' (ar 'تمت موافقة الإدارة على الحساب.'; data-testid recipient-status).
Step 2: the cart shows 'Deposit now: 37.50' and 'Rest on receipt: 37.50' (75.00 EGP x 50%) and 'Send the deposit before <time>.'.
Step 3 right after saving: status line 'Waiting for staff approval; deposits are not offered to customers until then.' (ar 'في انتظار موافقة الإدارة؛ لن يُعرض العربون على العملاء قبلها.').

Step 4: deposit option -> message 'This kitchen does not take deposits at the moment. Choose cash on receipt.' (ar from pay.depositNotOffered); cash on receipt still calculates a total of 75.00 EGP with no platform fee line.

Step 6: 'Approve account' is disabled until the reason has at least 10 characters; after approval the row disappears and the panel says 'No accounts are waiting for approval.' (ar 'لا توجد حسابات تنتظر الموافقة.'); the tab 'Finance' is visible only because FX-STAFF-FINANCE also holds finance.read/refund_approve/settlement.
Step 7: cook status 'Staff approved this account.'; the customer quote shows the deposit again, paid to 'demo-kitchen-2@instapay.invalid'.
api: Step 3: PUT /api/v1/cook/payment-profile {expectedVersion,depositBps:5000,codMaxTotalMinor:null,recipient:{method:'INSTAPAY',identifier,name}} -> 200 with recipientStatus 'NONE'.
Step 4: POST /api/v1/quotes with paymentMethod 'DEPOSIT' -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{field:'paymentMethod', code:'DEPOSIT_NOT_OFFERED'}]; with 'COD' -> 201.
Step 5: GET /api/v1/ops/payment-recipients -> 403 FORBIDDEN (needs finance.verify).

Step 6: POST /api/v1/ops/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/payment-recipient/approval {expectedVersion,reason} -> 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED first, then 200 recipientStatus 'APPROVED'; a reason shorter than 10 characters -> 422 LENGTH_10_500.
database: SELECT recipient_identifier, recipient_status, approved_by, approved_at, version FROM kitchen_payment_profile WHERE kitchen_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' -> NONE with approved_by NULL after step 3; APPROVED, approved_by = FX-STAFF-FINANCE id, approved_at set after step 6.

SELECT action, permission, outcome, reason FROM audit_event WHERE object_type = 'kitchen' AND object_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' AND action LIKE 'payment.%' ORDER BY occurred_at -> payment.profile_update (cook, details recipientChanged true) then payment.recipient_approve (finance.verify, ALLOWED, the typed reason).

unverified: The exact wording of the customer-web options was taken from apps/customer-web/src/i18n.ts; element roles (radio vs select) were not read.

A staff member holding ONLY finance.verify cannot use this screen: the Finance tab is shown only when GET /api/v1/ops/finance/statements answers 404 (App.tsx), which needs finance.read, finance.settlement or finance.refund_approve. See findings.
