cases.title: The cook's free insights count one visit per visitor and day, ignore crawlers, show only the own kitchen and never claim profit
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

FX-COOK-B (PROVISION by deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql): login owner-e2e-cook-b, re-pointed to the seeded second kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002, 1 meal, one OPEN slot from seed-preview.sql). Verify: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000b1' returns that kitchen, ACTIVE. Never create FX-COOK-B by approving FX-COOK-PENDING: that fixture is consumed only by E2E-COOK-049.
A shell with curl on the tester's machine (the activity endpoint needs no cookie or CSRF token), the meal id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001, and the visitor ids below (8-64 characters).
Cairo day boundary: do not run across 00:00 Africa/Cairo.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > tab 'Insights' (ar 'الأداء'). Set From and To (ar 'من' / 'إلى') both to today's date and click 'Show' (ar 'عرض'). Note 'Dish page views' (ar 'مشاهدات صفحات الأطباق') = V0.

Send the same event three times: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/activity -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 e2e' -d '{"visitorId":"e2e-visitor-0001","events":[{"kind":"MEAL_VIEW","subjectId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001"}]}'
steps.data: Three identical requests.

steps.action: Send one event with another visitor: same command with "visitorId":"e2e-visitor-0002".
Send one event as a declared crawler: same command with -H 'User-Agent: ExampleBot/1.0' and "visitorId":"e2e-visitor-0003".

prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED: a disposable Docker stack (deploy/web-preview or scripts/dev.sh) started with PRIVACY_DELETION_GRACE=PT1M so the grace period is one minute; the erasure job runs every 15 minutes (matbakhy.privacy.erasure-job.interval default 15m, @Scheduled fixedDelay), so allow up to 16 minutes. Destructive: the account becomes unusable.

Reload https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and, in its console, run await x('GET','/api/v1/cook/dashboard').

steps.action: Wait at least 16 minutes. As an operator run the read-only SQL listed under database.

ui: Step 1: message 'Deletion request received; the account is disabled.'.
Step 2: the ops web falls back to the signed-out or error state; the API call answers 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED.
api: Step 1: POST /api/v1/me/deletion-requests {confirm:true,policyVersion:'retention-policy-draft'} -> 200. Step 2: 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED. The account is not erased.
database: SELECT status FROM app_user WHERE id = <cook id> -> DELETION_REQUESTED (not DELETED).
SELECT state, legal_hold_reason FROM deletion_request WHERE user_id = <cook id> -> ON_HOLD, COOK_ACCOUNT_REVIEW.
SELECT count(*) FROM kitchen WHERE owner_id = <cook id> -> 1 and display_name, contact_phone still populated (nothing erased).
SELECT outcome, reason FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'account.erasure' AND object_id = '<cook id>' -> DENIED, COOK_ACCOUNT_REVIEW.

cases.title: Request changes, resubmit as revision 2, then reject: history is preserved and no kitchen is ever created
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.
A second SUBMITTED application: use FX-CUST-NEW after E2E-COOK-048 (state SUBMITTED, revision 1). Do not use the account approved in E2E-COOK-049.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: As FX-STAFF-OPS open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'Cook applications' > 'Submitted' > 'مطبخ القبول' (the FX-CUST-NEW application) and click 'Start review'. If the session has no MFA proof younger than 10 minutes the action answers 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED and the screen shows 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' (ar: 'هذا الإجراء يتطلب تحققًا إضافيًا (MFA).') with a button 'Verify again' (ar: 'إعادة التحقق'); press it, enter the TOTP code from the authenticator app (first time: scan the QR code to enrol), then repeat the action.
Type reason 'الصورة الشخصية والعنوان غير واضحين' and click 'Request changes' (ar 'طلب تعديلات').
As FX-CUST-NEW run in the console (helper from E2E-COOK-048): await x('GET','/api/v1/cook/application')
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Run PUT /api/v1/cook/application with publicName:'مطبخ القبول المعدل' and the version from step 3 as expectedVersion, then POST /api/v1/cook/application/submit with the new version.
As FX-STAFF-OPS open 'Cook applications' > 'Submitted' > the application (now 'Revision 2') > 'Start review', then reason 'مرفوض لعدم استيفاء الشروط' > 'Reject' (ar 'رفض').
As FX-CUST-NEW run: await x('PUT','/api/v1/cook/application',{publicName:'محاولة بعد الرفض',expectedVersion:<current version>}) and reload https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>

ui: Step 1-2: the heading changes Submitted > Under review > 'Changes requested' (ar 'مطلوب تعديلات'); no 'Kitchen' card appears.
Step 5: heading 'Rejected' (ar 'مرفوض'); no decision buttons remain.
Step 6: FX-CUST-NEW still sees 'This account has no approved kitchen yet.' and 'Application status: REJECTED'.
api: Step 3: state 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', history[0] = {revision:1, decision:'CHANGES_REQUESTED', decisionReason:'الصورة الشخصية والعنوان غير واضحين'} - the applicant sees the reason but not the reviewer identity.
Step 4: PUT 200 (editable in CHANGES_REQUESTED); submit 200 state SUBMITTED currentRevision 2.
Step 6: PUT -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT (REJECTED is final).
database: SELECT revision, decision, decision_reason, reviewer_id FROM cook_application_revision WHERE application_id = <id> ORDER BY revision -> (1, CHANGES_REQUESTED, ..., staff id), (2, REJECTED, 'مرفوض لعدم استيفاء الشروط', staff id).
SELECT count(*) FROM kitchen WHERE application_id = <id> -> 0.
audit_event: two cook.application.decision START_REVIEW rows and one each for REQUEST_CHANGES and REJECT, all ALLOWED, details.revision 1 / 2.

unverified: Revision immutability (DB trigger cook_revision_guard) is not exercised here because the tester has no write access; it is covered by CookWorkflowIntegrationTest.submitted_revisions_are_immutable_in_the_database.

cases.title: Kitchen settings keep the kitchen serviceable and refuse unapproved zones and stale edits
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

Kitchen A is approved for pickup and delivery to 'Test zone A' (ar 'منطقة تجريبية أ', id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001) only (seed-preview.sql kitchen_zone). Record the original description to restore it.

steps.action: FX-COOK-A: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > Settings. Untick 'Pickup from the kitchen' (ar 'الاستلام من المطبخ') leaving the zone ticked, click 'Save'.

Tick 'Pickup from the kitchen' again, replace the description by 'أكل بيتي تجريبي - تعديل' and Save.
Open Settings in a second browser tab (tab 2), change the description in tab 1 and Save, then change it in tab 2 and Save.

cases.title: An administrator cannot grant themselves a permission; unknown permissions, past expiry and duplicate grants are refused
prerequisites: MFA-gated grants/revokes are done by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B in its own browser profile with a recent MFA proof (preview-ops-* stay password-only, docs/security/mfa-policy.md:35); FX-STAFF-ADMIN is used only for steps without MFA.

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.
Keep the user ids from GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/staff (own id = FX-STAFF-ADMIN's userId).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: 'Staff permissions' > own card > Permission 'finance.verify', Reason 'منح ذاتي - اختبار' > 'Grant'. If the session has no MFA proof younger than 10 minutes the action answers 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED and the screen shows 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' (ar: 'هذا الإجراء يتطلب تحققًا إضافيًا (MFA).') with a button 'Verify again' (ar: 'إعادة التحقق'); press it, enter the TOTP code from the authenticator app (first time: scan the QR code to enrol), then repeat the action.

cases.title: A revoked or expired grant stops working on the very next request; revoking staff.grant is allowed while another administrator remains
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-ADMIN (EXISTS) = preview-ops-1, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1: made the first staff administrator by STAFF_BOOTSTRAP_SUBJECT; holds exactly staff.grant and audit.read (GrantService.bootstrapAdministratorIfNone) and nothing else. Verify: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1 -> audit.read, staff.grant.

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (PROVISION): second administrator with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset. Not in seed-preview.sql. For E2E-OPS-102 first grant it content.moderate.

FX-STAFF-NOGRANT (EXISTS) = preview-ops-2, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f2: staff-style login with no grants. Its app_user row is created at its first sign-in (not in seed-preview.sql); its user id for API calls: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f2'.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

Run on a disposable stack (FX-ISOLATED): this case changes shared seeded state (kitchen A operating state / payment recipient / administrator grants); on any shared preview it would disturb other cases. Restoration steps are listed, but the stack is discarded afterwards.

Revoker/grantor is FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (own browser profile, recent MFA); preview-ops-* stay password-only (docs/security/mfa-policy.md:35). Two administrators hold staff.grant: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B and FX-STAFF-ADMIN. FX-STAFF-OPS holds content.moderate (seed).

steps.action: FX-STAFF-OPS (profile 2): open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, note the tabs ('Catalogue moderation' present) and in the console GET /api/v1/ops/catalogue?limit=1.
steps.data: Helper as in E2E-COOK-048.

steps.action: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (profile 1): 'Staff permissions' > card of FX-STAFF-OPS > click 'Revoke' next to content.moderate with reason 'سحب لاختبار الأثر الفوري' (step-up if asked, then repeat).
FX-STAFF-OPS (no new login): repeat GET /api/v1/ops/catalogue?limit=1, then reload the page.

FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: grant support.case to FX-STAFF-NOGRANT through the console with an expiry three minutes ahead: x('POST','/api/v1/ops/staff/<NOGRANT id>/grants',{permission:'support.case',reason:'اختبار انتهاء الصلاحية',expiresAt:new Date(Date.now()+180000).toISOString()})
FX-STAFF-NOGRANT: GET /api/v1/ops/cases?limit=1 now, and again after 4 minutes.
FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: card of FX-STAFF-ADMIN > 'Revoke' next to staff.grant, reason 'نهاية الاختبار' (allowed: a second administrator, FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B itself, remains).
FX-STAFF-ADMIN (password-only, no MFA needed for reading): reload the page and GET /api/v1/ops/staff.
Restoration: grant staff.grant back to FX-STAFF-ADMIN (reason 'استعادة') and content.moderate back to FX-STAFF-OPS, or discard the isolated stack.
steps.data: Needs a fresh MFA proof.

ui: Step 3: after the reload the tab 'Catalogue moderation' is gone from FX-STAFF-OPS's navigation.
Step 7: after the reload FX-STAFF-ADMIN no longer has the tab 'Staff permissions'.
api: Step 1: 200. Step 3: 403 FORBIDDEN on the next request without re-login (permissions are read from the database per request).
Step 4: 201 with expiresAt set. Step 5: first call 200, call after expiry 403 FORBIDDEN.
Step 6: revocation -> 200 with revokedAt set; Step 7: FX-STAFF-ADMIN's GET /api/v1/ops/staff -> 403.
database: SELECT permission, revoked_at, revoked_by, revoke_reason, expires_at FROM user_grant WHERE user_id IN (<OPS id>, <ADMIN id>, <NOGRANT id>) ORDER BY granted_at -> revoked rows carry revoked_by = FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, the expiry row has expires_at in the past and revoked_at NULL; audit_event staff.revoke ALLOWED rows with the reasons.

unverified: Access tokens/sessions are not invalidated on revoke; the check relies on grants being read per request (GrantService.activePermissions). Whether the web session cache of authorities is refreshed per request was inferred from StaffAccessIntegrationTest.revoked_grant_stops_working_on_the_next_request, not run.

cases.title: Journey end: after a customer's order is completed by the kitchen, operations and finance inspect it - totals, timeline, cash state, zero platform commission and masked contact
prerequisites: FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION): finance staff with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs (for example finance.read, finance.verify).

FX-STAFF-ADMIN (EXISTS) = preview-ops-1, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1: made the first staff administrator by STAFF_BOOTSTRAP_SUBJECT; holds exactly staff.grant and audit.read (GrantService.bootstrapAdministratorIfNone) and nothing else. Verify: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1 -> audit.read, staff.grant.

Seed: kitchen A has an OPEN slot tomorrow 13:00-14:00 with 10 portions of 'كشري تجريبي' (75.00 EGP, 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001); the synthetic commerce policy has tax 0, commission 0, acceptance window 15 minutes. FX-CUST-A has a verified phone.
No staff second factor is needed anywhere in this case (order.ops, finance.read and audit.read are read-only). Steps 1-2 must finish within 15 minutes of placing the order.
Record the order's public number <N> from the customer web.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.
Only these grants are needed: FX-STAFF-OPS order.ops, FX-STAFF-FINANCE finance.read, FX-STAFF-ADMIN audit.read; extra grants from the seed are irrelevant.

steps.action: FX-CUST-A: https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > dish 'كشري تجريبي' (Preview koshari) > tomorrow's 13:00 slot > quantity 2 > 'Add to cart' > cart > 'Pickup from the kitchen' > choose 'Cash on receipt' under 'How you pay' > 'Calculate total' > tick the checkbox 'I accept the terms and the cancellation policy' (ar 'أوافق على الشروط وسياسة الإلغاء'; Place order stays disabled until ticked), click 'Place order'.

cases.title: A reported customer review is hidden with a reason, leaves the public kitchen page, and can be restored
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

Setup S1: a COMPLETED order of FX-CUST-A at kitchen A (produce it with steps 1-2 of E2E-OPS-103). S2: FX-CUST-A rates it on the customer web (order page 'Rate your order', rating 2, comment 'تقييم تجريبي للاختبار', 'Submit review'). S3: FX-CUST-B opens the kitchen page, finds the review and presses 'Report' with reason 'Other' (ar from reportReasons.OTHER).
No staff second factor is needed (content.moderate).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-STAFF-OPS: https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'Catalogue moderation'; scroll to the section 'Customer reviews' (ar 'تقييمات العملاء'); the segmented control shows 'Reported reviews' (ar 'تقييمات تم الإبلاغ عنها') and 'Hidden'.
In the card of the review (stars, 'تقييم تجريبي للاختبار', '1 report(s)') type reason 'محتوى غير مناسب - اختبار' and click 'Hide' (ar 'إخفاء').
Click 'Hidden' in the section and read the card; then FX-GUEST opens https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/reviews.
FX-STAFF-OPS: in 'Hidden' type reason 'تمت المراجعة' and click 'Show' (ar 'إظهار'); FX-GUEST reload the reviews call.

ui: Step 1: the review appears under 'Reported reviews' with badge '1 report(s)' (ar '1 بلاغ'), the report reason, and 'Visible'.
Step 2: it disappears from 'Reported reviews'. Step 3: it appears under 'Hidden' with 'Reason: محتوى غير مناسب - اختبار'.
Step 4: after restore it is visible again on the public page.
api: Step 2: POST /api/v1/ops/reviews/{reviewId}/moderation {visibility:'HIDDEN',reason,expectedVersion} -> 200 visibility 'HIDDEN'.
Step 3: GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/reviews -> the hidden review is absent and the kitchen's rating count excludes it.
Step 4: {visibility:'VISIBLE'} -> 200; repeating a state already set -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT.
database: SELECT visibility, moderation_reason FROM review WHERE order_id = <order id> -> HIDDEN / reason, later VISIBLE / NULL.
SELECT count(*) FROM review_report WHERE review_id = <id> -> 1 (reports are kept, one per reporter).
audit_event action 'review.moderation', permission 'content.moderate', object_type 'review', ALLOWED, reason = typed text (two rows).

unverified: That the queue 'Reported reviews' lists only reviews that have at least one report was read from the API-098 comment in Catalogue.tsx; ReviewService.queue was not read line by line.

FX-STAFF-SUPPORT: open C2. Choose 'Closed' (ar 'مغلق') directly and Save with reason 'محاولة إغلاق'.
On C2 choose 'Resolved', resolution 'Order cancelled' (ar 'تم إلغاء الطلب'), reason 'اختبار' and Save.
On C2 choose 'Resolved' with 'No action' (ar 'لا إجراء'), reason 'لا يوجد إجراء مطلوب', Save; then choose 'Closed', reason 'إغلاق نهائي', Save.

On the closed C2 try to send a message and change state (the form is hidden in the UI, so use the console helper): x('POST','/api/v1/ops/cases/<C2>/messages',{body:'x',visibility:'PUBLIC'}) and x('PATCH','/api/v1/ops/cases/<C2>',{state:'OPEN',expectedVersion:<v>}).
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

ui: Step 1: error 'Check the fields.' (ar 'تحقق من الحقول.'); state unchanged. Step 2: heading shows 'Resolved'.
Step 3: after the customer reply C1 returns to 'Open' in the staff queue (filter 'Active').
Step 4: error 'This action is no longer available. Refreshed.' (ar from errors.STATE_CONFLICT). Step 5: same error text.
Step 6: C2 shows 'Closed' and the reply/update forms disappear.
api: Step 1: PATCH /api/v1/ops/cases/{id} {state:'RESOLVED',resolutionCode:'INFORMATION_PROVIDED',expectedVersion} -> 422 fieldErrors [{field:'reason', code:'REQUIRED'}].
Step 3: customer POST /api/v1/support/cases/{id}/messages -> 201 and the case state returns to 'OPEN' with resolutionCode null.
Step 4: 409 STATE_CONFLICT ('only resolved cases can be closed').
Step 5: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fieldErrors [{field:'resolutionCode', code:'ORDER_NOT_CANCELLED'}].
Step 7: both calls -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT ('case is closed'). A stale expectedVersion -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.
database: SELECT state, resolution_code, resolved_at FROM support_case WHERE id = <C2> -> CLOSED, NO_ACTION, set (DB constraint support_case_resolution_ck: resolved/closed need a resolution_code). audit_event action 'case.update' rows carry details from/to/resolutionCode.

cases.title: A delivery-fee change applies to new quotes only: a quote taken earlier is refused, the placed order keeps its fee, the new quote uses the new fee
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (PROVISION): second administrator with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset. Not in seed-preview.sql. For E2E-OPS-102 first grant it content.moderate.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

FX-COOK-A exists: SELECT k.id, k.operating_state FROM kitchen k JOIN app_user u ON u.id = k.owner_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000a1' returns one row (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, ACTIVE) - created by deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql

'Test zone A' (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001, fee 30.00 EGP) is one of kitchen A's delivery zones. FX-CUST-A has a saved address in Test zone A (customer-web 'My account' > 'My addresses' > 'New address': name 'بيت الاختبار', recipient 'عميل تجريبي', governorate/city/street/building any synthetic text, zone Test zone A).
Step 1 and 3 must happen within the quote lifetime (300 seconds in the synthetic policy).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-CUST-A: add 'كشري تجريبي' (tomorrow's slot, quantity 1), cart > mode 'Delivery' > the saved address > 'Cash on receipt' > 'Calculate total'. Do NOT place the order. Read 'Delivery fee' and 'Total'.
steps.data: Expected delivery fee 30.00, total 105.00.

steps.action: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: 'Operating configuration' > card 'Test zone A' > 'Delivery fee (EGP)' 35.00, reason 'اختبار أثر الرسوم على العروض' > 'Save' (step-up if asked).
FX-CUST-A: click tick 'I accept the terms and the cancellation policy' (ar 'أوافق على الشروط وسياسة الإلغاء'; Place order stays disabled until ticked) and click 'Place order' on the old quote.
FX-CUST-A: click 'Calculate total' again and place the order.
Restore the fee: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B sets Test zone A back to 30.00 with reason 'استعادة الرسوم'.

ui: Step 3: the order is NOT created; the cart shows a price-change notice (data-testid price-change in the customer web) or an error and asks to recalculate.
Step 4: 'Delivery fee 35.00', 'Total 110.00'; the order is placed with these values.
api: Step 3: POST /api/v1/orders with the old quote -> 409, body contains fieldErrors code 'TOTAL_CHANGED' (the delivery-fee change invalidates the quote).
Step 4: POST /api/v1/quotes -> 201 deliveryFee {amountMinor:3500}; POST /api/v1/orders -> 201.
database: SELECT delivery_fee_minor, total_minor FROM customer_order WHERE public_number = '<N>' -> 3500, 11000; any order placed before the change keeps 3000 / 10500.
SELECT config_key, resulting_version FROM config_change WHERE config_key = 'zone:00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001' -> rows for 35.00 and the restore.

unverified: The exact error code word the server returns for the stale quote (the integration test only asserts that the body contains TOTAL_CHANGED); the customer-web's reaction is described by Checkout.tsx's price-change notice, not observed.
Totals assume tax 0 and no extra fees (synthetic policy) - verify on the quote screen.

cases.title: Commerce policy versions: commission must stay zero, a real policy needs an approval reference, scheduled changes are refused, a synthetic version is appended
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (PROVISION): second administrator with the grants of fixtures.json / seed-owner-e2e.sql: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset. Not in seed-preview.sql. For E2E-OPS-102 first grant it content.moderate.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

Active policy: SELECT version, label, synthetic, status, commission_rate_bps FROM commerce_policy WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' -> version >= 1, synthetic true, commission 0. A new synthetic version is irreversible (history is kept) but changes nothing else if the same values are sent.
Console helper on the signed-in ops tab with a fresh MFA proof.

steps.action: GET /api/v1/ops/configuration and keep commercePolicy.version = V.
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: POST /api/v1/ops/configuration/commerce-policy/versions with value {label:'SYNTHETIC e2e policy',synthetic:true,taxRateBps:0,commissionRateBps:100,maxItemQuantity:10,quoteTtlSeconds:300,acceptanceWindowMinutes:15,minAcceptanceMinutes:5,cancellationPolicyVersion:'synthetic-cancel-v1',termsVersion:'synthetic-terms-v1'}, reason 'اختبار العمولة', expectedVersion V.
Same body with commissionRateBps 0 and synthetic:false and no approvalReference.
Same body with synthetic:true, commissionRateBps 0 and effectiveAt '2099-01-01T00:00:00Z'.
Same body with synthetic:true, commissionRateBps 0, no effectiveAt, expectedVersion V-1 (stale).
steps.data: Skip if V = 1 and use V+5 instead.

steps.action: Same body, expectedVersion V, reason 'نسخة تجريبية للاختبار'.
GET /api/v1/ops/configuration again; open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> > 'Operating configuration' and read the policy card.

ui: Step 7: the card 'Current pricing policy v<V+1>' (ar 'سياسة التسعير الحالية') shows the label 'SYNTHETIC e2e policy - Synthetic policy (local only)' (ar 'سياسة تجريبية (محلية فقط)') and 'no platform commission (owner decision D10)' (ar 'بدون عمولة للمنصة (قرار المالك D10)').
api: Step 2: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{field:'value.commissionRateBps', code:'RANGE_0_0'}].
Step 3: 422 [{field:'approvalReference', code:'REQUIRED_FOR_REAL_POLICY'}].
Step 4: 422 [{field:'effectiveAt', code:'SCHEDULED_CHANGES_NOT_SUPPORTED'}].
Step 5: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.
Step 6: 200 {key:'commerce-policy', version:V+1}.
Step 7: commercePolicy.version V+1, status ACTIVE; the previous version appears in policyHistory with status RETIRED.
database: SELECT version, status, synthetic, commission_rate_bps FROM commerce_policy ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 2 -> (V+1, ACTIVE, true, 0), (V, RETIRED, ...); exactly one ACTIVE row.
SELECT count(*) FROM config_change WHERE config_key = 'commerce-policy' -> +1 (only the successful change); audit_event config.change ALLOWED once.

unverified: The approval-reference guard refers to open point O04 (approved commerce policy), an open item rather than a decision id, so it is not listed under refs.decisions.
Stale and approval-guard ordering (which error appears first when several apply) follows ConfigurationService.newPolicy: version check, then synthetic permission, then approval check.

cases.title: Separation of duties: a person who is both a cook and a reviewer cannot decide their own application, operate their own kitchen or approve their own payment account
prerequisites: FX-MULTIROLE (PROVISION): ONE login that owns an APPROVED kitchen (like FX-COOK-B) AND holds active grants cook.review, finance.verify, finance.read. Not in seed. Provision: use FX-COOK-B's account and have FX-STAFF-ADMIN grant the three permissions (MFA). Verify: SELECT permission FROM user_grant WHERE user_id = <id> AND revoked_at IS NULL; SELECT id FROM kitchen WHERE owner_id = <id>.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.
Own ids: application id (SELECT id FROM cook_application WHERE user_id = <id>), kitchen id, current versions.

steps.action: FX-MULTIROLE: open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The tab bar shows both the cook tabs (Home, Orders, ...) and 'Cook applications', 'Finance'.
'Cook applications' > filter 'Approved' (ar 'معتمد') > own application > card 'Kitchen' > reason 'اختبار الفصل بين المهام' > 'Pause' (ar 'إيقاف مؤقت'). Do the MFA step-up if asked, then press again.
Console (helper): x('POST','/api/v1/ops/cooks/<own application id>/decision',{decision:'START_REVIEW',revision:1,expectedVersion:<version>})
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Settings > 'Payment': change 'Account address or number' to 'multirole@instapay.invalid', name 'Multi role (not a real account)', Save. Then 'Finance' > panel 'Accounts waiting for approval' > own row > reason 'محاولة موافقة ذاتية' > 'Approve account'.

ui: Step 2: error 'Not allowed.' (ar 'غير مسموح.' from errors.FORBIDDEN); the kitchen stays 'Active'.
Step 4: error 'Not allowed.' on 'Approve account'; the row stays in the waiting list; the cook's payment status stays 'Waiting for staff approval...'.
api: Step 2: POST /api/v1/ops/kitchens/{ownKitchenId}/operating-state -> 403 FORBIDDEN ('own kitchen').
Step 3: 403 FORBIDDEN ('self review').
Step 4: POST /api/v1/ops/kitchens/{ownKitchenId}/payment-recipient/approval -> 403 FORBIDDEN.
database: SELECT operating_state FROM kitchen WHERE owner_id = <id> -> ACTIVE; SELECT recipient_status FROM kitchen_payment_profile WHERE kitchen_id = <kitchen> -> NONE.

SELECT action, permission, outcome, reason FROM audit_event WHERE actor_id = <id> AND outcome = 'DENIED' ORDER BY occurred_at -> kitchen.operating_state 'staff cannot change the state of their own kitchen'; cook.application.decision 'reviewer cannot decide own application'. (The recipient self-approval refusal writes no dedicated row - see unverified.)

unverified: PaymentService.approveRecipient throws FORBIDDEN for the own kitchen without writing an audit row (no audit.record before the throw); the case asserts the refusal, not an audit entry.
docs/product/06-permissions.md requires 'record when separation of duties could not be achieved'; no code path records that for a solo operator.

cases.title: Application decisions are guarded: START_REVIEW first, current revision and version, reason required, one effect per idempotency key
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Not in seed-preview.sql. Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. PR #9 adds the 'matbakhy browser' step-up flow (deploy/web-preview/identity/matbakhy-realm.preview.json, migrate-mfa.sh) which must also be applied to the RUNNING realm.

A fresh SUBMITTED application (revision 1) from a disposable FX-CUST-NEW (E2E-COOK-048 steps 4-8); the fixture sheet should hold several such accounts. Console helper; every call is made as FX-STAFF-OPS with a fresh MFA proof.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: GET /api/v1/ops/cooks/<id> and note version V and currentRevision 1.
steps.data: Run the helper once in the DevTools console of the signed-in tab https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> (the API is on https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>; the session cookie and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie are set by the API). Helper: const x=(m,p,b)=>fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>'+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-XSRF-TOKEN':decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))||'=').split('=')[1]),'Idempotency-Key':'t-'+crypto.randomUUID()},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined}).then(async r=>({status:r.status,body:await r.json().catch(()=>null)}));  // then: await x('GET','/api/v1/me')

steps.action: Decide APPROVE straight from SUBMITTED: POST /api/v1/ops/cooks/<id>/decision {decision:'APPROVE',revision:1,expectedVersion:V,reason:'اختبار'}
START_REVIEW with a stale version {decision:'START_REVIEW',revision:1,expectedVersion:V+7}; then with revision 2.
START_REVIEW with expectedVersion V and header Idempotency-Key 'key-1' twice (identical body).
Same Idempotency-Key 'key-1' with a different body (decision REJECT).
Now in UNDER_REVIEW: APPROVE without a reason; then with reason 'ab' (2 characters).
In the UI open the application: reason empty and click 'Reject'.

ui: Step 7: error 'Check the fields.' (ar 'تحقق من الحقول.') and the application stays 'Under review'.
api: Step 2: 409 STATE_CONFLICT. Step 3: stale version -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT; revision 2 -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT ('stale revision').
Step 4: both calls return the same body (state UNDER_REVIEW) and version V+1 only once.
Step 5: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Step 6: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{field:'reason', code:'LENGTH_3_1000'}] for both.
database: SELECT state, version FROM cook_application WHERE id = <id> -> UNDER_REVIEW, V+1; SELECT count(*) FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'cook.application.decision' AND object_id = '<id>' AND outcome = 'ALLOWED' -> 1 (the replayed idempotent call wrote no second row).

cases.title: Audit trail reading: permission, filters, cursor paging, clamped limit; reading is itself audited; only the API offers it
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-ADMIN (EXISTS) = preview-ops-1, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1: made the first staff administrator by STAFF_BOOTSTRAP_SUBJECT; holds exactly staff.grant and audit.read (GrantService.bootstrapAdministratorIfNone) and nothing else. Verify: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f1' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1 -> audit.read, staff.grant.

FX-STAFF-NOGRANT (EXISTS) = preview-ops-2, Keycloak subject 7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f2: staff-style login with no grants. Its app_user row is created at its first sign-in (not in seed-preview.sql); its user id for API calls: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE subject = '7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-0000000000f2'.

At least 6 audit rows exist (earlier cases create them). The audit trail has NO screen in apps/operations-web (no file under src/ops reads /api/v1/ops/audit), so the administrator opens JSON URLs in the browser.

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.

steps.action: FX-STAFF-ADMIN: open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/audit?limit=2 and note nextCursor.
Open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/audit?limit=2&cursor=<nextCursor>.
Open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/audit?limit=1000 and count items.
Open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/audit?action=staff.grant&objectType=user&limit=5, then ?action=no.such.action.
Open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/audit?limit=3 once more and then ?action=audit.read&actorId=<admin id>&limit=3.
FX-STAFF-NOGRANT and FX-CUST-A each open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/audit?limit=1 in their own signed-in browser.
Open https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/ops/audit/export?from=2026-01-01&to=2026-12-31.

api: Step 1: 200 {items:[2 rows newest first: occurredAt descending], nextCursor:<string>, hasMore:true}; row fields: id, occurredAt, actorId, action, permission, objectType, objectId, outcome, reason, requestId, details.
Step 2: the next two rows, strictly older, none repeated from step 1.
Step 3: at most 100 items (limit is clamped to 100).
Step 4: the filtered rows all have action 'staff.grant'; an unknown action returns items [] and hasMore false.
Step 5: the second query's rows include audit.read entries written by the earlier calls of this case (reading is audited after the query, so a page never lists its own read).
Step 6: both -> 403 FORBIDDEN.
Step 7: the contract lists API-095 but the endpoint is not implemented (contracts/endpoints.json 'implemented': false): expect 404/405, not a CSV.
database: SELECT count(*) FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'audit.read' AND actor_id = <admin id> AND occurred_at > '<t0>' -> one row per audit call of the administrator in steps 1-5 (details contain only objectType/action/byActor/page flags, never the filter values for object ids).

unverified: The exact HTTP status for the unimplemented export route (404 vs 405 vs 403) was not determined.

prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). ui: Arabic: <html lang=ar dir=rtl>; English: lang=en dir=ltr. Every price is shown with currency EGP (ج.م in Arabic).

cases.title: New customer self-registration through the identity provider
prerequisites: BLOCKED: neither the preview realm nor the local realm allows self-registration, and a new account could not complete the e-mail or phone verification afterwards.

steps.action: Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/ and press 'تسجيل الدخول'; on the identity-provider page look for a registration link.

cases.title: Customer signs in and out; private data and the session are gone after sign-out
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.
FX-CUST-A = Keycloak user 'preview-customer-1' (app_user id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001, phone verified). Fresh browser profile or private window.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

steps.action: Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/ and press 'تسجيل الدخول' (top bar).
steps.data: Browser goes to https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/oauth2/authorization/keycloak?returnTo=... and then to https://id.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/realms/matbakhy login page.

steps.action: Enter username preview-customer-1 and the password from the fixture sheet; submit.
After return to the app, open the account page via the bottom nav 'حسابي', then run in the console: await call('GET','/api/v1/me')
steps.data: Account page headings include 'البيانات الشخصية', 'المفضلة', 'الإشعارات', 'الدعم', 'عناويني', 'طلب حذف الحساب'.

steps.action: Press 'تسجيل الخروج' (top bar).
steps.data: The browser is sent to the identity provider's logout and back; no password prompt is skipped on the next sign-in.

steps.action: After sign-out open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/account, then https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/orders, then press the browser Back button three times.
steps.data: Do this in the same tab.

steps.action: Run in a fresh console after redefining the helper: await call('GET','/api/v1/me'); await call('GET','/api/v1/orders'); await call('GET','/api/v1/me/favorites')

ui: After step 2 the top bar shows 'تسجيل الخروج' instead of 'تسجيل الدخول'; bottom nav shows 'الرئيسية', 'طلباتي', 'حسابي'.
After sign-out the top bar shows 'تسجيل الدخول' again and the bottom nav shows only 'الرئيسية'.

#/account shows only the link 'تسجيل الدخول' (no profile fields). #/orders shows no order number, total or item from FX-CUST-A (by code the list stays on 'جارٍ التحميل…'; record what you actually see).
Pressing Back never restores a page with FX-CUST-A's name, orders, basket or addresses (a restored bfcache page reloads itself).
api: Step 3: GET /api/v1/me -> 200 {displayName:'Preview Customer 1', phoneVerified:true, emailVerified:true, version, capabilities...}; body has no 'roles' or 'permissions' of staff.
Sign-out: POST /api/v1/auth/logout with X-XSRF-TOKEN -> 200/204 and (when the IdP session exists) a body with idpLogoutUrl.
After sign-out: GET /api/v1/me, /api/v1/orders and /api/v1/me/favorites -> 401 with ApiError.code 'UNAUTHENTICATED' and no private data.
database: Read-only: SELECT count(*) FROM spring_session WHERE principal_name='7d3f0a52-1c0e-4b8e-9a3e-000000000c01'; before step 4 >=1, after step 4 = 0 (web session removed). SELECT status FROM app_user WHERE id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' -> ACTIVE (sign-out does not disable the account).

unverified: Keycloak login form field labels (not in this repo).
Where the IdP logout lands (post-logout redirect target not verified here).
spring_session.principal_name equals the OIDC subject (inferred from IdentityIntegrationTest.web_sessions_are_indexed_by_the_provider_subject).

The loading-forever state on #/orders after sign-out is inferred from apps/customer-web/src/shared.tsx:40-43 (401 returns without setting state); if confirmed it contradicts BR-045 'denied state with actionable recovery' and should be logged as a defect.
automated_coverage: apps/customer-web/src/App.test.tsx 'ends the server session with the CSRF token...'

cases.title: Switching from customer A to customer B leaves no trace of A's basket, orders or profile
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.
FX-CUST-A (preview-customer-1) and FX-CUST-B (preview-customer-2) both phone-verified. Same browser profile for both (that is the point).

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.
Cook FX-COOK-A will be needed afterwards only to release stock: A cancels its own order in step 6 so no cook action is required.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+3 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

steps.action: Sign in as preview-customer-1. Open meal 'كشري تجريبي', pick the first slot radio, quantity 1, press 'أضف إلى السلة' (label shows the line total).
steps.data: Message 'تمت الإضافة إلى السلة.'

steps.action: Open السلة (#/checkout). Choose 'استلام من المطبخ', leave 'الدفع عند الاستلام', press 'احسب الإجمالي', tick 'أوافق على الشروط وسياسة الإلغاء', press 'تأكيد الطلب'.
steps.data: Browser moves to #/orders/<A-order-id>. Note the order number MB-1xxxxx and id.

steps.action: Add 'محشي تجريبي' (same slot) to the basket again so the basket is non-empty, then press 'تسجيل الخروج'.
steps.data: No pending-order warning appears because the order was confirmed.

steps.action: In the same window sign in as preview-customer-2. Open #/checkout, #/orders and #/account.
steps.data: Basket shows 'السلة فارغة.'; orders show 'لا توجد طلبات بعد.' (or only B's own); account name field shows 'Preview Customer 2'.

steps.action: With the helper run: await call('GET','/api/v1/orders/<A-order-id>'); await call('GET','/api/v1/orders/by-request/<A-clientRequestId-if-known>')
steps.data: Replace <A-order-id> with the id from step 2 (visible in the URL).

steps.action: Press the browser Back button until the A order page URL is reached again; also inspect DevTools > Application > Local Storage for the app origin.
steps.data: Keys matbakhy.cart and matbakhy.pendingPlacement must not hold A's data.

steps.action: Cleanup: sign out B, sign in A, open the order and press 'إلغاء الطلب' (visible while the state is 'بانتظار قبول المطبخ').
steps.data: State becomes 'ملغي' and the slot stock is released.

ui: Step 4: B sees an empty basket, no A order, B's own name; nothing from A (name 'Preview Customer 1', order number, items) is rendered at any point.
Step 6: Back to A's order URL shows the not-found text 'غير موجود.' (or the sign-in prompt), never A's items.
localStorage matbakhy.cart is absent or empty after A signs out and B signs in.
api: Step 5: GET /api/v1/orders/<A-order-id> as B -> 404 ApiError.code 'NOT_FOUND' (not 403, no A data). GET /api/v1/orders/by-request/<A clientRequestId> as B -> 404.
GET /api/v1/orders as B returns only orders whose customer is B.
database: Read-only: SELECT customer_id, state FROM customer_order WHERE id='<A-order-id>'; customer_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' (A), never B. SELECT count(*) FROM customer_order WHERE customer_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0002' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'; = 0 unless B placed orders itself. After cleanup: stock_allocation rows of the order have state RELEASED.

unverified: Exact wording of the 'not found' state for an order URL of another customer (errors.NOT_FOUND = 'غير موجود.' is verified in i18n.ts; whether the page shows it or the sign-in link depends on session timing).
Order ids are visible only in the URL; the clientRequestId of A is held in A's localStorage until the order is confirmed and then cleared, so step 5 second request is optional.

cases.title: Draft meal and paused kitchen are not browsable or purchasable by customers
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.
FX-COOK-A = 'preview-cook-1' (kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة'). Pausing the kitchen blocks every tester of kitchen 1: announce a 10 minute window and resume at the end.
A tiny PNG file on the tester machine to upload as a photo if a published test meal is wanted (not needed for this case).
Before pausing, capture the koshari slot id: GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 -> nextSlots[0].id (needed by step 6).

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+1 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

steps.action: Open https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, sign in as preview-cook-1, tab 'الأطباق' (Meals), form 'طبق جديد (مسودة)': Arabic name 'مسودة اختبار DR1', English name 'Draft test DR1', price (EGP) 50, portion/ingredients filled, allergens 'لا يوجد ما يُعلن عنه'; press 'إنشاء'. Do NOT press 'نشر'.
steps.data: Meal appears with status badge 'مسودة'. Copy its id from the page/network tab (POST /api/v1/cook/meals response id).

steps.action: In a private window open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/ and search (field 'ابحث عن طبق أو مطبخ') for 'DR1'; then open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/meal/<draft-id> directly.
Console: await (await fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals/<draft-id>')).status; and fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?q=DR1').
In operations web tab 'الإعدادات' (Settings) press 'إيقاف البيع مؤقتًا' (Pause new sales). Note the time.
steps.data: Heading of the state card changes from 'نشط' to 'متوقف مؤقتًا'.

steps.action: Reload https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/ ; open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/kitchen/preview-kitchen ; open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/meal/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 ; then in the console fetch /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and /api/v1/kitchens/preview-kitchen.

While the kitchen is still paused, sign in as preview-customer-1 and run in the console: await call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:1}],slotId:'<koshari slot id captured before pausing>',fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})
steps.data: Capture the slot id BEFORE pausing: GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 -> nextSlots[0].id (do this as a preparation read in step 1 time frame). Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

steps.action: Resume: Settings > button 'استئناف البيع' (English 'Resume sales'), then reload the customer home.
steps.data: Both seeded meals of kitchen 1 reappear.

ui: Step 2: search for DR1 shows 'لا توجد أطباق متاحة لهذا البحث.'; the direct draft URL shows the error line 'غير موجود.' with a retry button; the draft never appears in any list.

Step 5 (kitchen paused): the home list no longer contains 'كشري تجريبي' or 'محشي تجريبي' (only 'ملوخية تجريبية'); #/kitchen/preview-kitchen still opens and shows 'المطبخ مش بياخد طلبات دلوقتي.' and an empty meals section 'لا توجد أطباق متاحة لهذا البحث.'; the direct meal URL shows 'غير موجود.'.
After resume both meals are back in the list.
api: GET /api/v1/meals/<draft-id> -> 404 ApiError.code 'NOT_FOUND'; GET /api/v1/meals?q=DR1 -> 200 items [].
Paused: GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 -> 404 NOT_FOUND; GET /api/v1/kitchens/preview-kitchen -> 200 with available=false.
Step 6: POST /api/v1/quotes for the paused kitchen -> 409 ApiError.code 'KITCHEN_UNAVAILABLE' (no quote row).
database: Read-only: SELECT status FROM meal WHERE id='<draft-id>' -> DRAFT; SELECT operating_state FROM kitchen WHERE id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' -> PAUSED during step 5 and ACTIVE after resume; SELECT count(*) FROM quote WHERE kitchen_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' AND created_at > '<step 6 time>' -> 0.

unverified: Cook meal form field labels other than titleAr/titleEn/price/portion/ingredients/allergens/photo (create requires only draft-valid fields: titles 2-120 chars, descriptions >=10 chars when given).
Whether the meal page shows 'غير موجود.' or another message for a 404 (errors.NOT_FOUND in customer i18n).

guidance.purpose: اختبار حالة النشر وحالة المطبخ من واجهة الطباخ لواجهة العميل

steps.instruction: من ops ادخل preview-cook-1 ثم الأطباق وأنشئ مسودة DR1 بالقيم الأصلية؛ ما تنشرهاش واحفظ معرّفها ومعرّف موعد الكشري قبل الإيقاف.
steps.expected: تظهر مسودة؛ مفيش تغيير في الأكلات المنشورة.

steps.instruction: من نافذة عميل خاصة ابحث DR1 وافتح رابط المسودة المباشر.
steps.expected: المسودة ما تظهرش كأكلة متاحة.

steps.instruction: نفّذ طلبي fetch الأصليين لمعرّف المسودة والبحث.
steps.expected: التفاصيل الخاصة غير متاحة وقائمة البحث ما تحتويش المسودة.

steps.instruction: من إعدادات الطباخ اضغط «إيقاف البيع مؤقتًا» بعد تنسيق استخدام البيئة.
steps.expected: حالة المطبخ تتحول لمتوقف مؤقتًا.

steps.instruction: حدّث قائمة العميل وروابط المطبخ والكشري ونفّذ طلبي API الأصليين.
steps.expected: أكلات المطبخ تختفي؛ صفحة المطبخ نفسها تعرض عدم استقبال طلبات حسب النتائج الأصلية.

steps.instruction: ادخل كعميل ونفّذ طلب quote الأصلي باستخدام الموعد اللي حفظته قبل الإيقاف.
steps.expected: السيرفر يرفض عرض السعر للمطبخ المتوقف؛ راجع كود الخطأ في النتائج الأصلية.

steps.instruction: من إعدادات الطباخ اضغط «استئناف البيع» وحدّث الرئيسية.
steps.expected: أكلات المطبخ ترجع؛ ما توقفش الأكلات المزروعة نفسها لأن صورها ناقصة.

cases.title: A suspended or not-yet-approved cook's kitchen is invisible and unquotable
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.
FX-COOK-B has an APPROVED kitchen with one published meal and an OPEN slot (PROVISION: not in the seed; the seed's second kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' has no login).
FX-COOK-PENDING has a submitted but undecided cook application (no kitchen row).
FX-STAFF-OPS holds the kitchen operating-state permission; staff actions need recent MFA step-up (see the MFA domain cases).
Never suspend FX-COOK-A (shared kitchen).

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

steps.action: Record FX-COOK-B's meal id, kitchen slug and a slot id: GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?q=<COOK-B meal title> and the item's nextSlots[0].id.

In the operations web catalogue/kitchen view open FX-COOK-B's kitchen and use the kitchen action 'إيقاف' (Suspend, in the operations web ops catalogue) with reason 'E2E suspend test' (API: POST /api/v1/ops/kitchens/<kitchenId>/operating-state {action:'SUSPEND',reason:'E2E suspend test',expectedVersion:<current>}).
Reload https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/ , search the meal title, open the kitchen URL #/kitchen/<slug>.
Console: POST /api/v1/quotes with FX-COOK-B's meal, the recorded slot id, fulfillmentMode PICKUP, paymentMethod COD.
steps.data: Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

steps.action: Look up the would-be public address of FX-COOK-PENDING: GET /api/v1/kitchens/<slug guessed from the application name> and GET /api/v1/meals?q=<pending cook name>.
steps.data: A pending application has no kitchen, therefore nothing to find.

steps.action: Restore FX-COOK-B: kitchen action 'استعادة' (Restore) with reason 'E2E restore'.
steps.data: The meal list shows the meal again.

ui: Suspended: the cook's meals are absent from the home list and from search; the kitchen page is still addressable and shows 'المطبخ مش بياخد طلبات دلوقتي.'.
Pending cook: no kitchen page and no meals anywhere.
After RESTORE the meal reappears.
api: Suspended: GET /api/v1/meals/<id> -> 404 NOT_FOUND; GET /api/v1/kitchens/<slug> -> 200 available=false; POST /api/v1/quotes -> 409 'KITCHEN_UNAVAILABLE'.
Pending: GET /api/v1/kitchens/<slug> -> 404 NOT_FOUND.
database: Read-only: SELECT operating_state FROM kitchen WHERE id='<kitchenId>' -> SUSPENDED then ACTIVE; SELECT action, outcome FROM audit_event WHERE resource_id='<kitchenId>' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2 shows the staff suspend/restore entries (verify column names with \d audit_event first).

unverified: Which operations-web screen lists kitchens with the Suspend/Restore buttons (labels kitchenAction PAUSE/SUSPEND/RESTORE = 'إيقاف مؤقت'/'إيقاف'/'استعادة' confirmed in i18n.ts:249; screen not opened).
audit_event column names and the resource key used by operating-state audits.

cases.title: Search, price ceiling, sort and reset return server-side results that match the seed prices
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
No other tester has published additional meals (otherwise adjust counts).

steps.action: Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/ . In the search field 'ابحث عن طبق أو مطبخ' type كشري and press the search button.
steps.data: Query sent: GET /api/v1/meals?limit=50&sort=NEWEST&q=كشري

steps.action: Replace the text with كشرى (ending in ى, alef maqsura) and search again.
steps.data: Arabic letter variants must match.

steps.action: Search Preview mahshi (English words), then search the kitchen name مطبخ تجريبي تاني, then search %.
Clear the search text, press 'تصفية النتائج', set 'أقصى سعر (ج.م)' = 100 and press 'عرض النتائج'.
Open the filters again, set max price 121 -> show; then 200 -> show; then type abc.
steps.data: abc must show the inline error and disable the button.

steps.action: With max price 200 open 'رتّب النتائج' and choose 'الأقل سعرًا', then 'الأعلى سعرًا'.
Choose max price 1 -> show. In the empty state press 'مسح الفلاتر'.
steps.data: Empty state card appears because a filter is active.

ui: Step 1: exactly one card 'كشري تجريبي'. Step 2: same single card (variant spelling matches). Step 3: 'محشي تجريبي' only; then the kitchen-name search returns only 'ملوخية تجريبية'; '%' returns 'لا توجد أطباق متاحة لهذا البحث.' (wildcards are literal).
Max 100: only 'كشري تجريبي' (75.00). Max 121: 'كشري تجريبي' and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (120.25) but not 'محشي تجريبي' (180.00). Max 200: all three.
Input 'abc' shows 'اكتب السعر بالأرقام، زي 150 أو 150.50' and the 'عرض النتائج' button is disabled.
Sort 'الأقل سعرًا': 75.00, 120.25, 180.00 in that order; 'الأعلى سعرًا': 180.00, 120.25, 75.00.
Max 1: empty state with text 'لا توجد أطباق متاحة لهذا البحث.' and the button 'مسح الفلاتر'; pressing it restores all three meals and the NEWEST sort.
api: Each UI change issues a new GET /api/v1/meals with q / maxPriceMinor / sort query parameters (check Network): maxPriceMinor=10000, 12100, 20000, 100; sort=PRICE_ASC / PRICE_DESC. The browser never filters locally.

GET /api/v1/meals?q=%25 -> 200 items []. GET /api/v1/meals?q=<81 characters> -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with fieldErrors[{field:'q',code:'MAX_80'}] (the web input is capped at 80 characters, so test this one in the console).
GET /api/v1/meals?maxPriceMinor=12100 returns items whose price.amountMinor are all <= 12100.
database: none (read-only API); optional: SELECT id, price_minor FROM meal WHERE status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY price_minor to compare with the order shown.

unverified: Exact currency string format for the empty-state price tokens is not asserted; compare numeric digits only.
The web client never sends minPriceMinor, date or slotId: those API filters have no UI (see findings).
automated_coverage: apps/customer-web/src/App.test.tsx 'home follows the approved hierarchy and sends every filter to the server'

cases.title: Zone filter shows only kitchens that deliver to the chosen zone, in dishes and kitchens views
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.

Seed facts: only kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' delivers to 'Test zone A' (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001, fee 3000); no kitchen delivers to 'Test zone B' (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a002, fee 4500); 'Test zone (inactive)' (id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a003) is inactive.

steps.action: Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/ , press 'تصفية النتائج', open the select 'منطقتك' and read all options.
Select 'منطقة تجريبية أ' and press 'عرض النتائج'.
Press 'المطابخ'.
Reopen filters, select 'منطقة تجريبية ب' and press 'عرض النتائج'.
Reopen filters, select 'اختر المنطقة' (empty) and press 'عرض النتائج'.
Console: for each of the three zone ids fetch https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?zoneId=<id> and read items.length.
steps.data: Use the ids from the prerequisites.

ui: Zone options: 'اختر المنطقة', 'منطقة تجريبية أ', 'منطقة تجريبية ب' (the inactive zone is NOT offered).
Zone A: 'كشري تجريبي' and 'محشي تجريبي' only (not 'ملوخية تجريبية'). Kitchens view: one kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' with '2 أكلة في النتائج'.
Zone B: empty state 'لا توجد أطباق متاحة لهذا البحث.'. Cleared zone: all three meals again.
api: GET /api/v1/zones -> 200 items include test-zone-a and test-zone-b and exclude test-zone-off. GET /api/v1/meals?zoneId=00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001 -> 2 items; zoneId=00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a002 -> 0 items; zoneId=00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a003 -> 0 items.
database: Read-only: SELECT zone_id FROM kitchen_zone WHERE kitchen_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' -> only 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001; SELECT count(*) FROM kitchen_zone WHERE kitchen_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002' -> 0.

unverified: Behaviour of zoneId for an inactive zone id (assumed to return no meals; the zone list excludes it).

cases.title: Meal listing paginates with a cursor and rejects out-of-range limits
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.
At least 3 meals visible (seed has exactly 3 when no tester added more). The web client requests limit=50 and offers no 'load more' control, so paging is an API-level check on the preview.

steps.action: Console: const p1=await (await fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=2')).json()
Console: const p2=await (await fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=2&cursor='+encodeURIComponent(p1.nextCursor))).json()
Compare ids of p1.items and p2.items; then request limit=0, limit=101 and cursor=garbage and read status plus body.code.
Request p1 again with sort=PRICE_DESC and page through all pages; list the prices in order.

ui: n/a (API-only case).
api: p1: 2 items, hasMore=true, nextCursor non-null. p2: 1 item, hasMore=false, nextCursor null; p1 and p2 ids are disjoint and together equal the full list.
limit=0 and limit=101 -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors[{field:'limit',code:'RANGE_1_100'}]. cursor=garbage -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (field 'cursor', code expected 'INVALID').
PRICE_DESC pages yield 18000, 12025, 7500 across pages with no duplicate or gap.
database: none

unverified: Exact fieldError for an invalid public-listing cursor (the cook/ops listings use code INVALID; the public DiscoveryService was not read to the end).

cases.title: Delivery to a zone the kitchen does not serve is refused at quote time; pickup still works
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002).
