cases.title: Keyboard-only path: browse, choose slot, add to basket, and the replacement dialog returns focus
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Desktop Chrome or Firefox, mouse not used. Screen reader optional (VoiceOver/NVDA).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+1 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

steps.action: From the home page press Tab repeatedly and note focus order; reach the 'عرض التفاصيل' link of 'كشري تجريبي' and press Enter.
steps.data: Visible focus ring on every stop.

steps.action: On the meal page Tab to the slot radios, select the first with Space/arrow keys, Tab to the quantity group (decrease, number input, increase), press the 'أضف إلى السلة' button with Enter.
steps.data: Message 'تمت الإضافة إلى السلة.' is announced (role=status).

steps.action: Go back to home, open 'ملوخية تجريبية' (other kitchen), choose its slot with the keyboard and press the add button.
steps.data: The replacement dialog opens.

steps.action: Press Tab and observe that initial focus is on 'خليك على سلتك الحالية'; press Escape.
Repeat the add, this time press Enter on 'خليك على سلتك الحالية'.

ui: Dialog: role=alertdialog titled 'تستبدل السلة؟' with text 'سلتك فيها أطباق من مطبخ تاني أو ميعاد تاني. الطلب الواحد من مطبخ واحد وميعاد واحد.'; initial focus on the Keep button; Escape closes it and shows 'سلتك زي ما هي.'; focus returns to the add-to-cart button.
Every control has an accessible name (aria-label/legend); quantity buttons are labelled 'قلّل' / 'زوّد'; the quantity field is labelled 'الكمية'.
api: none
database: none

unverified: Screen-reader announcements and 200 % text-size layout (browser zoom 200 %) are observations to record, not asserted by code.
automated_coverage: apps/customer-web/src/App.test.tsx 'is labelled in English after a language switch and reachable by keyboard'

guidance.title: استخدام لوحة المفاتيح وإرجاع التركيز
guidance.purpose: تصفّح وإضافة للسلة وإلغاء استبدالها من غير ماوس

steps.instruction: من الرئيسية استخدم Tab لعرض التفاصيل للكشري ثم Enter.
steps.expected: تركيز واضح وترتيب تنقل مفهوم.

steps.instruction: اختار الموعد بالمسافة أو الأسهم ومرّ على الكمية ثم أضف بـ Enter.
steps.expected: تظهر رسالة الإضافة مع role=status.

steps.instruction: ارجع وافتح الملوخية واختار موعدها وأضف بلوحة المفاتيح.
steps.expected: يفتح حوار استبدال السلة.

steps.instruction: راجع التركيز الأول على خليك على سلتك الحالية ثم اضغط Escape.
steps.expected: الحوار يقفل ويرجع التركيز لمصدره.

steps.instruction: كرّر الإضافة واضغط Enter على خليك على سلتك الحالية.
steps.expected: السلة القديمة تفضل كما هي والتركيز يرجع.

cases.title: Unverified phone blocks quoting; wrong or repeated codes never verify and are rate limited
prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED stack (destructive to the fixture account). In the shared preview the seeded customers are already verified and a changed number could never be re-verified (the SMS code is not retrievable by testers).

Fixture: make FX-CUST-B unverified in the isolated database: UPDATE app_user SET phone_verified_at=NULL WHERE id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0002'; (or use the staging fixture channel deploy/web-preview/e2e-fixtures/customer_phone_verified.sql in reverse). Basket has koshari x1.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

steps.action: Sign in as preview-customer-2 and open #/checkout with a koshari basket.
steps.data: The checkout form is replaced by the section 'التحقق من رقم الهاتف'.

steps.action: Console: await call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:1}],slotId:'<koshari slot id>',fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})
In 'رقم الموبايل المصري' type +20223456789 (landline) and press 'إرسال الرمز'.
Type +201000000102 and press 'إرسال الرمز'. Immediately press it again.
steps.data: Second press within 60 s.

steps.action: Type the wrong code 000000 and press 'تحقق' five times (use 111111 if the real code happens to be 000000).
steps.data: The real code is not visible to testers; every code you type is wrong.

steps.action: Press 'تحقق' a sixth time.

ui: Step 1: heading 'التحقق من رقم الهاتف', fields 'رقم الموبايل المصري' and, after sending, 'رمز التحقق'.
Step 3: error line 'تحقق من البيانات.' and no code field appears.
Step 4: code field appears after the first press; the second press shows the generic error line (rate limited).
Steps 5-6: first five attempts show 'الرمز غير صحيح.'; the sixth also fails (rate-limited challenge); the account stays unverified and checkout never appears.
api: Step 2: POST /api/v1/quotes -> 409 ApiError.code 'CONTACT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED'.
Step 3: POST /api/v1/me/phone/challenges {phoneE164:'+20223456789'} -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors[{field:'phoneE164',code:'EGYPTIAN_MOBILE'}] (no SMS).
Step 4: first send -> 201 {id, expiresAt (+5 min), resendAvailableAt (+60 s)}; second send within 60 s -> 429 RATE_LIMITED retryable=true.
Steps 5-6: five POST .../verify {code:'000000'} -> 422 VERIFICATION_FAILED each; sixth -> 429 RATE_LIMITED. A 7th request with a correct code would still be refused (challenge locked).
database: Read-only: SELECT attempts, consumed_at FROM phone_challenge WHERE user_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0002' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 -> attempts=5, consumed_at NULL; code_hmac is a 64-hex string (the code itself is never stored). SELECT phone_verified_at FROM app_user WHERE id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0002' -> NULL. Count of phone_challenge rows for the invalid number = 0.

unverified: The UI shows the generic error for a 429 (errors map has no RATE_LIMITED entry -> 'حدث خطأ.' / 'Something went wrong.'); record the exact text.

Completing a successful verification is impossible for a manual tester in every environment: FakePhoneVerificationSender keeps the code in memory only. Use the DB fixture customer_phone_verified.sql to re-verify.

cases.title: Favorites are per customer, idempotent, and flagged unavailable instead of disappearing
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.
Neither customer has favorites at the start (account page section 'المفضلة' empty).

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+1 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.
FX-CUST-A has one PENDING_ACCEPTANCE pickup order (koshari x1, COD) placed in this case's step 1. The notification dispatcher runs in the API (outbox poll); allow up to a minute for inbox rows.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

steps.action: Place a pickup COD order for koshari x1 (see E2E-BASKET-009 steps 1-4 then #/checkout: 'استلام من المطبخ' > 'احسب الإجمالي' > terms checkbox > 'تأكيد الطلب'). Note the order number MB-1xxxxx.
Operations web, tab 'الطلبات': open the order and press 'قبول'.
steps.data: Order moves to ACCEPTED.

steps.action: Account page > 'الإشعارات'. Wait up to 60 s and reload.
Press 'تمت القراءة' on the entry. Reload.
Console: const n=await call('GET','/api/v1/notifications?limit=20'); n; await call('GET','/api/v1/notifications?unreadOnly=true')
Console (B): await call('PUT','/api/v1/notifications/<A notification id>/read')
Cleanup: open the order; if still cancellable use 'إلغاء الطلب', otherwise ask FX-COOK-A to continue/cancel via the cook workflow.

ui: One inbox row: '<date, time> · تم القبول MB-1xxxxx' (the state label, then the order number as a link to #/orders/<id>), initially with a 'تمت القراءة' button; after pressing it the row is greyed and the button disappears.
No row appears for the order placement itself (the placement notification goes to the cook, not the customer).
api: GET /api/v1/notifications -> 200 items[{id,type:'ORDER_ACCEPTED',orderId,params:{orderNumber,state:'ACCEPTED'},createdAt,readAt:null}], newest first; after the read call readAt is set; unreadOnly=true excludes it.
B reading A's notification -> 404 NOT_FOUND (not 200).

cases.title: Only the owner of a COMPLETED order can review it, once; the rating shows on the meal page
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

A COMPLETED pickup order of FX-CUST-A at kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' exists (cook accepted, prepared, marked ready and confirmed handover with the customer's handover code: follow the cook-workflow cases) and has no review yet. Record its id as ORDER.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

steps.action: Console (B): await call('POST','/api/v1/orders/<ORDER>/reviews',{rating:5})
steps.data: Not the owner.

steps.action: Open #/orders/<ORDER>. In 'قيّم طلبك' choose التقييم = 4, comment 'E2E review text', press 'إرسال التقييم'.
Console: await call('POST','/api/v1/orders/<ORDER>/reviews',{rating:5}); await call('POST','/api/v1/orders/<ORDER>/reviews',{rating:6})
Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/meal/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 (signed out) and read the 'التقييمات' section.
Place and leave a PENDING order of A, then call POST /api/v1/orders/<pending id>/reviews {rating:5}.
steps.data: Order not completed.

ui: Step 2: the form is replaced by 'شكرًا على تقييمك.'.
Step 4: summary line '٤٫٠ من 5 (1 تقييم)' (4.0 of 5, 1 review) and the row '★★★★ E2E review text <date>' with no customer name and no order number.
api: Step 1: 404 NOT_FOUND. Step 2: 201. Step 3: first call 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fieldErrors[{field:'orderId',code:'ALREADY_REVIEWED'}]; second call 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (rating must be 1..5). Step 5: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fieldErrors[{field:'state',code:'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE'}].
GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/reviews -> summary.count=1, averageTenths=40 when this is the only visible review.
database: Read-only: SELECT rating, visibility, customer_id FROM review WHERE order_id='<ORDER>'; -> rating 4, VISIBLE, customer_id=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001; exactly one row (UNIQUE order_id).

unverified: Status code for a rating outside 1..5 (assumed 422 VALIDATION_FAILED).
Average rendering: ratingOf uses toLocaleString; exact string in each language not asserted.
automated_coverage: apps/customer-web/src/App.test.tsx 'reviews a completed order once and offers ordering again at a new price'

cases.title: A signed-in customer can report a visible review once, with a reason
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.
A visible review exists on kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (output of E2E-DISC-110); FX-CUST-B is not its author.

Console: const id=(await call('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/reviews')).body.items[0].id; await call('POST','/api/v1/reviews/'+id+'/reports',{reasonCode:'SPAM'})
steps.data: Second report by the same customer.

steps.action: Console: await call('POST','/api/v1/reviews/'+id+'/reports',{reasonCode:'NOPE'})

ui: Step 2: the select is replaced by 'تم الإبلاغ. شكرًا لك.'; the review stays visible to everyone (reports do not hide it).
api: Step 2: POST /api/v1/reviews/{id}/reports -> 204. Step 3: repeat by the same reporter -> 204 again, no second row (ReviewService.report inserts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Step 4: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors[{field:'reasonCode',code:'ALLOWED_NOT_ABOUT_ORDER|OFFENSIVE|OTHER|PRIVATE_INFO|SPAM'}]. More than the hourly cap of reports -> 429 RATE_LIMITED.
database: Read-only: SELECT reason_code FROM review_report WHERE review_id='<id>' AND reporter_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0002'; exactly one row; SELECT visibility FROM review WHERE id='<id>'; -> VISIBLE.

unverified: The hourly report cap (REPORTS_PER_HOUR) value was not read.

cases.title: Organic browsing activity is counted once per visitor per day without any identity
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Private window (new sessionStorage = new anonymous visitor id). Read-only DB access to the preview database.

Product facts (D17, docs/product/10): kinds MEAL_IMPRESSION, MEAL_VIEW, KITCHEN_VIEW, ADD_TO_CART; once per visitor, kind, subject and Cairo day; visitor id kept in sessionStorage only. There is NO consent banner or opt-out in the web app (privacy notice is open item O06).

steps.action: Record DB baseline: SELECT kind, count(*) FROM activity_daily WHERE day=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')::date AND subject_id IN ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001','00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001') GROUP BY kind;
Open the home page (dishes list shows koshari), then open meal 'كشري تجريبي', then pick a slot and press 'أضف إلى السلة'. Wait 3 s.
steps.data: Events are batched after 1 s: DevTools Network shows POST /api/v1/activity {visitorId, events:[...]}.

steps.action: Reload the meal page three times and add the meal to the basket again.
Open #/kitchen/preview-kitchen once.
Re-run the baseline SQL, then run \d activity_daily to list the table columns.

Console: await fetch('https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/activity',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({visitorId:'e2e-bot-visitor-1',events:[{kind:'MEAL_VIEW',subjectId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000999'}]})}).then(r=>r.status)
steps.data: Unknown subject; CSRF may require the X-XSRF-TOKEN header: reuse the helper if the call returns 403.

ui: No cookie banner, consent dialog or tracking-related prompt appears at any point (record as an observation against the pending privacy notice).
api: POST /api/v1/activity -> 202 for the batch, for repeated batches and for an unknown subject (the response never reveals whether an event counted).
database: After steps 2-4 compared with baseline: +1 row each for MEAL_IMPRESSION and MEAL_VIEW and ADD_TO_CART for the koshari id, +1 KITCHEN_VIEW for the kitchen id; reloads and repeated add-to-cart add 0 rows (primary key (day, kind, subject_id, visitor_hash)). Table activity_daily has only day, kind, subject_id, kitchen_id, visitor_hash (32-byte hash): no user id, IP, device or free-text column. No row exists for subject ...0999.

unverified: Whether the anonymous POST needs the XSRF header on the preview (the SPA sends it when the cookie exists).
automated_coverage: apps/customer-web/src/App.test.tsx 'sends one batch for a meal view and an add to cart...'

cases.title: Account deletion request disables the account immediately and is idempotent
prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED stack only; consumes the fixture account (restore with a fresh stack or UPDATE app_user SET status='ACTIVE' and delete the deletion_request row).
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

steps.action: Account page > 'طلب حذف الحساب': without the checkbox the button 'طلب حذف الحساب' is disabled; tick 'أؤكد طلب حذف حسابي' and press the red button.
Read the status text, then reload the page.

Console (before reload if possible): await call('POST','/api/v1/me/deletion-requests',{confirm:false,policyVersion:'retention-policy-draft'}); await call('POST','/api/v1/me/deletion-requests',{confirm:true,policyVersion:'retention-policy-draft'}); await call('GET','/api/v1/me')

ui: After confirmation: 'تم استلام طلب الحذف؛ تم إيقاف الحساب.' is shown; on reload the app treats the user as unavailable (no profile data).
api: confirm:false -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED. confirm:true -> 200 DeletionRequest with the same id when repeated. Subsequent GET /api/v1/me -> 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED with no profile data.
database: Read-only: SELECT status FROM app_user WHERE id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' -> DELETION_REQUESTED; SELECT state, policy_version FROM deletion_request WHERE user_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' -> exactly one row state RECEIVED (partial unique index); order and ledger rows are untouched.

unverified: The policyVersion sent by the web ('retention-policy-draft') is a draft string; the retention policy is not approved (open item O06).
automated_coverage: apps/customer-web/src/App.test.tsx 'shows the account page only when signed in and sends the deletion request...'

cases.title: Basket lines can be added, edited and removed; estimates use integer piastres and survive reload
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.
FX-CUST-A signed in with an empty basket (matbakhy.cart absent in Local Storage; page '#/checkout' shows 'السلة فارغة.').

Slot day for this case: seeded day+1 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

Step 4: quantity 3 -> line ٢٢٥٫٠٠ and estimate ٢٢٥٫٠٠; back to 2 -> ١٥٠٫٠٠. The 'زيادة' button is disabled at the limit (min(10, portions left)); 'تقليل' disabled at 1.

Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

At least two seeded slots for kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (day +1 and day +2) and one for 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني'. FX-CUST-A basket empty.

steps.action: Add 'كشري تجريبي' x1 in the day+1 slot to the basket (as in E2E-BASKET-009).
Open 'ملوخية تجريبية' (other kitchen), select its slot, press 'أضف إلى السلة'.
steps.data: A dialog opens.

steps.action: Press 'خليك على سلتك الحالية'. Open السلة.
Add molokhia again; this time press 'استبدال السلة'. Open السلة.
Empty the basket, add 'كشري تجريبي' x1 in the day+1 slot, then open the same meal and select the DAY+2 slot and press add.
steps.data: Same kitchen, different slot.

steps.action: Press 'استبدال السلة'. Open السلة.
Add 'محشي تجريبي' x1 in the same day+2 slot.
steps.data: Same kitchen and slot.

ui: Steps 2 and 5: role=alertdialog 'تستبدل السلة؟' with text 'سلتك فيها أطباق من مطبخ تاني أو ميعاد تاني. الطلب الواحد من مطبخ واحد وميعاد واحد.' and two buttons 'استبدال السلة' / 'خليك على سلتك الحالية'; nothing is written to the basket before a choice.
Step 3: message 'سلتك زي ما هي.'; the basket still holds only koshari (day+1 slot).
Step 4: message 'تمت الإضافة إلى السلة.'; the basket holds only 'ملوخية تجريبية' with 'المطبخ: مطبخ تجريبي تاني'; koshari is gone.
Step 6: basket holds koshari with the slot pill of day+2 13:00. Step 7: no dialog; two lines in one slot.
api: No server call changes anything; POST /api/v1/activity may send ADD_TO_CART only after a confirmed add (not after 'keep').
database: none (basket is client-side).

unverified: The dialog is rendered inline (role=alertdialog), not as a modal overlay; focus trapping is not implemented in code, only initial focus on 'keep' and focus return.

cases.title: The server refuses quotes that mix kitchens, slots, duplicate lines or meals not offered in the slot
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Place-order console helper (after the base helper): const place=(q,key)=>call('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},{'Idempotency-Key':key||('e2e-'+crypto.randomUUID())}); const quote=(items,slotId,mode='PICKUP',extra={})=>call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items,slotId,fulfillmentMode:mode,paymentMethod:'COD',...extra});

Console variables: const K=(await call('GET','/api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001')).body.nextSlots[0].id (kitchen 1 slot), const M=(await call('GET','/api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003')).body.nextSlots[0].id (kitchen 2 slot).
For step 4 FX-COOK-A creates a slot of kitchen 1 that offers ONLY 'محشي تجريبي' (capacity for koshari left empty).

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+1 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

Slots must start at a time not already used by that kitchen (unique start per kitchen) - use D+4 or a time other than 13:00.

cases.title: Per-line quantity limit comes from the server (10 on the preview) and is enforced at the quote
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Place-order console helper (after the base helper): const place=(q,key)=>call('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},{'Idempotency-Key':key||('e2e-'+crypto.randomUUID())}); const quote=(items,slotId,mode='PICKUP',extra={})=>call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items,slotId,fulfillmentMode:mode,paymentMethod:'COD',...extra});
Limit check: GET /api/v1/configuration/public -> orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine = 10.
Seed slots give koshari exactly 10 portions, so the limit and the stock coincide. To prove the limit is independent of stock, FX-COOK-A creates a slot with koshari capacity 15 (max portions 15).

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+1 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

ui: Step 1-2: the meal page still shows 'متبقٍ ١٠' for the first slot after both quotes. Step 4 for B: after A's order the slot shows 'متبقٍ ٠' and B's placement fails (record the UI text; by code 'حدث خطأ.').
api: Quotes: two 201 responses with different quoteId, each total 75000. A's place -> 201. B's place -> 409 STOCK_CHANGED fieldErrors[{field:'items',code:'INSUFFICIENT_PORTIONS'}] (and no order).
database: Read-only before step 3: SELECT reserved FROM meal_slot WHERE id='<koshari first meal_slot>' -> 0 with two quotes outstanding; after step 3 -> 10; after cleanup -> 0 and stock_allocation state RELEASED. UPDATE on quote is refused by trigger quote_immutable (not testable read-only).

unverified: UI text B sees for STOCK_CHANGED: the customer errors map has no STOCK_CHANGED entry, so 'حدث خطأ.' / 'Something went wrong.' is expected.

cases.fixture_data: Short-lived slot created by FX-COOK-A at now+45 min with lead 30 min (not in the seed). FX-COOK-A creates slots in the operations web (https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, tab 'المواعيد', form 'موعد جديد'): fields التاريخ (date), البداية (start HH:MM), النهاية (end), أقصى عدد حصص, مهلة الطلب (دقائق) (minimum 30), then 'حصص لكل طبق' per published meal; press 'إنشاء' then 'فتح' on the new card. Slots must start at a time not already used by that kitchen (unique start per kitchen) - use D+4 or a time other than 13:00.

steps.action: Create a slot for TODAY (Cairo) starting about 45 minutes from now: date today, البداية = now+45 min rounded to the minute, النهاية = start+60 min, أقصى عدد حصص 5, مهلة الطلب = 30, 'كشري تجريبي' capacity 5; press 'إنشاء' and 'فتح'. Write CUTOFF = start - 30 min.
steps.data: Cutoff is 15 minutes from creation.

steps.action: More than 6 minutes before CUTOFF: console quote 1 koshari for the new slot id (GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001, nextSlots[0] is the earliest).
steps.data: Note acceptanceDeadlinePreview.

steps.action: Between CUTOFF-4:59 and CUTOFF-0:01: quote again for the same slot.
After CUTOFF: reload the koshari meal page; then quote again; then place the quote from step 2 (it is older than 5 minutes by now or has expired at CUTOFF).
In 'المواعيد' read the state of the slot card.

ui: Step 4: the new slot is no longer in the slot list (the earliest slot is the next day's 13:00).
Step 5: the slot card still says 'مفتوح' (no automatic state change); only the cutoff time blocks ordering.
api: Step 2: 201 with acceptanceDeadlinePreview <= CUTOFF.
Step 3: 409 SLOT_CLOSED fieldErrors[{field:'slotId',code:'ACCEPTANCE_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT'}].

Step 4: new quote -> 409 SLOT_CLOSED fieldErrors[{field:'slotId',code:'SLOT_CLOSED'}]; placing the old quote -> 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED (quote expiry is checked before the slot) with no order. GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 nextSlots excludes the slot.

prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

FX-COOK-A publishes a test meal 'اختبار سعر PX1' (English 'Price test PX1') in the operations web: tab 'الأطباق' > form 'طبق جديد (مسودة)': Arabic and English names, السعر (جنيه) = 40, portion, ingredients, allergens 'لا يوجد ما يُعلن عنه', attach any small PNG in 'صورة الطبق', press 'إنشاء', then 'نشر'. A photo is mandatory: the seeded meals have no photo, so editing their price through the cook UI is refused (MealService.update validates published meals as complete: photos APPROVED_PHOTO_REQUIRED). Then create a slot (FX-COOK-A creates slots in the operations web (https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, tab 'المواعيد', form 'موعد جديد'): fields التاريخ (date), البداية (start HH:MM), النهاية (end), أقصى عدد حصص, مهلة الطلب (دقائق) (minimum 30), then 'حصص لكل طبق' per published meal; press 'إنشاء' then 'فتح' on the new card. Slots must start at a time not already used by that kitchen (unique start per kitchen) - use D+4 or a time other than 13:00.) on day+4 at 17:00 with PX1 capacity 5.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

cases.title: Two customers race for the last portion: exactly one order, no oversell
prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED disposable stack (race test; do not run on the shared preview).
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Place-order console helper (after the base helper): const place=(q,key)=>call('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},{'Idempotency-Key':key||('e2e-'+crypto.randomUUID())}); const quote=(items,slotId,mode='PICKUP',extra={})=>call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items,slotId,fulfillmentMode:mode,paymentMethod:'COD',...extra});

Race technique: in each customer's DevTools console define a timer so both fire in the same second: const T=<same epoch milliseconds ~30 s ahead>; setTimeout(async()=>console.log(await place(q)), T-Date.now()). Run it in both consoles before T. Repeat the whole case 3 times with a fresh slot each time.

FX-COOK-A creates slot LAST1: Cairo date D+1 (write the YYYY-MM-DD) at 18:00; LAST2 on D+2 and LAST3 on D+3, also 18:00 (distinct dates because overlapping non-cancelled slots are rejected), أقصى عدد حصص 1, 'كشري تجريبي' capacity 1, then 'فتح'. Copy its id.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).
cases.fixture_data: LAST1..LAST3: slots of kitchen 1 with max 1 portion and koshari capacity 1 (not in the seed).

steps.action: Console (profile A): const qa=(await quote([{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:1}], LAST1)).body
Console (profile B): const qb=(await quote([{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:1}], LAST1)).body
steps.data: Both quotes are accepted because quotes hold no stock.

steps.action: Schedule place(qa) at the common time T (see prerequisites).
Schedule place(qb) at the same T.
Read both console outputs; then open the koshari meal page (any profile) and read the LAST1 slot label.
Repeat steps 1-5 with new slots LAST2 and LAST3, swapping who clicks first.

ui: After each round the LAST slot shows 'متبقٍ ٠' and exactly one of the two customers has a new order in 'طلباتي'.
api: Per round: one response 201 (OrderView with state PENDING_ACCEPTANCE) and one 409 STOCK_CHANGED fieldErrors[{field:'items',code:'INSUFFICIENT_PORTIONS'}]; never two 201 and never a 5xx.
database: Read-only per round: SELECT count(*) FROM customer_order WHERE slot_id='<LAST>' -> 1; SELECT reserved, capacity FROM meal_slot WHERE cook_slot_id='<LAST>' -> 1,1; SELECT reserved, max_portions FROM cook_slot WHERE id='<LAST>' -> 1,1; SELECT sum(quantity) FROM stock_allocation sa JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=sa.order_id WHERE o.slot_id='<LAST>' AND sa.state='RESERVED' -> 1. No negative or over-capacity value (checks cook_slot_capacity_ck / meal_slot_capacity_ck).

unverified: Browser-timer synchronisation is accurate to tens of milliseconds only; the automated 20-customer race is the stronger proof.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. cases.title: A two-line order where one line no longer fits places nothing (all or nothing)
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Place-order console helper (after the base helper): const place=(q,key)=>call('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},{'Idempotency-Key':key||('e2e-'+crypto.randomUUID())}); const quote=(items,slotId,mode='PICKUP',extra={})=>call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items,slotId,fulfillmentMode:mode,paymentMethod:'COD',...extra});

FX-COOK-A creates slot LIM: day+4 at 20:00, أقصى عدد حصص 6, capacity 'كشري تجريبي' 5 and 'محشي تجريبي' 1, then 'فتح' (FX-COOK-A creates slots in the operations web (https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, tab 'المواعيد', form 'موعد جديد'): fields التاريخ (date), البداية (start HH:MM), النهاية (end), أقصى عدد حصص, مهلة الطلب (دقائق) (minimum 30), then 'حصص لكل طبق' per published meal; press 'إنشاء' then 'فتح' on the new card. Slots must start at a time not already used by that kitchen (unique start per kitchen) - use D+4 or a time other than 13:00.). Copy its id.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).
cases.fixture_data: Slot LIM: kitchen 1, day+4 20:00, 6 portions total, koshari 5, mahshi 1 (not in the seed).

steps.action: Add 'كشري تجريبي' x1 and 'محشي تجريبي' x1, both in slot LIM, to the web basket; السلة > 'استلام من المطبخ' > 'احسب الإجمالي'.
Console (B): const qb=(await quote([{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002',quantity:1}], LIM)).body; await place(qb)
steps.data: B takes the last mahshi portion.

steps.action: Tick terms, press 'تأكيد الطلب'.
Reload السلة and read the koshari line; then open the koshari meal page and read the LIM slot label.
Cleanup: cancel B's order.

ui: Step 3: no order page opens; the quote summary disappears and an alert line is shown (by code the generic 'حدث خطأ.' because STOCK_CHANGED has no customer message; record the exact text). The basket still has both lines.
Step 4: the koshari line is unchanged and LIM still offers 'متبقٍ ٥' for koshari.
api: Step 2: 201 for B. Step 3: POST /api/v1/orders -> 409 STOCK_CHANGED fieldErrors[{field:'items',code:'INSUFFICIENT_PORTIONS'}] and no Location header.
database: Read-only after step 3: SELECT reserved FROM meal_slot WHERE meal_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001' AND cook_slot_id='<LIM>' -> 0 (the fitting line was not kept); SELECT reserved FROM cook_slot WHERE id='<LIM>' -> 1 (B only); SELECT count(*) FROM customer_order WHERE customer_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' AND slot_id='<LIM>' -> 0; SELECT count(*) FROM stock_allocation sa JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=sa.order_id WHERE o.customer_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' AND o.slot_id='<LIM>' -> 0; quote of A is still unused (SELECT count(*) FROM customer_order WHERE quote_id='<A quote>' -> 0).

unverified: Exact UI text after a STOCK_CHANGED refusal (see above).

cases.title: Changing fulfilment, address or payment method discards the shown total and the server recalculates
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' offers pickup, delivery to 'Test zone A' (fee 3000) and a 50 % deposit profile (INSTAPAY, demo recipient). FX-CUST-A has no address yet or an old one in Test zone A. Basket: 'كشري تجريبي' x2 (day+1 slot).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+1 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

steps.action: السلة > 'استلام من المطبخ' > 'احسب الإجمالي'. Read the summary.

Press 'توصيل'. Read what happened to the previous summary. Press 'عنوان جديد', fill اسم العنوان = Zone A home, اسم المستلم = Test Recipient, المحافظة = Cairo, المدينة = Test city, الشارع = Test street 2, رقم المبنى = 9, رقم الموبايل المصري = +201000000101, منطقتك = 'منطقة تجريبية أ', 'حفظ العنوان'; select the new address radio; 'احسب الإجمالي'.
Select payment 'عربون يُحوّل للمطبخ مباشرة' (group 'طريقة الدفع'); read that the summary vanished; 'احسب الإجمالي'.
Press '+' on the line to quantity 3 in the basket (top section).
Cleanup: account page > 'عناويني' > 'حذف' for 'Zone A home'.

ui: Step 1 summary: قيمة الأطباق ١٥٠٫٠٠ ج.م · رسوم التوصيل ٠٫٠٠ · الضريبة ٠٫٠٠ · الإجمالي ١٥٠٫٠٠ and the line 'الدفع نقدًا عند الاستلام.'; also 'سياسة تجريبية (بيئة اختبار)'.
Step 2: after pressing 'توصيل' the summary disappears (a new quote is required); the new summary shows رسوم التوصيل ٣٠٫٠٠ and الإجمالي ١٨٠٫٠٠.

Step 3: summary shows 'العربون الآن: ٩٠٫٠٠ ج.م' and 'الباقي عند الاستلام: ٩٠٫٠٠ ج.م', recipient 'إنستاباي: demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid · Demo kitchen (not a real account)' and the note that the platform never holds money.
Step 4: the quote and the form are reset (the order form is re-keyed by the basket contents): a new 'احسب الإجمالي' is required.
api: Three POST /api/v1/quotes responses (201): (subtotal 15000, deliveryFee 0, tax 0, total 15000, method COD); (15000, 3000, 0, 18000, COD); (15000, 3000, 0, 18000, DEPOSIT with payment.deposit.amountMinor=9000 and remainder 9000). Each has a distinct quoteId; the request bodies contain no amounts.
database: Read-only: SELECT fulfillment_mode, payment_method, subtotal_minor, delivery_fee_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, deposit_minor FROM quote WHERE customer_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3 -> (DELIVERY,DEPOSIT,15000,3000,0,18000,9000), (DELIVERY,COD,15000,3000,0,18000,0), (PICKUP,COD,15000,0,0,15000,0); total_minor = subtotal + delivery + tax holds on every row (quote_total_ck).

cases.title: Client-supplied prices, totals and identities are rejected; the order total equals the server quote
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Place-order console helper (after the base helper): const place=(q,key)=>call('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},{'Idempotency-Key':key||('e2e-'+crypto.randomUUID())}); const quote=(items,slotId,mode='PICKUP',extra={})=>call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items,slotId,fulfillmentMode:mode,paymentMethod:'COD',...extra});
K = a seeded kitchen-1 slot id.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

Slot day for this case: seeded day+3 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

steps.action: Forged quote fields, one request each: await call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{total:{amountMinor:1,currency:'EGP'},items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:1}],slotId:K,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP'}); the same with deliveryFee:0; with unitPriceMinor:1; and with an item {mealId,quantity:1,unitPrice:1}.
const q=(await quote([{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:1}], K)).body
steps.data: Valid quote; total 7500.

steps.action: Forged placement fields: await call('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),total:{amountMinor:1,currency:'EGP'},acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},{'Idempotency-Key':'e2e-forge-1'}); the same with state:'COMPLETED' and with customerId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0002'.
Missing key and wrong policy: POST /api/v1/orders without the Idempotency-Key header; then with acceptedPolicyVersions {terms:'old-terms',cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}.
Console (B): await place(q) using A's quote object.
steps.data: Foreign quote.

steps.action: const o=(await place(q)).body; o.total
Cleanup: cancel the order from its page.

ui: After step 6 the order page shows ٧٥٫٠٠ ج.م and state 'بانتظار قبول المطبخ'.
api: Step 1: each request -> 400 ApiError.code 'MALFORMED_REQUEST' (unknown JSON properties rejected). Step 3: each -> 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST. Step 4: missing header -> 400 (record the code); wrong terms -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors[{field:'acceptedPolicyVersions',code:'POLICY_NOT_ACCEPTED'}]. Step 5: 404 NOT_FOUND. Step 6: 201 with total.amountMinor=7500.
database: Read-only: SELECT count(*) FROM quote WHERE customer_id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001' AND created_at > '<case start>' -> 1; SELECT total_minor, customer_id FROM customer_order WHERE quote_id='<q>' -> 7500, 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000b0001 (never B, never 1); exactly one order row.

unverified: Error code for the missing Idempotency-Key header (test asserts status 400 only).

cases.title: One quote can create at most one order, even with a new request reference
prerequisites: Preview reachable: opening https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/configuration/public in a browser returns 200 JSON with environment.name='PREVIEW', environment.demo=true and orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=10.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

Place-order console helper (after the base helper): const place=(q,key)=>call('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},{'Idempotency-Key':key||('e2e-'+crypto.randomUUID())}); const quote=(items,slotId,mode='PICKUP',extra={})=>call('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items,slotId,fulfillmentMode:mode,paymentMethod:'COD',...extra});

Slot day for this case: seeded day+3 slot (13:00 Cairo, 10 koshari / 10 mahshi portions); if its availablePortions is lower than needed, use another seeded day and record it. Cases run in parallel by different testers must use different days.

cases.title: A delivery-fee change after the quote is attributed to the fee, not the kitchen
prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED stack (changes the shared zone fee).
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.

FX-STAFF-ADMIN has config.write and a fresh MFA step-up (staff configuration changes need recent MFA). Current fee of Test zone A = 3000 (service_zone.delivery_fee_minor). A has a saved address in Test zone A and a basket of koshari x1 for delivery.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

steps.action: السلة > 'توصيل' > select the address > 'احسب الإجمالي'. Read the total.

POST /api/v1/ops/configuration/zone:00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001/versions {value:{active:true,deliveryFeeMinor:3500},reason:'E2E fee change',expectedVersion:<zone version>} from the operations web console session (zone version: SELECT version FROM service_zone WHERE id='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001').
Tick terms, press 'تأكيد الطلب'.
Press 'أوافق على الإجمالي الجديد', tick terms, press 'تأكيد الطلب'.
Restore: same call with deliveryFeeMinor 3000 and expectedVersion = the new version.

ui: Step 3: notice 'تغيّر السعر' with the single line 'رسوم التوصيل تغيّرت من ٣٠٫٠٠ ج.م إلى ٣٥٫٠٠ ج.م.' (no sentence blaming the kitchen) and 'الإجمالي كان ١٠٥٫٠٠ ج.م وأصبح ١١٠٫٠٠ ج.م. …'.
Step 4: order total ١١٠٫٠٠ ج.م.
api: Step 2: 200 PolicyVersion for key zone:00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001. Step 3: POST /api/v1/orders -> 409 PRICE_CHANGED fieldErrors[{field:'quoteId',code:'TOTAL_CHANGED'}] (not MEAL_CHANGED). Step 4: 201 with deliveryFee.amountMinor=3500, total.amountMinor=11000.
database: Read-only: SELECT total_minor, delivery_fee_minor FROM customer_order WHERE id='<order>' -> 11000, 3500; SELECT resulting_version, value FROM config_change WHERE config_key='zone:00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2 shows both changes with the reason; an audit_event row 'config.change' exists for each.

unverified: How a tester obtains the staff session for a direct API call (staff web uses the operations web session); the operations web Configuration screen (ops/Configuration.tsx) may offer this change without the console.
Whether zone:{id} changes are permitted for the PREVIEW profile (synthetic-policy restriction applies only to commerce-policy).
automated_coverage: apps/customer-web/src/App.test.tsx 'attributes a delivery-fee-only change to the fee, not the kitchen (English)'

cases.title: A basket line above a lowered per-line limit blocks the quote until reduced
prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED stack (a new commerce policy applies to every user).
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Paste this once in the browser DevTools console of the signed-in app tab (origin https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) to define call(method,path,body,extraHeaders): const API='https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>';const xsrf=()=>decodeURIComponent(document.cookie.split('; ').find(c=>c.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN=')).slice(11));const call=async(m,p,b,h={})=>{const r=await fetch(API+p,{method:m,credentials:'include',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept-Language':'en',...(m==='GET'?{}:{'X-XSRF-TOKEN':xsrf()}),...h},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const t=await r.text();return {status:r.status,body:t?JSON.parse(t):null}}; Each call returns {status, body}. If document.cookie has no XSRF-TOKEN yet, reload the page once and retry.
FX-STAFF-ADMIN has config.write and recent MFA. Current active commerce policy version = 1 (maxItemQuantity 10). The synthetic flag is allowed only in LOCAL/CI profiles. A's basket: 'كشري تجريبي' x8.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

steps.action: Open السلة with koshari x8 and keep the tab open.

POST /api/v1/ops/configuration/commerce-policy/versions {value:{label:'E2E limit 5',synthetic:true,taxRateBps:0,commissionRateBps:0,maxItemQuantity:5,quoteTtlSeconds:300,acceptanceWindowMinutes:15,minAcceptanceMinutes:5,cancellationPolicyVersion:'synthetic-cancel-v1',termsVersion:'synthetic-terms-v1'},reason:'E2E limit test',expectedVersion:1}
Navigate to #/ then back to #/checkout (the limit is re-read when the cart opens). Read the line and the quote button.
Console: await quote([{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:8}], K)
Press 'تقليل الكمية: كشري تجريبي' until 5, then 'احسب الإجمالي'.
Restore with a new version carrying maxItemQuantity 10 (expectedVersion = the active version).

ui: Step 3: the line shows the alert 'أقصى كمية لكل طبق دلوقتي ٥. قلّل الكمية علشان تكمل.' and 'احسب الإجمالي' is disabled; the 'زيادة' button is disabled.
Step 5: at quantity 5 the quote is available and the total is ٣٧٥٫٠٠ ج.م.
api: GET /api/v1/configuration/public -> orderLimits.maxQuantityPerLine=5 after step 2. Step 4: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors[{field:'items.quantity',code:'RANGE_1_TO_5'}]. An unplaced quote made before step 2 fails placement with 409 PRICE_CHANGED (POLICY_CHANGED).
database: Read-only: SELECT version, status, max_item_quantity FROM commerce_policy ORDER BY version -> v1 RETIRED, v2 ACTIVE 5 (then v3 ACTIVE 10 after restore); exactly one ACTIVE row at any time (unique index).

unverified: Staff session mechanics for the direct API call (see BASKET-022).

're-reads the limit when the cart opens, so a policy lowered after the page loaded blocks the quote at once'

cases.title: Native app confirms replacing the basket and shows the price-change notice before placing
prerequisites: Signed device build pointing at the preview; FX-CUST-A signed in on the device (system-browser sign-in). PX1 test meal and slot as in E2E-BASKET-014.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).
