cases.title: Native account switch clears the previous person's basket, pending order and screens
prerequisites: Signed device build of PR #9 (the epoch/ownership guards of accountEpoch and bindShopping exist only there: commits 5e0ce79, 89ec820). Both customers phone-verified.

Seed loaded (deploy/web-preview/seed-preview.sql): GET https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/api/v1/meals?limit=50 contains meals 'كشري تجريبي' (price.amountMinor 7500, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001), 'محشي تجريبي' (18000, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb002) of kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' (slug preview-kitchen, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) and 'ملوخية تجريبية' (12025, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb003) of kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' (slug preview-kitchen-two, id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002). Other testers may have added meals: record the actual list at the start.

Seeded slots are still in the future: the seed created one OPEN slot per kitchen at 13:00 Africa/Cairo on each of the three calendar days after the seed date (20 max portions per slot, 10 per meal, cutoff 11:00 same day). Open GET /api/v1/meals/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001 and confirm nextSlots has at least one entry; if the three days have passed, FX-COOK-A must create new OPEN slots (operations web, tab المواعيد/Slots, form 'موعد جديد'/'New slot', then button 'فتح'/'Open') with 10 portions for each seeded meal before any basket case.
Sign-in password comes from the private fixture sheet (PREVIEW_USER_PASSWORD); never write it into results.

Two or more human actors: use a separate browser profile (or browser) per actor; sessions share cookies per profile, so never sign two actors into one profile at once unless the case says so. Before the case, read GET /api/v1/meals/<id> and check nextSlots[].availablePortions of the slot you will use is at least what the case needs (seed: 10 per meal; preparation consumes stock permanently, so prefer cancelling test orders).

steps.action: Sign in as FX-CUST-A. Add 'كشري تجريبي' x1 to the cart; open Orders and Favorites tabs so they load.
Account tab > 'تبديل الحساب' (Switch account); in the system browser sign in as FX-CUST-B.
Look at Cart, Orders, Favorites and Account (greeting).
With B signed in and an empty cart, kill and relaunch the app; open Cart.
Repeat steps 1-4 on iOS.

ui: After the switch: greeting 'أهلًا Preview Customer 2'; the cart shows 'السلة فارغة.' (never A's koshari line); Orders and Favorites show only B's data; nothing of A is visible at any time, including after relaunch.
api: B's session calls GET /api/v1/orders and /api/v1/me/favorites with B's bearer token only; no request of B carries A's token.
database: Read-only: SELECT customer_id FROM customer_order WHERE created_at > '<case start>' -> none created by this case; A's quotes belong to A.

unverified: Whether the earlier (develop) native build already cleared the cart on switch; the PR #9 hardening concerns late responses and stored pending placements.

cases.title: Placement stores an immutable snapshot, locked prices and reserves capacity in one transaction (pickup, COD)
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.

Record BEFORE placing, from SQL: SELECT cs.reserved, ms.reserved FROM cook_slot cs JOIN meal_slot ms ON ms.cook_slot_id = cs.id WHERE cs.id = '<slot id>' AND ms.meal_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001'; (call these R_slot0 and R_meal0).

steps.action: Customer web: add 2 × 'Preview koshari' (13:00 tomorrow) to the cart, mode 'Pickup from the kitchen', payment 'Cash on receipt', press 'Calculate total'. Read the quote panel, then tick the terms box and press 'Place order' once.
steps.data: slot = items[0] of kitchen A

steps.action: On the order page copy the order id from the URL (#/orders/<uuid>). In the Console run GET /api/v1/orders/<id> and GET /api/v1/orders/<id>/events.
steps.data: api('GET','/api/v1/orders/<id>'), api('GET','/api/v1/orders/<id>/events')

steps.action: Run the read-only SQL listed under expected.database with :'order' = the order id.

ui: Quote panel: Meals 150.00, Delivery fee 0.00, Tax 0.00, Total 150.00, text 'Pay in cash on receipt.', notice 'Synthetic policy (test environment)'. Order page: '<MB-number> · Waiting for the kitchen', '2 × Preview koshari — 150.00', timeline with one line, no handover code, no deposit panel.
api: GET order 200: state PENDING_ACCEPTANCE, version 0 (or the initial version returned by POST), items[0].quantity 2, unitPrice.amountMinor 7500, lineTotal 15000, subtotal 15000, deliveryFee 0, tax 0, total 15000 (currency EGP), cashState DUE, payment.method COD, payment.state NOT_REQUIRED, handoverCode null, contact null, allowedActions ['CANCEL'], acceptBy about 15 minutes after the placement time.
GET events 200: exactly one event {sequence 1, fromState null, toState PENDING_ACCEPTANCE, actorType CUSTOMER}.
database: SELECT state, version, subtotal_minor, delivery_fee_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, commission_bps_snapshot, commission_minor, accept_by, terminal_at FROM customer_order WHERE id = :'order'; -> state PENDING_ACCEPTANCE, total_minor 15000, commission_bps_snapshot 0, commission_minor 0.

SELECT quantity, unit_price_minor, line_total_minor, meal_snapshot->>'titleEn', meal_snapshot->>'priceMinor' FROM order_item WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> one row 2, 7500, 15000, 'Preview koshari', '7500'.

SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> one row RESERVED quantity 2, released_at null. cook_slot.reserved = R_slot0 + 2 and meal_slot.reserved = R_meal0 + 2 (SELECT cs.reserved, cs.allocated, cs.consumed, cs.max_portions FROM cook_slot cs JOIN customer_order o ON o.slot_id = cs.id WHERE o.id = :'order';).

SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> amount_minor 15000 DUE.  SELECT method, state, total_minor, deposit_minor, remainder_minor, deposit_expires_at, version FROM order_payment WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> COD, NOT_REQUIRED, deposit_minor 0, remainder_minor 15000.

SELECT event_type, status FROM outbox_event WHERE aggregate_id = :'order' ORDER BY created_at; -> one ORDER_PLACED row.  SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> one row.

fixture_data.item: kitchen A tomorrow slot capacity (20 total, 10 per meal)

unverified: acceptBy is min(createdAt+15 min, slot cutoff) per QuoteService.terms; the UI does not show acceptBy to the customer, so it is asserted through the API only.

flow.original: Run the read-only SQL listed under expected.database with :'order' = the order id.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Replaying the same placement request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same order and does not reserve twice
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
Generate once in the console: `const K=crypto.randomUUID(), C=crypto.randomUUID();` (Idempotency-Key must match [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}, JdbcIdempotentCommands).

steps.action: Create one quote (2 × koshari, PICKUP, COD) as in conventions.recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2 but do NOT place yet. Record SQL: cook_slot.reserved before (R0).
steps.data: q = quote body

steps.action: POST /api/v1/orders with Idempotency-Key K and body {quoteId:q.quoteId, clientRequestId:C, acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion, cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}}. Save the response as r1.
steps.data: key=K

steps.action: Repeat exactly the same request with the same K (r2), then a third time (r3).
steps.data: identical body and key

steps.action: GET /api/v1/orders?limit=50 and GET /api/v1/orders/by-request/<C>.

ui: Customer web 'My orders' lists the order once (open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>/#/orders).
api: r1.status 201. r2.status and r3.status 201 with the same body.id and same publicNumber as r1 (no new MB- number).
by-request returns 200 with that id; the orders list contains exactly one order with this id.
database: SELECT count(*) FROM customer_order WHERE customer_id = (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE display_name = 'Preview Customer 1') AND client_request_id = '<C>'; -> 1.
SELECT count(*) FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = '<id>'; -> 1 and cook_slot.reserved = R0 + 2 (not R0 + 6).
SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE aggregate_id = '<id>' AND event_type = 'ORDER_PLACED'; -> 1.
SELECT count(*) FROM idempotency_record WHERE command = 'order.place' AND idempotency_key = '<K>'; -> 1 (expires_at >= created_at + 24 h).

unverified: A replay returns the CURRENT view of the order (state may have advanced); this case keeps the order pending so the body is identical.

flow.original: API variant (post-commit loss): in the console place an order with key K and clientRequestId C, ignore the response; then GET /api/v1/orders/by-request/<C>, then POST the identical placement again with K.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Cook accepts a pending order once: reservation becomes allocation, customer gets contact and a notification
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
A PENDING_ACCEPTANCE pickup/COD order O1 of FX-CUST-A exists (create it with conventions.recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2 in the FX-CUST-A console; keep o.body.id and o.body.version).
Acceptance deadline not passed (placed less than 15 minutes ago).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Ops web > 'Orders' > 'Active': locate O1. Before accepting note that no customer name/phone is shown. Press 'Accept'.
Reload the order page of O1.

In the cook console: replay the accept with the SAME Idempotency-Key and expectedVersion (POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<O1>/accept {expectedVersion:v0}); then send accept with a NEW key and the OLD expectedVersion; then with a NEW key and the CURRENT version.
steps.data: v0 = version before accept

steps.action: Run the read-only SQL.

ui: Cook card after Accept: badge 'Accepted', 'Customer: Preview Customer 1 · +201000000101', buttons 'Start preparing' and 'Cancel'. Customer page: '<MB-number> · Accepted', 'Kitchen contact: مطبخ المعاينة · +201000000201 · Pickup location: Synthetic location 1', button 'Request cancellation (reviewed by support)' (no 'Cancel order').
api: Replay with the same key: 200 and the same CookOrderView. New key + old version: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. New key + current version: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fieldErrors [{state,'ACCEPTED'}].
database: SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> RESERVED became ALLOCATED (quantity 2); SELECT cs.reserved, cs.allocated, cs.consumed, cs.max_portions FROM cook_slot cs JOIN customer_order o ON o.slot_id = cs.id WHERE o.id = :'order'; reserved decreased by 2 and allocated increased by 2.

SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> sequence 2: PENDING_ACCEPTANCE→ACCEPTED actor COOK. customer_order.version increased by exactly 1.

SELECT n.type, n.recipient_id, n.params->>'state' AS state, n.read_at FROM notification n WHERE n.order_id = :'order' ORDER BY n.created_at; -> a notification type ORDER_ACCEPTED for the customer with params.state 'ACCEPTED' within about 5-10 s (dispatch poll 5 s).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Cook rejection releases the reservation exactly once and ends the order
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
A PENDING_ACCEPTANCE pickup/COD order O1 of FX-CUST-A exists (create it with conventions.recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2 in the FX-CUST-A console; keep o.body.id and o.body.version).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Orders > 'Active': on O1 choose Reason 'Kitchen busy' (default) and press 'Reject'.
Reload the order page.
Cook console: POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<O1>/reject with a new key, current version and reasonCode 'BAD'; then with a valid reason on the now-terminal order.
steps.data: reasonCode='BAD' then 'OTHER'

steps.action: Run the read-only SQL.

ui: Customer page: '<MB-number> · Rejected by the kitchen', no cancel button; the card disappears from the cook 'Active' list after reload.
api: Invalid reason on a terminal order: 409 STATE_CONFLICT (terminal check precedes the reason check). Invalid reason on a pending order (use a fresh order): 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors reasonCode 'ALLOWED_INGREDIENT_UNAVAILABLE|KITCHEN_BUSY|OTHER|OUTSIDE_CAPACITY'.
database: SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> PENDING_ACCEPTANCE→REJECTED actor COOK reason_code KITCHEN_BUSY.

SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> state RELEASED with released_at set; cook_slot.reserved and meal_slot.reserved back to the pre-order values (released once, never negative).

SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> state NOT_DUE.  SELECT n.type, n.recipient_id, n.params->>'state' AS state, n.read_at FROM notification n WHERE n.order_id = :'order' ORDER BY n.created_at; -> one ORDER_REJECTED notification for the customer (ORDER_REJECTED is a customer event only; the rejecting cook gets none).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Customer cancels a pending order directly; capacity is released once
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
A PENDING_ACCEPTANCE pickup/COD order O1 of FX-CUST-A exists (create it with conventions.recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2 in the FX-CUST-A console; keep o.body.id and o.body.version).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Open the order page of O1 and press 'Cancel order' (ar: إلغاء الطلب).
steps.data: UI sends reasonCode CHANGED_MIND

steps.action: Reload Orders > 'Active'.
Console: cancel again with a new key and the current version.
Run the read-only SQL.

ui: Customer page '<MB-number> · Cancelled', no buttons. Cook 'Active' list no longer contains O1.
api: Second cancel: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{state,'CANCELLED'}].
database: SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> PENDING_ACCEPTANCE→CANCELLED actor CUSTOMER reason_code CHANGED_MIND.
SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> RELEASED once; counters restored.
SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> NOT_DUE.
Notifications: cook (kitchen owner) and customer both receive ORDER_CANCELLED (dedup key type:order per recipient) - SELECT recipient_id, type FROM notification WHERE order_id = :'order';

flow.original: Run the read-only SQL.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Accept racing customer cancel (and expiry): exactly one transition wins, release happens at most once
prerequisites: FX-ISOLATED disposable stack (parallel writes). Never on the shared preview.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
Run 20 iterations; each iteration needs a fresh pending order O (recipe) and its version v.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: For each iteration fire POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<O>/accept {expectedVersion:v} (cook session) and POST /api/v1/orders/<O>/cancel {expectedVersion:v, reasonCode:'CHANGED_MIND'} (customer session) at the same instant (two consoles synchronised by a shared start time or a script with two sessions).
steps.data: same version v

steps.action: After all iterations run infra/db/reconcile.sql and the SQL for each order.

ui: Not applicable.
api: Per iteration exactly one 200 and one 409 (STATE_CONFLICT or VERSION_CONFLICT) carrying the current state; never two 200.
database: Final state ACCEPTED (allocation ALLOCATED) or CANCELLED (allocation RELEASED once); order_event has exactly one transition after sequence 1; reconcile.sql all zero; no negative counters.

Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: An order not accepted by its deadline expires by server time and cannot be accepted afterwards
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
A PENDING_ACCEPTANCE pickup/COD order O1 of FX-CUST-A exists (create it with conventions.recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2 in the FX-CUST-A console; keep o.body.id and o.body.version).

No clock control is available on the preview: the test waits the real acceptance window (about 15 minutes after placement, plus up to 30 s for the expiry job, matbakhy.orders.expiry-job.interval=30s). The disposable stack may shorten it.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Open Orders > 'Active' and note on O1 'Accept by <time> (N min left)'. Do not act.
After the deadline press 'Accept' if the card is still shown, and in the console POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<O1>/accept with current version.
Reload the order page.
Run the read-only SQL.

ui: Before the deadline: 'N min left'; after: 'Deadline passed'. Customer page: '<MB-number> · Not accepted in time'.
api: Accept after the deadline: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fieldErrors [{acceptBy,'DEADLINE_PASSED'}] (job has not run yet) or [{state,'EXPIRED'}] (job ran).
database: SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> PENDING_ACCEPTANCE→EXPIRED actor SYSTEM reason_code ACCEPTANCE_DEADLINE, occurred_at >= accept_by.
SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> RELEASED once.
SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> NOT_DUE.
Notifications ORDER_EXPIRED for both the customer and the kitchen owner.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

ui: After 'Start preparing': customer state 'Preparing', no code. After 'Ready': 'Ready' and 'Handover code (give it to the cook or courier on receipt)' with 6 digits. The cook card never shows the code.
api: Cook JSON has no property 'handoverCode'. FX-CUST-B gets 404 NOT_FOUND. Owner JSON handoverCode matches ^[0-9]{6}$.
database: SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> CONSUMED; SELECT cs.reserved, cs.allocated, cs.consumed, cs.max_portions FROM cook_slot cs JOIN customer_order o ON o.slot_id = cs.id WHERE o.id = :'order'; allocated decreased by 2, consumed increased by 2.

SELECT attempts, expires_at, locked_at, consumed_at, code_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AS hashed FROM handover_challenge WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> attempts 0, hashed true, locked/consumed null, expires_at = slot ends_at + 2 h (16:00 Cairo on the slot day).
SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> ACCEPTED→PREPARING→READY actor COOK.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Five wrong handover codes lock the challenge; the correct code is then refused and the customer's code disappears
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
A READY pickup/COD order O1 (E2E-ORDER-030). Note the true code X from the customer page and choose a wrong code W that differs from X (e.g. 000000).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Type W in 'Customer handover code' and press 'Confirm handover'. Repeat until five attempts were made (watch the response each time in the Network tab).
Now enter the CORRECT code X and press 'Confirm handover'.
Reload the order page.
Run the read-only SQL.

ui: Customer page: state still 'Ready' and the handover code line is NOT shown any more (locked challenge).
api: Attempts 1-4: 422 VERIFICATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{code,'WRONG_CODE'}]. Attempt 5: 422 VERIFICATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{code,'CHALLENGE_LOCKED'}]. Correct code afterwards: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{code,'CHALLENGE_LOCKED'}].
database: SELECT attempts, locked_at IS NOT NULL, consumed_at IS NULL FROM handover_challenge WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 5, true, true. SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) FROM handover_attempt WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 5.
Order state READY, no COMPLETED event. Recovery is E2E-ORDER-108.

unverified: Cook UI text for VERIFICATION_FAILED (the ops-web errors dictionary was not inspected); assert the API codes in the Network tab.
Per-actor limit (30 attempts per hour per actor) is covered by automated tests only.
