conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Failed delivery ends the order as DELIVERY_FAILED without automatic refund, payment or commission
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
A delivery/COD order O1 in OUT_FOR_DELIVERY (E2E-ORDER-102 up to the courier step). FX-STAFF-OPS holds order.ops.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: On the card (OUT_FOR_DELIVERY) choose Reason 'Customer unreachable' and press 'Delivery failed'.
Reload the order page.
Look for O1 in Orders: try the filters 'Active' and 'Completed'.
Ops 'Order monitoring' > filter 'Delivery failed'.

ui: Customer page '<MB-number> · Delivery failed'. The cook UI shows O1 in neither 'Active' nor 'Completed' (the filter list in Orders.tsx has only those two). Ops filter 'Delivery failed' lists O1 with badge 'Delivery failed'.
api: Console GET /api/v1/cook/orders?state=DELIVERY_FAILED returns O1.
database: SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERY_FAILED actor COOK reason_code CUSTOMER_UNREACHABLE. terminal_at set.
SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> CONSUMED stays (no automatic restoration).
SELECT count(*) FROM refund WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 0. SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_group WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 0 (commission posts only for COMPLETED).
SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> amount_minor 28500 and state remains DUE (the delivery_failure branch does not call cash(); finance review is manual).

unverified: Docs 04-state-machines.md say DELIVERY_FAILED creates a 'support task'; the code opens no support case for cash orders, only the ops exception flag DELIVERY_FAILED (and a PAYMENT case for deposit orders, E2E-FIN-107). Owner decision whether a task is required.
Whether a COD order left in cash state DUE after DELIVERY_FAILED is intended.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: After acceptance the customer can only request cancellation; the order itself does not change
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
An ACCEPTED pickup/COD order O1 of FX-CUST-A and a PENDING one P1. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT holds support.case (PROVISION).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Open O1: the only cancel-related control is 'Request cancellation (reviewed by support)'. Press it.
steps.data: UI sends reasonCode CHANGED_MIND

steps.action: Console: POST /api/v1/orders/<O1>/cancel {expectedVersion:v, reasonCode:'CHANGED_MIND'}; POST /api/v1/orders/<O1>/cancellation-requests again; POST /api/v1/orders/<P1>/cancellation-requests.
Ops web > 'Support': find the case (category 'Cancellation request').
Run the read-only SQL.

ui: Step 1: text 'Cancellation request sent.' and a link 'Support cases for this order'; the order still says 'Accepted'. Step 3: the case appears with severity 'High'.
api: Direct cancel: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{state,'CANCELLATION_REQUEST_REQUIRED'}]. Second request: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{orderId,'OPEN_CANCELLATION_REQUEST'}]. Request on a pending order: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{state,'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE'}].
database: SELECT category, severity, cancellation_reason, state FROM support_case WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> CANCELLATION_REQUEST, HIGH, CHANGED_MIND, OPEN (exactly one open row: unique index support_case_open_cancellation_uq).
SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> ALLOCATED unchanged; customer_order.state ACCEPTED, version unchanged.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Out-of-order, stale and replayed commands are refused without changing history
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
Four orders of FX-CUST-A at kitchen A: P PENDING, A ACCEPTED, R READY pickup, Z COMPLETED. Record order_event counts and customer_order.version for each before starting.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Send as cook (current version each time, fresh key): prepare on P; ready on A; accept on A; prepare on Z; accept on Z.
Send accept on P with a stale expectedVersion (v-1) and with expectedVersion omitted; send accept without any Idempotency-Key header.
Send customer cancel on Z with the current version.
Re-read event counts/versions.

ui: Not applicable.
api: prepare@P, ready@A, accept@A: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fieldErrors [{state, <current state>}]. Anything on Z: 409 STATE_CONFLICT with state COMPLETED (terminal check comes before the version check). Stale version: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. Missing expectedVersion: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED. Missing/malformed key: 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST ('Idempotency-Key missing or malformed').
database: For all four orders order_event count and customer_order.version equal the values recorded before; no new outbox_event rows.

unverified: Whether an omitted expectedVersion yields 422 (bean validation @NotNull) or 400; confirm in the Network tab.

conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: A cook cannot read or command another kitchen's order; customers and unprivileged staff cannot call cook/ops endpoints
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).

Order OK2 of FX-CUST-A at kitchen B (seed kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني', 1 × 'Preview molokhia', slot from GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd002/slots; kitchen B's owner has no login, so FX-COOK-B is not needed) and order OK1 at kitchen A. Both PENDING.
FX-COOK-A is a cook of kitchen A only.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Ops web > 'Orders': confirm OK1 is listed and OK2 is not. In the console: GET /api/v1/cook/orders/<OK2>; POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<OK2>/accept {expectedVersion:0}, /reject {expectedVersion:0, reasonCode:'OTHER'} and /handover {expectedVersion:0, code:'123456'} (each with a fresh Idempotency-Key, XSRF header from the helper); POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<OK2>/payment/receipt {expectedVersion:0, amountMinor:1} (schema-valid body so the 404 comes from the ownership check, not validation).
Console: GET /api/v1/cook/orders and POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<OK1>/accept {expectedVersion:0} (fresh Idempotency-Key) as the customer.
Console: POST /api/v1/orders/<OK1>/cancel {expectedVersion:0, reasonCode:'OTHER'} (fresh Idempotency-Key) as the cook (not the owning customer).
Sign in at ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>: note the visible tabs; console: GET /api/v1/ops/orders and GET /api/v1/ops/payments?state=DISPUTED.

ui: FX-STAFF-NOGRANT sees no Finance, Order monitoring or Support tabs; the cook's list never contains OK2.
api: Cook on OK2: 404 NOT_FOUND for every call (no data about the order). Customer on cook endpoints: 403 FORBIDDEN. Cook cancelling a customer order: 404 NOT_FOUND. No-grant staff: 403 FORBIDDEN.
database: OK2 still PENDING_ACCEPTANCE (version unchanged) until cleanup; order_event for OK2 has one row; audit_event shows no ALLOWED order action by FX-COOK-A for OK2.

They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Core journey 1: pickup + cash on receipt, from placement to completion and operations inspection
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).
FX-STAFF-OPS holds the active grant order.ops (verify: it sees the 'Order monitoring' tab at ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>).
FX-CUST-A basket is empty (the 'Cart' page shows 'Your cart is empty.').

Slot assignment: use the seeded slot of day 1 (items[0]) (GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots, same index each run). Preparation consumes capacity permanently and each meal-slot has only 10 portions: before the case read the AGGREGATE slot availablePortions (max 20) from the kitchen slots response (SlotAvailability exposes aggregate availability only) AND the meal-specific availability from the meal's nextSlots[].availablePortions (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>; the owning cook's slot response also lists per-meal capacity) and switch to another seeded day if fewer portions than the case orders remain. E2E-ORDER-114/115 own the day-3 slot; do not use it here.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Open https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, sign in, press the language button until labels are English. Open meal 'Preview koshari', under 'Cooking slots' pick the day-1 slot (13:00 Africa/Cairo on today+1, state the Cairo date in the evidence), set quantity 2, press 'Add to cart'.
steps.data: quantity=2

steps.action: Open nav 'Cart'. Select the 'Pickup from the kitchen' button, leave payment radio 'Cash on receipt', press 'Calculate total'. Tick 'I accept the terms and the cancellation policy' and press 'Place order' once.
steps.data: mode=Pickup, payment=Cash on receipt

steps.action: On the order page note the order number (MB-…) and the heading state. Then open 'My orders' and confirm the order is listed.

At https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> open tab 'Orders', filter 'Active'. Find the card with the same MB- number: it shows badge 'Waiting for acceptance', 'Pickup', 'Accept by <time> (N min left)'. Press 'Accept'.
On the same card press 'Start preparing', then 'Ready'.
Reload the order page. Read the 'Handover code (give it to the cook or courier on receipt)' value (6 digits) and the 'Kitchen contact'/'Pickup location' line.
On the card, type the 6-digit code in 'Customer handover code' and press 'Confirm handover'.
steps.data: code = the digits read in step 6

steps.action: Reload the order page; check state, code and the review form. Open the nav 'My account' > 'Notifications'.
Tab 'Orders', filter 'Completed': the card shows 'Cash due' and a 'Report cash collected' form (finance verification of the cash is covered by E2E-FIN-038).
At ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> open 'Order monitoring' (filter 'All'), click the MB- number.

ui: Step 3: heading reads '<MB-number> · Waiting for the kitchen'; line '2 × Preview koshari — 150.00'; 'Total: 150.00'; no 'Payment' (deposit) panel because the order is cash.

Step 4: card badges as stated; after Accept the badge becomes 'Accepted', customer name 'Preview Customer 1' and phone +201000000101 appear, buttons 'Start preparing' and 'Cancel'. After Ready the badge is 'Ready' and the only action is 'Confirm handover'.
Step 6: customer page shows 'Ready', a 6-digit handover code, 'Kitchen contact: مطبخ المعاينة · +201000000201 · Pickup location: Synthetic location 1'.

Step 8: customer page heading '<MB-number> · Delivered' (English label for COMPLETED, also for pickup), the code line is gone, the 'Rate your order' form is shown; the timeline has 5 lines in order: Waiting for the kitchen, Accepted, Preparing, Ready, Delivered. Notifications list contains (newest first) Delivered, Ready, Preparing, Accepted, each with the MB- link and 'Mark read'.
Step 9: completion did not mark cash paid: the card shows 'Cash due'.

Step 10: operations timeline lists the first row 'Waiting for acceptance' (no 'from' state) followed by 'Waiting for acceptance → Accepted', 'Accepted → Preparing', 'Preparing → Ready', 'Ready → Completed' rows with Africa/Cairo times; customer phone/name are NOT shown for the completed order ('Contact details are not shown in this state.'); no handover code anywhere.
api: POST /api/v1/orders 201 (OrderView state PENDING_ACCEPTANCE, total.amountMinor 15000, payment.method COD, cashState DUE, allowedActions ['CANCEL']).
Cook commands 200 CookOrderView with version +1 each; final GET /api/v1/orders/{id} state COMPLETED, handoverCode null, cashState DUE, events length 5.
GET /api/v1/ops/orders/{id} 200 with order.handoverCode null and customerContact null.
database: Run SQL_ORDER: state COMPLETED, subtotal=total=15000, delivery_fee_minor 0, tax_minor 0, commission_bps_snapshot 0, commission_minor 0, terminal_at not null. SELECT state, version, subtotal_minor, delivery_fee_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, commission_bps_snapshot, commission_minor, accept_by, terminal_at FROM customer_order WHERE id = :'order';

SQL_EVENTS shows sequences 1..5: NULL→PENDING_ACCEPTANCE (CUSTOMER), →ACCEPTED, →PREPARING, →READY, →COMPLETED (COOK). SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence;
stock_allocation: one row state CONSUMED quantity 2 (not released). SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order';
cash_obligation: amount_minor 15000, state DUE (completion is independent of payment). SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order';
audit_event has action 'access.order_contact' ONLY for views made while the order was non-terminal (none for step 10): SELECT action, object_id FROM audit_event WHERE object_id = :'order';

flow.title: افحص الـ Preview قبل أي حساب
flow.goal: نتأكد إن الاختبار تجريبي وإن الروابط تخص نفس النسخة.
flow.configuration: إعدادات النشر: PREVIEW_DOMAIN بالدومين الموثق هنا. دي روابط من المصدر، مش شهادة إن السيرفر شغّال. من مجلد deploy/web-preview في نسخة السيرفر الفعلية شغّل ./deploy.sh status للقراءة؛ سجّل RELEASE_COMMIT وimage digests وإصدار schema.
flow.data: ثلاثة Browser Profiles مستقلة للعميل والطباخ والعمليات؛ النوافذ الخاصة في نفس المتصفح ممكن تشارك الكوكيز.
flow.instruction: افتح الرابط واقرأ JSON. بعدها افتح موقع العميل والمطبخ. سجّل التاريخ والوقت Africa/Cairo ورقم النسخة في نموذج النتيجة آخر الصفحة.
flow.expected: environment.name=PREVIEW وenvironment.demo=true، وموقعي العميل والمطبخ بيفتحوا من عنوانك.
flow.verification: طابق RELEASE_COMMIT بالنسخة اللي هتختبرها؛ ممنوع اعتبار وجود الكود دليل نشر.
flow.troubleshooting: 403 مع Not available: المشغّل يراجع CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_IPS وSTAFF_ALLOWED_IPS من الإعداد الخاص؛ ما تغيّرش المستخدم أو توسّع القائمة بنفسك. لو النسخة مش معروفة سجّل BLOCKED.

flow.title: راجع Realm وعميل الويب من غير تعديل
flow.goal: نتأكد إن الدخول متوصل بالـ Realm والـ callback الصح.
flow.configuration: Keycloak: اختار matbakhy من Realm selector ثم Clients → matbakhy-web. المطلوب protocol=openid-connect، Client authentication ON (publicClient=false)، Standard flow ON، Direct access grants OFF، PKCE S256. Valid redirect URI هو https://api.167-86-90-174.sslip.io/login/oauth2/code/keycloak. تسجيل الخروج يسمح بـ app/ops على نفس الدومين. ما تفتحش أو تنسخ Client secret.
flow.data: حساب مسؤول Keycloak المصرّح له، مستقل عن preview-ops-1. بيانات owner-admin وOTP من ملف GENERATED_DIR/admin-console/<name>.private عند المشغّل، عبر مدير كلمات مرور خاص؛ مسار GENERATED_DIR من إعداد السيرفر.
flow.instruction: ادخل من kc-admin بالحساب الإداري وOTP الخاص بيك. راجع القيم قراءة فقط. افتح OIDC discovery في الرابط التاني المعروض تحت، وطابق issuer.
flow.expected: issuer=https://id.167-86-90-174.sslip.io/realms/matbakhy، وعميل الويب مسجل callback الدقيق وS256.
flow.verification: لو المسميات اختلفت حسب إصدار Keycloak قارن حقول JSON غير السرية في ملف realm بالمصدر. المشغّل يقدر يشغّل ./deploy.sh admin-console status للقراءة فقط.
flow.troubleshooting: 404 على kc-admin ممكن تعني إنه مقفول. متفتحوش أو تعمل admin جديد تلقائيًا: سجّل BLOCKED واطلب المشغّل. أي mismatch يحتاج تغيير معتمد وسجل الحالة القديمة واسترجاعها؛ السيناريو ده لا يحتاج أي تغيير Realm.

flow.goal: نقدر نراجع الطلب من Back-office بعد اكتماله.

flow.verification: apply بيرفض غير PREVIEW أو schema أقل من V31. تابع exit code الحقيقي، مش خروج tail أو tee. إعادة التشغيل بتتجاهل المستخدم الموجود ومابتغيرش باسورده.

flow.title: راجع المطبخ والكشري والمواعيد
flow.goal: الطلب يستخدم مطبخ معتمد ووجبة ومخزون صالحين.

flow.instruction: في Profile الطباخ ادخل preview-cook-1. افتح Orders وSlots وتأكد إن المطبخ الصحيح ظاهر. في Profile العميل افتح الوجبة وتأكد من nextSlots. قبل التنفيذ افحص availablePortions للمطبخ وللوجبة نفسها؛ الكتالوج يطلب إجمالي ≥6 كهامش للحالات الأخرى، والطلب ده يستهلك حصتين. فحص المتطلب الأصلي يشمل3مواعيد OPEN للأيام الثلاثة المقبلة، وأول موعد صالح بسعة إجمالية≥6 وسعة كشري≥2؛ لو أقل من كده سجّل المتطلب الناقص BLOCKED قبل الطلب.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Core journey 2: delivery + cash on receipt, from placement through courier dispatch to completion

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

prerequisites: Signed iOS and Android builds pointing at the preview API (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md says Apple/Google setup is deferred); FX-CUST-A signed in on the device.

Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: On the device open Discover > 'Preview koshari' > slot 13:00 tomorrow > add 1; open the basket, 'Calculate total', accept terms.
Turn on airplane mode, press 'Place order', then force-quit the app, turn airplane mode off and relaunch.
On the basket screen read the pending notice and press 'Check and retry' (testID retry-order).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Operations handover override completes a locked order with fresh MFA, reason and evidence, fully audited
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).

Staff accounts for this case are PROVISIONED fixtures: grants are written by the operator (DB insert into user_grant) or by FX-STAFF-ADMIN in the ops 'Staff permissions' screen; granting through the API requires staff.grant AND recent MFA (StaffController), which needs the PR #9 Keycloak step-up flow.

FX-STAFF-OPS holds order.ops and order.handover_override and can complete a Keycloak MFA step-up (PR #9 realm flow applied; on origin/develop the realm has no OTP/acr flow, so this step ends in 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED).
A READY order O1 whose challenge is locked (result of E2E-ORDER-033). PRE_DB.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Ops web > 'Order monitoring' > open O1. In the form 'Handover override' leave Reason empty and press the button: note it is disabled. Type a Reason of 5 characters: still disabled.
Without a fresh step-up press the button with Reason 'Challenge locked after 5 wrong codes; customer verified by phone' and Evidence reference 'TEST-EVID-001'.
Press 'Verify again' (the step-up link), pass the second factor, return and submit the same form.
Console (ops origin): POST /api/v1/ops/orders/<O1>/handover-override as the cook.
Same call from the no-grant staff account.

ui: Step 2: message 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).' with link 'Verify again'. Step 3: order shows '<MB-number> · Completed'; the Delivered state appears for the customer.
api: Step 2: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED. Step 3: 200 OrderView state COMPLETED, handoverCode null, no customer contact. Direct API call with reason of 9 chars: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors reason MIN_10_CHARS. Steps 4-5: 403 FORBIDDEN.
database: order_event last row READY→COMPLETED actor_type STAFF reason_code HANDOVER_OVERRIDE; handover_challenge.consumed_at set.

SELECT action, permission, outcome, reason, details FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'order.handover_override' AND object_id = :'order'; -> one ALLOWED row with the reason text and details {evidenceRef:'TEST-EVID-001', mode:'PICKUP'}.

unverified: Step-up round trip in the ops UI (link target) was not exercised; verify against docs/security/mfa-policy.md web step-up route.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Operations exception-cancel of a PREPARING order keeps consumed capacity and links the support case
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).

Staff accounts for this case are PROVISIONED fixtures: grants are written by the operator (DB insert into user_grant) or by FX-STAFF-ADMIN in the ops 'Staff permissions' screen; granting through the API requires staff.grant AND recent MFA (StaffController), which needs the PR #9 Keycloak step-up flow.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.

A PREPARING pickup/COD order O1 with an open CANCELLATION_REQUEST case reference CS-XXXXXXXX (E2E-ORDER-035). FX-STAFF-OPS holds order.ops + order.exception_cancel; FX-STAFF-SUPPORT holds support.case.
Note: the exception-cancel endpoint requires the permission only (no step-up in OpsOrderController); the UI still renders a step-up hint.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: In 'Support' try to resolve the case with resolution 'Order cancelled' BEFORE the order is cancelled (reason text >= 3 characters).
Order monitoring > O1 > form 'Exception cancellation': Reason OPERATIONAL, 'Case reference' = CS-XXXXXXXX, Note 'Ingredient shortage'; press 'Exception cancellation'.
Console: repeat the call on an ACCEPTED order, and with a blank caseId.
Resolve the case now with 'Order cancelled'.
Reload the order page.

ui: Customer page '<MB-number> · Cancelled'.
api: Step 1: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{resolutionCode,'ORDER_NOT_CANCELLED'}]. Step 3: 409 STATE_CONFLICT ('exception cancel only from PREPARING or READY'); blank caseId: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED. Step 4: 200 case RESOLVED.
database: SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> state CONSUMED stays; cook_slot.consumed unchanged (not released). SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> PREPARING→CANCELLED actor STAFF reason_code OPERATIONAL.
SELECT action, details FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'order.exception_cancel' AND object_id = :'order'; -> ALLOWED with details.caseRef = the case reference.
SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> state unchanged DUE (manual finance review, BR-029).

unverified: Docs list order.exception_cancel among high-risk permissions; the controller does not require recent MFA for it (only the handover override does).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

steps.action: On A1 choose Reason 'Ingredient unavailable' (default) and press 'Cancel'.
On B1 look at the buttons; then console POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<B1>/cancel {expectedVersion:v, reasonCode:'OTHER'}.
Reload A1.
SQL for A1.

ui: A1 customer page '<MB-number> · Cancelled'. B1 card shows only 'Ready' (no 'Cancel').
api: B1 cancel: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{state,'PREPARING'}].
database: SELECT sequence, from_state, to_state, actor_type, reason_code FROM order_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY sequence; -> ACCEPTED→CANCELLED actor COOK reason_code INGREDIENT_UNAVAILABLE.
SELECT state, quantity, released_at FROM stock_allocation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> ALLOCATED→RELEASED once; allocated counter decreased by 2.
SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> NOT_DUE.
