conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Core journey 3: pickup + 50% deposit, from deposit report to verified remaining cash
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION) holds finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve and finance.settlement.

On origin/develop the cash-report step produces a false DISPUTED (discrepancy = -deposit) because CashService compared the report with the order total; PR #9 compares with the cash obligation. Run this case against a PR #9 deployment.

Slot assignment: use the seeded slot of day 2 (items[1]) (GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots, same index each run). Preparation consumes capacity permanently and each meal-slot has only 10 portions: before the case read the AGGREGATE slot availablePortions (max 20) from the kitchen slots response (SlotAvailability exposes aggregate availability only) AND the meal-specific availability from the meal's nextSlots[].availablePortions (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>; the owning cook's slot response also lists per-meal capacity) and switch to another seeded day if fewer portions than the case orders remain. E2E-ORDER-114/115 own the day-3 slot; do not use it here.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Customer web: add 2 × 'Preview koshari' (day-2 slot: 13:00 Africa/Cairo on today+2; state the Cairo date in the evidence), open 'Cart', mode 'Pickup from the kitchen', pick the radio 'Deposit sent straight to the kitchen', press 'Calculate total'. Read the quote including the box data-testid="deposit-terms".
Tick the terms box and press 'Place order'. On the order page read the box data-testid="payment-status".
Type 'TEST-REF-0001' in 'Transfer reference (optional)' and press 'I sent the deposit'. Nothing is actually transferred in the preview.
steps.data: reference=TEST-REF-0001

steps.action: Ops web > 'Orders' > 'Active': on the card read the 'Deposit' panel, then press 'Accept'.
In the Deposit panel press 'The deposit arrived (EGP 75.00)' (the kitchen states that it saw the money in its own account).
Press 'Start preparing', then 'Ready'.
Reload the order page, read the 6-digit 'Handover code'.
Enter the code in 'Customer handover code' and press 'Confirm handover'.
Orders > 'Completed': on the card the 'Report cash collected' form shows Amount (EGP) 75.00 (the remainder). Reference 'TEST-CASH-DEP-1', press 'Submit'.

Console on ops origin: GET /api/v1/ops/finance/cash-reports?state=REPORTED, take the report id/version for this order; POST /api/v1/ops/finance/cash-reports/<reportId>/verification {decision:'VERIFY', verifiedAmountMinor:7500, expectedVersion:<version>} with a fresh Idempotency-Key.
Ops web > 'Finance': enter kitchen id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001, press 'Show', read the statement.
Reload the order page and 'My account' > 'Notifications'.

ui: Step 1 box: 'Deposit now: 75.00 · Rest on receipt: 75.00', 'InstaPay: demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid · Demo kitchen (not a real account)', 'Send the deposit before <acceptBy time>.', 'You pay the kitchen's account directly; the platform never receives or holds the money. The kitchen confirms after checking its own account; your report alone is not proof.'

Step 2: 'Payment: Waiting for your deposit' + the reference field and 'I sent the deposit'. Step 3: 'Payment: You reported the transfer; waiting for the kitchen to confirm' and 'Preparation starts only after the kitchen confirms the deposit reached its account.' (no bank-verified wording anywhere).

Step 4: cook panel 'Deposit: 75.00 · rest on hand-over 75.00 · Customer reported a transfer' and the notice 'Check your own account before reporting; what you record is your statement, not a bank confirmation.' Step 5: badge 'Kitchen reported receipt'.

Step 12: customer page 'Delivered', Payment panel 'The kitchen reported receiving the deposit'; inbox contains 'Deposit: the kitchen reported receiving it'. Step 11: statement row '<MB-number> · 150.00 · Verified'; 'Cash verified' rises by 75.00 compared with the value recorded before step 10 (the figure sums all verified cash of the kitchen in the month); no commission lines; banner 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.'
api: Quote 201: total 15000, payment {method DEPOSIT, depositBps 5000, deposit 7500, remainder 7500, recipient INSTAPAY …}. Order payment {state WAITING_FOR_DEPOSIT, version 0, depositExpiresAt = acceptBy}; after the customer report CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED; after the kitchen report KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED.
POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<id>/cash-reports 201: amount 7500, discrepancy 0, state REPORTED. Verification 200 state VERIFIED verifiedAmount 7500.
database: SELECT method, state, total_minor, deposit_minor, remainder_minor, deposit_expires_at, version FROM order_payment WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> DEPOSIT, KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED, total 15000, deposit 7500, remainder 7500 (terms immutable).

SELECT from_state, to_state, actor_type, amount_minor, reference, reason_code FROM payment_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY occurred_at, id; -> NULL→WAITING_FOR_DEPOSIT (CUSTOMER, amount 7500), →CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED (CUSTOMER, amount NULL, reference TEST-REF-0001), →KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED (COOK, amount 7500).

SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> amount_minor 7500; SELECT amount_minor, discrepancy_minor, state, verified_amount_minor, verified_by, reporter_id FROM cash_report WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 7500, 0, VERIFIED, 7500, verified_by <> reporter_id.
SELECT count(*) FROM support_case WHERE order_id = :'order' AND category = 'PAYMENT'; -> 0 (nothing disputed). SELECT count(*) FROM refund WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 0.

SELECT g.kind, g.rate_bps, g.base_minor, e.account, e.direction, e.amount_minor FROM ledger_group g JOIN ledger_entry e ON e.group_id = g.id WHERE g.order_id = :'order' ORDER BY g.posted_at, e.direction; -> poll (bounded, up to 90 s; LedgerPostingJob runs every 30 s, asynchronously) until the COMPLETED event has its kind COMMISSION group, then assert exactly two entries (COOK_COMMISSION_RECEIVABLE DEBIT and PLATFORM_COMMISSION_REVENUE CREDIT), both amount_minor 0, balanced: deposits never enter the ledger.

flow.configuration: Slot assignment: use the seeded slot of day 2 (items[1]) (GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots, same index each run). Preparation consumes capacity permanently and each meal-slot has only 10 portions: before the case read the AGGREGATE slot availablePortions (max 20) from the kitchen slots response (SlotAvailability exposes aggregate availability only) AND the meal-specific availability from the meal's nextSlots[].availablePortions (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>; the owning cook's slot response also lists per-meal capacity) and switch to another seeded day if fewer portions than the case orders remain. E2E-ORDER-114/115 own the day-3 slot; do not use it here.

flow.goal: الهويات ومنح التطبيق تبقى متطابقة مع manifest.
flow.configuration: الأداة من deploy/web-preview؛ plan للقراءة، apply تعديل فعلي في Keycloak وقاعدة التطبيق، يحتاج موافقة المالك على Preview المشتركة. لا تنشئ User عشوائي بدل fixed-ID fixture.
flow.instruction: شغّل plan عند المشغّل. لو الحسابات ناقصة استخدم apply بعد التفويض فقط: الأداة تعمل backup وpartial import بنفس IDs وSQL للمنح وrefresh للمواعيد وreconciliation. existing users يحتفظوا بباسوردهم القديم. لا تعيد seed-preview.sql.
flow.expected: reconciliation تنجح وتظهر الهوية وصلاحياتها المطلوبة. كلمات السر الجديدة في BACKUP_DIR/owner-e2e-private/<run>/credentials.private.json، صلاحيات600، عبر قناة خاصة فقط.
flow.verification: المشغّل يقارن IDs والـgrants بالقيم المطلوبة في تجهيزات الحالة؛ عند اختلاف ID الأداة ترفض قبل SQL.
flow.troubleshooting: الحساب المستهلك أو جهاز/بيئة FX-ISOLATED مش بيتصلح بإعادة apply؛ لو المطلوب غير متاح سجّل BLOCKED.
flow.code:
cd deploy/web-preview
./owner-e2e-provision.sh plan
# apply بعد موافقة مالك البيئة المشتركة فقط:
./owner-e2e-provision.sh apply

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Kitchen reports 'Not received': payment becomes DISPUTED, a PAYMENT support case opens, the order is not changed
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).
FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION) holds finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve and finance.settlement.
An ACCEPTED deposit order D1 (pickup, total 15000) whose customer transfer is reported (CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Check your own account (nothing arrived in the preview). In the Deposit panel of D1 press 'Not received'.
Reload the order page and 'My account' > 'Notifications'.
Open the link 'Support cases for this order'.
Console: POST /api/v1/support/cases {orderId:D1, category:'PAYMENT', description:'trying to open a payment case'}.
Press 'Start preparing'.
Ops web > 'Finance' > 'Payments needing attention' > filter 'Payment disputed'.
Console: POST /api/v1/ops/orders/<D1>/payment/decision {expectedVersion:<payment version>, outcome:'REFUND_OWED', reason:'attempt while the order is active'} (needs a recent MFA proof).

ui: Step 1: Deposit panel badge 'Payment disputed'. Step 2: 'Payment: The kitchen did not find the transfer or found a different amount' plus 'Contact support from the order page with your transfer reference.'; inbox entry 'Deposit: the kitchen did not find the transfer or found a different amount'; order still 'Accepted'. Step 3: a case with category 'Deposit review' (High). Step 6: D1 listed with the line 'The order is still active; waiting for the kitchen's report.' (no decision form while the order is active).
api: Step 1: 200 PaymentView state DISPUTED. Step 4: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (customers cannot open PAYMENT cases). Step 5: 409 STATE_CONFLICT payment DEPOSIT_NOT_RECEIVED. Step 7: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{orderId,'ORDER_ACTIVE'}] (a decision is possible only after the order ended; without MFA 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED comes first).
database: SELECT from_state, to_state, actor_type, amount_minor, reference, reason_code FROM payment_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY occurred_at, id; -> last row CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED→DISPUTED actor COOK reason_code NOT_RECEIVED.

SELECT category, severity, state FROM support_case WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY created_at; -> exactly one PAYMENT/HIGH/OPEN case (partial unique index support_case_open_payment_uq); its description is system text with no account, reference or amount.

SELECT state, version, subtotal_minor, delivery_fee_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, commission_bps_snapshot, commission_minor, accept_by, terminal_at FROM customer_order WHERE id = :'order'; -> still ACCEPTED, version unchanged by the dispute.
SELECT n.type, n.recipient_id, n.params->>'state' AS state, n.read_at FROM notification n WHERE n.order_id = :'order' ORDER BY n.created_at; -> a customer notification PAYMENT_DISPUTED.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Clients cannot dictate payment amounts; the kitchen receipt must equal the server-computed deposit
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).
A pending deposit order D1 (total 15000, deposit 7500) with the customer's transfer reported; cook session on ops origin; D1 payment version v from GET /api/v1/cook/orders/<D1> (payment.version).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: POST /api/v1/quotes with an extra field {…, depositMinor: 20000} and another with {…, paymentMethod:'DEPOSIT', totalMinor: 1}.
POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<D1>/payment/receipt {expectedVersion:v, amountMinor:15000}; then 7000; then 0.
steps.data: amounts above, below, zero

steps.action: PUT /api/v1/cook/payment-profile with depositBps 10001; then with codMaxTotalMinor -1 (use the profile's current version).
POST the receipt with amountMinor 7500 and a stale version (v-1).

ui: Not applicable.
api: 1: 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST (unknown field). 2: 15000 and 7000 -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{amountMinor,'DOES_NOT_MATCH_DEPOSIT'}]; 0 -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (must be positive). 3: 422 depositBps RANGE_0_10000 and 422 codMaxTotalMinor NOT_NEGATIVE; the profile is unchanged. 4: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.
database: SELECT method, state, total_minor, deposit_minor, remainder_minor, deposit_expires_at, version FROM order_payment WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> state still CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED, deposit_minor 7500, version unchanged; no KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED event. quote_payment_ck (deposit_minor <= total_minor) means no stored quote can ever exceed its total: SELECT count(*) FROM quote WHERE deposit_minor > total_minor; -> 0.

unverified: Whether the receipt body with amountMinor 0 returns 422 (bean validation @Positive) as expected.
Rounding half-up of the deposit (e.g. 1 piastre) cannot be hit with seeded prices at 50%; covered by DepositPaymentIntegrationTest.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Repeated customer transfer reports are idempotent and are information only
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).
A pending deposit order D1 and a pending COD order P1 of FX-CUST-A.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: On D1 press 'I sent the deposit' once; in the console POST /api/v1/orders/<D1>/payment/transfer-report {reference:'TEST-REF-0002'} twice more. (The payment endpoints take no Idempotency-Key header.)
POST the report with a 65-character reference; with an extra field {amountMinor:1}; on the COD order P1.
POST the report on D1.
Console: GET /api/v1/notifications?limit=20.

ui: After the first press the form disappears and the status reads 'You reported the transfer; waiting for the kitchen to confirm'. No text claims the money arrived.
api: Repeat reports: 200 with the same payment state CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED and the same version. 65-char reference: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED; extra field: 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST; COD order: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{payment,'NO_DEPOSIT_WAITING'}]; FX-CUST-B: 404 NOT_FOUND.
database: SELECT count(*) FROM payment_event WHERE order_id = '<D1>' AND to_state = 'CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED'; -> 1. order_payment.version = initial + 1. SELECT count(*) FROM notification WHERE order_id = '<D1>' AND type = 'PAYMENT_CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED'; -> 1 (cook).

unverified: A race of the report with the kitchen receipt/expiry needs the isolated stack and is covered by DepositPaymentIntegrationTest#a_transfer_report_racing_expiry_is_reconciled_or_refused_never_lost.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: A cash shortfall becomes a dispute for finance; the original order snapshot is untouched
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION) holds finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve and finance.settlement.
A COMPLETED pickup/COD order O1 (total 15000, cash DUE). FX-STAFF-OPS holds order.ops.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Orders > 'Completed' > O1: set Amount (EGP) to 140.00, Reference 'short-test', press 'Submit'.
Console: GET /api/v1/ops/finance/cash-reports?state=DISPUTED; take the report {id, version}.
POST …/verification {decision:'VERIFY', verifiedAmountMinor:14000, expectedVersion:v} without a reason; then WITH reason 'Cook reported 140.00 against 150.00 due'.
POST …/verification {decision:'DISPUTE', verifiedAmountMinor:14000, reason:'Cook reported EGP 140.00 against EGP 150.00 due', expectedVersion:v}.
Ops web > 'Order monitoring' > filter 'Cash disputed'.
Reload Orders > 'Completed'.

ui: Step 1: card text 'Under review'. Step 5: O1 listed with badge 'Cash disputed'; its total still reads 150.00 and state Completed.
api: Step 1 report 201: discrepancy.amountMinor -1000, state REPORTED. Step 3a: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors reason REQUIRED_FOR_EXCEPTIONS; 3b: 422 verifiedAmountMinor MUST_EQUAL_AMOUNT_DUE_OR_DISPUTE. Step 4: 200 state DISPUTED.
database: SELECT amount_minor, discrepancy_minor, state, verified_amount_minor, verified_by, reporter_id FROM cash_report WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 14000, -1000, DISPUTED (after step 4), verified_amount_minor 14000.
SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> DISPUTED (already DISPUTED from step 1, before staff action).

SELECT state, version, subtotal_minor, delivery_fee_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, commission_bps_snapshot, commission_minor, accept_by, terminal_at FROM customer_order WHERE id = :'order'; -> state COMPLETED, total_minor 15000 unchanged.
Variant: an over-report of 16000 gives discrepancy_minor +1000 and the same DISPUTED handling.

unverified: No API/UI moves a DISPUTED cash obligation to a final state; resolution outside the system is assumed (not found in code).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Platform refund of verified cash: only finance.refund_approve, full amount only, requester and approver differ
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.

Staff accounts for this case are PROVISIONED fixtures: grants are written by the operator (DB insert into user_grant) or by FX-STAFF-ADMIN in the ops 'Staff permissions' screen; granting through the API requires staff.grant AND recent MFA (StaffController), which needs the PR #9 Keycloak step-up flow.
Console on the ops origin. There is no customer refund request in the product: customers use a support case or cancellation request.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

FX-STAFF-FINANCE holds finance.refund_approve. A second, different holder is needed (four-eyes): FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B (staff.grant, recent MFA, PR #9) temporarily grants finance.refund_approve to FX-STAFF-OPS (fixtures.json gives OPS order.* and ADMIN-B no finance permission) and revokes it at the end; FX-STAFF-SUPPORT holds only support.case.

steps.action: POST /api/v1/ops/finance/refunds {orderId:O1, caseId:'CS-TEST-1', fullAmountMinor:15000, reason:'test refund'} (fresh key). Repeat as FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and as FX-CUST-A.
Same request with fullAmountMinor 10000, then 20000, then 15000.
POST /api/v1/ops/finance/refunds/<refundId>/action {action:'APPROVE', expectedVersion:0}.
Same action APPROVE; then action VERIFY immediately; then PAYMENT_RECORDED with evidenceRef 'TEST-REF-PAY-1' and the new version.
VERIFY (the same person recorded payment). Then FX-STAFF-FINANCE: VERIFY.
Request a second refund for O1.

ui: Not applicable (API only; the ops Finance statement offers 'Request full refund' and per-state buttons Approve/Reject/Record payment/Verify).
api: 1: 403 FORBIDDEN each. 2: 10000 -> 422 fieldErrors fullAmountMinor FULL_REFUND_REQUIRED; 20000 -> OVER_REFUND; 15000 -> 200 state REQUESTED. 3: 403 FORBIDDEN (separation of duties, requester = approver). 4: APPROVE 200 state APPROVED; VERIFY -> 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{state,'APPROVED'}]; PAYMENT_RECORDED 200 state PAID. 5: same payer VERIFY -> 403; other person VERIFY -> 200 VERIFIED. 6: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{fullAmountMinor,'OVER_REFUND'}].
database: SELECT state, amount_minor, requested_by, approved_by, paid_by, verified_by, payment_reference FROM refund WHERE order_id = '<O1>'; -> one row VERIFIED amount 15000 with approved_by <> requested_by and verified_by <> paid_by (DB checks refund_approver_ck, refund_verifier_ck).
SELECT kind, rate_bps FROM ledger_group WHERE order_id = '<O1>' ORDER BY posted_at; -> COMMISSION then one COMMISSION_REVERSAL (both with 0 entries under D10).
audit_event rows refund.request, refund.approve, refund.payment_recorded, refund.verify, all ALLOWED, each with actor and reason.

unverified: The refund path predates D10: it moves no money in the platform (state machine only) and with zero commission the reversal group carries zero amounts.
Whether the owner still wants the platform refund workflow next to the kitchen-owed deposit refund (FIN-107).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Reconciliation invariants hold: balanced ledger, one cash obligation per order, payments match history, deposit never in ledger
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.

At least one COMPLETED COD order (E2E-ORDER-101/102) and one COMPLETED deposit order (E2E-FIN-039/101) exist. E2E-FIN-107 is NOT required: run it separately for cancelled/disputed-deposit coverage. A read-only SQL channel; infra/db/reconcile.sql from the release commit. There is no ledger export endpoint (getOpsAuditExport is x-implemented: false).

steps.action: Run infra/db/reconcile.sql read-only against the preview database.
steps.data: psql -f infra/db/reconcile.sql

steps.action: Run the extra checks listed in expected.database.
Open ops 'Finance' for kitchen 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001 (default period = current Cairo calendar month through today) and compare 'Cash verified' with the SQL sum in expected.database.

ui: Finance statement totals equal the SQL sums.
api: GET /api/v1/ops/finance/statements?kitchenId=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001 summary.cashVerified.amountMinor equals SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state = 'VERIFIED' for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event falls in the statement's Cairo date range (default: first day of the current Cairo month through today).
database: reconcile.sql returns every check_name with violations = 0: meal_slot_counters_match_allocations, cook_slot_counters_match_meal_slots, terminal_orders_hold_no_live_stock, order_items_match_subtotal, order_state_matches_latest_event, one_cash_obligation_per_order, ledger_groups_balanced, ledger_only_for_completed_orders, migrations_all_successful, payment_state_matches_history.

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT kind, source_event_id FROM ledger_group GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1) d; -> 0. SELECT count(*) FROM order_payment p JOIN customer_order o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.deposit_minor + p.remainder_minor <> o.total_minor; -> 0.

SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE account NOT IN ('COOK_COMMISSION_RECEIVABLE','PLATFORM_COMMISSION_REVENUE'); -> 0 (no entry for deposits or cash). SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry e JOIN ledger_group g ON g.id = e.group_id JOIN customer_order o ON o.id = g.order_id WHERE o.commission_bps_snapshot = 0 AND e.amount_minor <> 0; -> 0.

SELECT coalesce(sum(c.amount_minor),0) FROM cash_obligation c JOIN customer_order o ON o.id = c.order_id JOIN order_event e ON e.order_id = o.id AND e.to_state = 'COMPLETED' WHERE o.kitchen_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001' AND c.state = 'VERIFIED' AND e.occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo') AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo' AND e.occurred_at < (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo'; -> equals the statement 'Cash verified' (not SUM(cash_report.verified_amount_minor)).

flow.original: Open ops 'Finance' for kitchen 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001 (default period = current Cairo calendar month through today) and compare 'Cash verified' with the SQL sum in expected.database.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Zero platform charges: no commission, service fee or tax on any quote, order, ledger or statement
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
FX-STAFF-FINANCE holds config.read (see fixtures.json; FX-STAFF-OPS does not) - needed to open 'Operating configuration'; alternatively read the policy by SQL.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Create four quotes for the same kitchen A slot: pickup/COD (2 × koshari), pickup/DEPOSIT, delivery/COD and delivery/DEPOSIT (1 koshari + 1 mahshi, address Test zone A). Record the full JSON of each.
Place any one and open it. In the customer web look for any charge line other than Meals, Delivery fee, Tax, Total.
Ops web > 'Operating configuration': read 'Current pricing policy'.
Ops web > 'Statement'.
Run the SQL.

ui: Quote panel shows only Meals, Delivery fee, Tax, Total. Policy screen reads 'no platform commission (owner decision D10)' and the synthetic-policy label. Cook statement: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' and no commission column.
api: Every quote: tax.amountMinor 0; total = subtotal + deliveryFee (pickup deliveryFee 0, zone A 3000); JSON has no service-fee or commission property. Order JSON likewise.
database: SELECT policy_version, commission_bps_snapshot, commission_minor, tax_minor FROM customer_order; -> policy_version >= 1 (the active synthetic policy version, not 0) and commission_bps_snapshot, commission_minor and tax_minor all 0 on every preview order. SELECT version, commission_rate_bps, tax_rate_bps, synthetic FROM commerce_policy WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'; -> commission_rate_bps 0, tax_rate_bps 0. SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE amount_minor <> 0; -> 0.

unverified: Operation id of the configuration read (getOpsConfiguration) inferred from the route used by the ops UI.
The delivery fee is a kitchen/zone delivery arrangement fee, not a Matbakhy fee (owner rule); the product has no paid ads or growth billing in this scope.
