flow.original: Run the SQL.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: No real money or notification leaves the preview: only simulated bookkeeping and fake recipients
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
Browser DevTools Network panel with 'Preserve log' on; E2E-FIN-039 is executed while the log is recording.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: With the Network panel open execute the customer part of E2E-FIN-039 (quote, place, 'I sent the deposit').
Execute the cook part (receipt, cash report) and finance verification.
In the Network panel list all distinct hostnames. Read the demo notice and the deposit recipient text on the quote.
Check the API's configured providers (APP_ENV=PREVIEW: SMS, e-mail, push and malware scanner are fake per docs/operations/06-web-preview.md) and outbound notifications.

ui: Persistent banner 'Demo environment — Test data only. Orders, deposits and payments here are simulated, and no real notification is sent.' on customer web and ops web. Recipient shows 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' (non-routable '.invalid') and 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)'.
api: The contract (contracts/openapi.yaml) has no payment-provider, webhook or payout operation; the deposit and cash endpoints only record statements.
database: Only hosts under app./ops./api./id./media.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> appear in the Network log (no card/wallet/bank/PSP host). SELECT count(*) FROM notification_delivery WHERE channel = 'PUSH'; -> 0 (push flag off). No table stores card data or provider charge ids.

unverified: Which notification_delivery.status the fake e-mail provider records; whether a server-side egress log is available to the tester.

flow.original: Check the API's configured providers (APP_ENV=PREVIEW: SMS, e-mail, push and malware scanner are fake per docs/operations/06-web-preview.md) and outbound notifications.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Core journey 4: delivery + 50% deposit with a courier, to verified remaining cash
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION) holds finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve and finance.settlement.
FX-CUST-A has an address in 'Test zone A' (see E2E-ORDER-102 step 2). PR #9 behaviour for the cash step as in E2E-FIN-039.

Slot assignment: use the seeded slot of day 1 (items[0]) (GET /api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots, same index each run). Preparation consumes capacity permanently and each meal-slot has only 10 portions: before the case read the AGGREGATE slot availablePortions (max 20) from the kitchen slots response (SlotAvailability exposes aggregate availability only) AND the meal-specific availability from the meal's nextSlots[].availablePortions (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>; the owning cook's slot response also lists per-meal capacity) and switch to another seeded day if fewer portions than the case orders remain. E2E-ORDER-114/115 own the day-3 slot; do not use it here.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Add 1 × 'Preview koshari' and 1 × 'Preview mahshi' (same 13:00 slot), 'Cart', mode 'Delivery', select the Test-zone-A address, radio 'Deposit sent straight to the kitchen', 'Calculate total', terms, 'Place order'.
On the order page press 'I sent the deposit' without a reference.
'Accept', then 'The deposit arrived (EGP 142.50)', 'Start preparing', 'Ready', then type 'COURIER-TEST-02' in the delivery reference field and press 'Hand to courier'.
Reload: read the code. State must read 'On the way'.
Enter the code, 'Confirm handover'. Then in 'Completed' submit 'Report cash collected' with the pre-filled Amount (EGP) 142.50.
Verify the report via the API with verifiedAmountMinor 14250.

ui: Quote: Meals 255.00, Delivery fee 30.00, Tax 0.00, Total 285.00; 'Deposit now: 142.50 · Rest on receipt: 142.50'. Cook card shows the delivery address line and the Deposit panel. Final customer state 'Delivered'.
api: Quote total.amountMinor 28500 (subtotal 25500 + deliveryFee 3000), payment.deposit.amountMinor 14250, remainder 14250. Cash report amount 14250 discrepancy 0 -> VERIFIED.
database: SELECT method, state, total_minor, deposit_minor, remainder_minor, deposit_expires_at, version FROM order_payment WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> total 28500, deposit 14250, remainder 14250.
SELECT amount_minor, state FROM cash_obligation WHERE order_id = :'order'; -> 14250 VERIFIED after step 6.

SELECT from_state, to_state, actor_type, amount_minor, reference, reason_code FROM payment_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY occurred_at, id; -> amounts in transition order: 14250 (WAITING_FOR_DEPOSIT), NULL (customer report, reference NULL), 14250 (kitchen receipt).
customer_order.dispatch_reference = 'COURIER-TEST-02', delivery_fee_minor 3000; the delivery fee is part of the total the kitchen collects, no separate Matbakhy fee exists.

fixture_data.item: delivery address in Test zone A for FX-CUST-A

unverified: The delivery fee (EGP 30.00 by zone) is shown as 'Delivery fee'; the product states it is an external delivery fee, not platform monetisation. No code path adds a platform share to it.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Duplicate or invalid cash reports are refused; one report per order
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).
Two COMPLETED COD orders C1 and C2 (cash DUE, total 15000) at kitchen A, plus one PREPARING order P1; cook session on ops origin. Record customer_order.version of each (v).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: On C1 build `const body={amountMinor:15000,currency:'EGP',collectedAt:new Date().toISOString(),method:'CASH',externalReference:'TEST-CASH-002',expectedVersion:v}` and POST /api/v1/cook/orders/<C1>/cash-reports with key K.
Repeat the same POST with the same key K and body; then with K and amountMinor 14000.
POST again with a NEW key K2.
On C2 send: currency 'USD'; then collectedAt one day in the future; then a stale expectedVersion (v-1).
On P1 send a valid report.
Send a report on C2 as the customer.

ui: Not applicable.
api: 1: 201 state REPORTED. 2: same key and body -> 201 with the same report id; changed body -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. 3: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{cashState,'REPORTED'}]. 4: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors method CASH_EGP_ONLY; 422 collectedAt BETWEEN_ORDER_AND_NOW; 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. 5: 409 STATE_CONFLICT fieldErrors [{state,'PREPARING'}]. 6: 403 FORBIDDEN.
database: SELECT count(*) FROM cash_report WHERE order_id = '<C1>'; -> 1 (UNIQUE order_id). C2 has no cash_report row and cash_obligation still DUE.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: A changed kitchen payment account is hidden from customers until staff approve it, and stale quotes are re-priced
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).

FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION) holds finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve and finance.settlement; the ops web shows its 'Finance' tab (the tab appears only for accounts that may read statements, so finance.verify alone is not enough). Payment recipient approval and payment decisions also need a recent Keycloak MFA step-up (PR #9 realm flow); cash verification, refunds and settlements do not.

Staff accounts for this case are PROVISIONED fixtures: grants are written by the operator (DB insert into user_grant) or by FX-STAFF-ADMIN in the ops 'Staff permissions' screen; granting through the API requires staff.grant AND recent MFA (StaffController), which needs the PR #9 Keycloak step-up flow.
SHARED DATA WARNING: this changes kitchen A's recipient in the shared preview; steps 7-8 restore it. Run on a PR #9 deployment (MFA step-up).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: Customer web: cart 2 × koshari, Pickup, radio 'Deposit sent straight to the kitchen', 'Calculate total' (quote Q1). Do not place yet.
Ops web > 'Settings' > section 'Payment': change 'Account address or number' to 'demo-kitchen-2@instapay.invalid', press 'Save'. Read the status line.
Place Q1 (tick terms, 'Place order') within 5 minutes.
Calculate the total again with the deposit radio; then switch to 'Cash on receipt' and calculate.

Ops web > 'Finance' > 'Accounts waiting for approval': row 'مطبخ المعاينة · InstaPay: demo-kitchen-2@instapay.invalid …'. Reason 'Checked against approved application (test)'; press 'Approve account'. (Needs recent MFA.)
Calculate the total with the deposit radio again.
Restore 'Account address or number' to 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid', Save.
Approve the restored account the same way.

ui: Step 2: 'Waiting for staff approval; deposits are not offered to customers until then.' Step 3: the placement is refused (nothing is ordered); the page tries a new quote, which fails because deposits are no longer offered, so it shows "We couldn't calculate the new total. Calculate the total again." and no order exists. Step 4: 'This kitchen does not take deposits at the moment. Choose cash on receipt.' for deposit, cash quote works. Step 5: the approved row disappears from the waiting list. Step 6: deposit quote works and shows 'demo-kitchen-2@instapay.invalid'. Step 8 leaves 'Staff approved this account.'
api: Step 3: 409 PRICE_CHANGED fieldErrors [{quoteId,'PAYMENT_CHANGED'}]. Step 4 deposit: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{paymentMethod,'DEPOSIT_NOT_OFFERED'}]. Step 5 without MFA: 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED; reason shorter than 10 characters: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED on field reason. After approval 200 ProfileView recipientStatus APPROVED.
database: SELECT recipient_status, recipient_identifier, approved_by, approved_at FROM kitchen_payment_profile WHERE kitchen_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001'; -> NONE after step 2, APPROVED with approved_by = FX-STAFF-FINANCE after step 5.

audit_event rows payment.profile_update (details recipientChanged true) and payment.recipient_approve (reason text) exist; no order has the unapproved identifier in order_payment.recipient_identifier.

unverified: Step 3 outcome in the UI: Checkout.place() maps PRICE_CHANGED to a re-quote; the UI also falls back to the generic text if the re-quote fails.
A staff member who also owns the kitchen cannot approve it (403) - needs a multi-role fixture and is not exercised here.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Cash-on-receipt eligibility: a kitchen's COD cap refuses higher totals exactly above the cap
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-CUST-A signs in (password from the private fixture sheet) and GET /api/v1/me returns phoneVerified=true.
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.

Kitchen A (00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001) has OPEN 13:00 Africa/Cairo slots for the next 3 days: in the DevTools Console on app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> `(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items` has >= 3 items and items[0].availablePortions >= 6 (seed: 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).

SHARED DATA WARNING: changes the COD cap of kitchen A; step 6 restores 'no cap'. The recipient is not edited, so its APPROVED status is kept (PaymentService.updateProfile keeps the status for an identical recipient).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

Cart: 1 × koshari + 1 × mahshi (total 255.00), Pickup, 'Cash on receipt', 'Calculate total'.
steps.data: total 25500 = cap

steps.action: Set the cap to 254.99 and Save.
Calculate the same basket again with 'Cash on receipt'; then with 'Deposit sent straight to the kitchen'.
Console: POST /api/v1/quotes with paymentMethod 'COD' for the same basket.
Clear the cap field and Save.

ui: Step 2: quote accepted (total exactly at the cap is eligible). Step 4: message 'Cash on receipt is not available for this total at this kitchen. Choose the deposit.' for cash; the deposit quote works with 'Deposit now: 127.50 · Rest on receipt: 127.50'.
api: Step 5: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{paymentMethod,'COD_NOT_ELIGIBLE'}].
database: SELECT cod_max_total_minor, recipient_status, version FROM kitchen_payment_profile WHERE kitchen_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001'; -> 25500, then 25499, then NULL; recipient_status APPROVED throughout.
No customer_order was created by this case.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Order ends after a reported transfer: reconciliation, staff decision 'kitchen owes a refund', kitchen reports the refund it sent
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).

FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION) holds finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve and finance.settlement; the ops web shows its 'Finance' tab (the tab appears only for accounts that may read statements, so finance.verify alone is not enough). Payment recipient approval and payment decisions also need a recent Keycloak MFA step-up (PR #9 realm flow); cash verification, refunds and settlements do not.

Staff accounts for this case are PROVISIONED fixtures: grants are written by the operator (DB insert into user_grant) or by FX-STAFF-ADMIN in the ops 'Staff permissions' screen; granting through the API requires staff.grant AND recent MFA (StaffController), which needs the PR #9 Keycloak step-up flow.
Run on a PR #9 deployment with the Keycloak step-up flow applied (steps 5-6 need a recent MFA proof). A pending deposit order D1 with the customer's transfer reported.

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: 'Accept' D1, press 'The deposit arrived (EGP 75.00)', then choose Reason 'Ingredient unavailable' and press 'Cancel'.
Reload D1; 'My account' > 'Notifications'; open the case link.
Ops web > 'Finance' > 'Payments needing attention' > filter 'Needs reconciliation': D1 is listed with the deposit and the order state 'Cancelled'.
Before deciding, console: POST /api/v1/ops/orders/<D1>/payment/decision {expectedVersion:v, outcome:'RECEIVED', reason:'no such outcome exists'}; then outcome 'REFUND_OWED' with reason 'short'.

In the form pick Decision 'Kitchen owes a refund', Reason 'Kitchen cancelled after receiving deposit (test)', press 'Record decision'. If it answers 'This action needs additional verification (MFA).', use 'Verify again' and repeat.
Orders (reload): the Deposit panel on D1 shows 'Kitchen owes a refund' with the field 'Refund transfer reference'. Type 'REFUND-TEST-1' and press 'Refund sent'.
Reload D1 and the notifications.

ui: Step 2: customer order 'Cancelled'; Payment panel 'Needs reconciliation' with 'The order ended after a reported transfer; support will follow up the refund or confirmation.'; a case 'Deposit review' (High). Step 5-6: customer Payment panel 'The kitchen owes you a refund' + 'The kitchen is responsible for returning your deposit. Contact support if it is late.'; inbox 'Deposit: the kitchen owes you a refund'. Step 7 (after the cook's report): 'The kitchen reported sending the refund' and inbox 'Deposit: the kitchen reported sending the refund'. The ops queue shows no decision that marks money received (only the two outcomes).
api: Step 4: invalid outcome 'RECEIVED' -> 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST (no outcome marks money as received); short reason -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED on field reason (bean-validation size rule, 10..500). Without a recent MFA proof the call returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED (on origin/develop the realm has no OTP flow, so MFA-gated steps cannot complete there). Step 5: 200 PaymentView state REFUND_OWED. Step 6: 200 state REFUNDED.
database: SELECT from_state, to_state, actor_type, amount_minor, reference, reason_code FROM payment_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY occurred_at, id; -> …→RECONCILE_PENDING (actor COOK, reason_code INGREDIENT_UNAVAILABLE, the ending reason of the order), →REFUND_OWED (STAFF, reason_code REFUND_OWED), →REFUNDED (COOK, amount 7500, reference REFUND-TEST-1).
SELECT category, severity, state FROM support_case WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY created_at; -> exactly one PAYMENT case created at RECONCILE_PENDING (not duplicated by REFUND_OWED).

SELECT action, outcome, reason, details FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'payment.decision' AND object_id = '<D1>'; -> ALLOWED with details {outcome:'REFUND_OWED', from:'RECONCILE_PENDING'} and the reason text.

SELECT count(*) FROM refund WHERE order_id = '<D1>'; -> 0 (this deposit path does not use the legacy platform refund table). SELECT n.type, n.recipient_id, n.params->>'state' AS state, n.read_at FROM notification n WHERE n.order_id = :'order' ORDER BY n.created_at;

unverified: Exact reason_code stored on the RECONCILE_PENDING event (the ending reason code of the order is passed through orderClosed).
Notification for RECONCILE_PENDING does not exist by design (only DISPUTED, REFUND_OWED, REFUNDED, KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED, CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED are notified).

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: A disputed deposit on an active order can still be settled when the kitchen finds the money
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
D1 from E2E-FIN-040 (ACCEPTED, payment DISPUTED, one open PAYMENT case).

Each actor uses a SEPARATE browser profile (or private window/cookie store): customer web, ops web and the API share one session cookie (SecurityConfiguration), so signing in as a second actor in the same profile silently replaces the first. Before each actor's steps run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` (helper in conventions.api_helper) and confirm the displayName is that actor.

steps.action: In the Deposit panel of D1 press 'The deposit arrived (EGP 75.00)'.
Press 'Start preparing'.
Check the support case.

ui: Panel badge 'Kitchen reported receipt'; 'Start preparing' now works.
api: Receipt 200 state KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED.
database: SELECT from_state, to_state, actor_type, amount_minor, reference, reason_code FROM payment_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY occurred_at, id; -> DISPUTED→KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED actor COOK amount 7500.
SELECT category, severity, state FROM support_case WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY created_at; -> the PAYMENT case is still OPEN (nothing closes it automatically; staff resolve it by hand).

unverified: That the case stays open is derived from the code (no auto-close); confirm whether the owner wants auto-resolution.

conventions.api_helper_usage: Paste once into the DevTools Console of a tab that is signed in as the stated actor: customer/cook-as-customer on https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook and staff on https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. The helper copies the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie into X-XSRF-TOKEN exactly like the web apps do (apps/customer-web/src/api.ts) and calls https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. If no XSRF-TOKEN cookie exists yet, run `await api('GET','/api/v1/me')` first. Mutating commands need a fresh `Idempotency-Key` (crypto.randomUUID(); allowed pattern [A-Za-z0-9-]{8,128}). VALIDATION_FAILED is HTTP 422, MALFORMED_REQUEST 400 (backend ErrorCode).

recipes.place_pickup_cod_x2: const sl=(await api('GET','/api/v1/kitchens/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001/slots')).body.items[0];const q=(await api('POST','/api/v1/quotes',{items:[{mealId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bb001',quantity:2}],slotId:sl.id,fulfillmentMode:'PICKUP',paymentMethod:'COD'})).body;const o=await api('POST','/api/v1/orders',{quoteId:q.quoteId,clientRequestId:crypto.randomUUID(),acceptedPolicyVersions:{terms:q.termsVersion,cancellation:q.cancellationPolicyVersion}},crypto.randomUUID());// o.status must be 201; o.body.id = order id, o.body.version = expectedVersion for the next command

conventions.seed_money_facts: Prices are integer piastres: koshari 7500, mahshi 18000, molokhia 12025; zone A delivery fee 3000; synthetic policy tax 0 bps, commission 0 bps; kitchen A deposit 5000 bps (50%), no COD cap; slot 13:00 Africa/Cairo, cutoff 11:00, 20 portions per slot, 10 per meal.
conventions.sql_note: Database checks are read-only SELECTs run through the operator's approved psql channel (never with write credentials, except the isolated-stack immutability case). :'order' is a psql variable holding the order UUID. Column names are from backend/app/src/main/resources/db/migration (V11 customer_order/order_item/stock_allocation/order_event, V12 handover_*, V13 cash_report/ledger_*, V14 notification, V17 support_case, V18 refund/settlement, V24-V25-V28 order_payment/payment_event, V29 request_fingerprint).
conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. Cases marked destructive change shared kitchen/catalogue settings and state their restore step. Always run the deposit journeys on a PR #9 deployment.
conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there. They are runnable only on a PR #9 deployment after the realm step-up flow is applied (docs/security/mfa-policy.md, Migration and rollout).
conventions.ui_language_note: Customer web, ops web and native default language differs (ops web starts in Arabic). Key assertions give the English label; the Arabic mirror is in apps/*/src/i18n.ts. Run each P0 journey once in Arabic (RTL) and once in English (LTR).
conventions.browser_profiles: Use one separate browser profile (cookie store) per actor: all web surfaces share the API session cookie, so a second sign-in in the same profile replaces the first. Run GET /api/v1/me before each actor's steps to confirm identity.
conventions.slot_capacity_rules: Seeded slots (days 1-3) have 20 portions each and 10 per meal; preparation consumes capacity permanently. Default assignment: ORDER-101 and FIN-101 day 1, ORDER-102, FIN-039 and FIN-106 day 2, ORDER-114/115 day 3. Day 1 = Cairo today+1, day 2 = today+2, day 3 = today+3. Before each case read the aggregate availablePortions from GET /api/v1/kitchens/<id>/slots (aggregate only) and the meal-specific availablePortions from the meal's nextSlots (GET /api/v1/meals/<mealId>); switch day if short.
conventions.statement_definitions: Statement 'Cash verified' = SUM(cash_obligation.amount_minor) WHERE state VERIFIED for the kitchen's orders whose COMPLETED event is inside the Cairo date range (default: current Cairo calendar month through today); assert increases, not absolutes. Banner text: 'No platform commission: the whole order amount is yours.' ('(owner decision D10)' appears only on the operating-configuration screen).

cases.title: Kitchen reports a different amount arrived: DISPUTED with the observed amount recorded
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
FX-COOK-A signs in at https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN> and the tab bar shows 'Orders' (ar: الطلبات); GET /api/v1/cook/dashboard in that session returns 200.
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.
In the DevTools Console of the signed-in tab, define the helper `api` from conventions.api_helper (needed for the API steps).

Kitchen A payment profile is the seeded one: deposit 50% (deposit_bps 5000), no COD cap, recipient INSTAPAY 'demo-kitchen@instapay.invalid' / 'Demo kitchen (not a real account)' with recipient_status APPROVED (verify: GET /api/v1/cook/payment-profile as FX-COOK-A).
A pending deposit order D1 (deposit 7500) with the transfer reported.

steps.action: In the Deposit panel type Amount that arrived (EGP) = 50.00 and press 'A different amount arrived'.
Console: POST …/payment/problem {expectedVersion:v, kind:'AMOUNT_MISMATCH'} (no amount); and {kind:'RECEIVED'}.

ui: Panel badge 'Payment disputed'.
api: Step 1 200 state DISPUTED. Missing amount: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{amountMinor,'REQUIRED_FOR_MISMATCH'}]. Unknown kind: 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST (there is no way to record 'received' through the problem endpoint).
database: SELECT from_state, to_state, actor_type, amount_minor, reference, reason_code FROM payment_event WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY occurred_at, id; -> →DISPUTED actor COOK amount_minor 5000 reason_code AMOUNT_MISMATCH.
SELECT category, severity, state FROM support_case WHERE order_id = :'order' ORDER BY created_at; -> one PAYMENT case.

cases.title: Settlements are dormant under zero commission: zero-amount entries cannot be batched
prerequisites: Preview stack reachable: customer web https://app.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, cook/staff web https://ops.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>, API https://api.<PREVIEW_DOMAIN>. seed-preview.sql is applied: on the customer web home, kitchen 'مطبخ المعاينة' lists 'Preview koshari' (EGP 75.00) and 'Preview mahshi' (EGP 180.00), and kitchen 'مطبخ تجريبي تاني' lists 'Preview molokhia' (EGP 120.25).
A read-only database method approved by the operator is available (psql through the operator channel); replace :'order' with the order UUID.

FX-STAFF-FINANCE (PROVISION) holds finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve and finance.settlement; the ops web shows its 'Finance' tab (the tab appears only for accounts that may read statements, so finance.verify alone is not enough). Payment recipient approval and payment decisions also need a recent Keycloak MFA step-up (PR #9 realm flow); cash verification, refunds and settlements do not.
A COMPLETED order O1 at kitchen A with its COMMISSION ledger group id G (SELECT id FROM ledger_group WHERE order_id = '<O1>' AND kind = 'COMMISSION';).

steps.action: Ops web > 'Finance' > kitchen 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001: open the 'Settlements' card and read 'Unsettled entries'.

Console: POST /api/v1/ops/finance/settlements {kitchenId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000bd001', period:{from:<today Cairo>,to:<today Cairo>}, entryIds:[G]} (fresh key). Then with a random UUID, then with an empty list.

ui: 'Unsettled entries' is empty (zero-amount groups are not listed).
api: Zero-amount entry: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED fieldErrors [{entryIds,'ZERO_AMOUNT'}]. Random UUID: 422 entryIds UNKNOWN_ENTRY. Empty list: 422 entryIds SIZE_1_500.
database: SELECT count(*) FROM settlement_batch; unchanged (the draft is rolled back with the failed request).
